verses.en: The waters saw Thee, O G-d; the waters saw Thee, they were in pain; the depths also trembled.

verses.he: זֹ֤רְמוּ מַ֨יִם עָב֗וֹת ק֭וֹל נָתְנ֣וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים אַף חֲ֝צָצֶ֗יךָ יִתְהַלָּֽכוּ׃
verses.en: The clouds flooded forth waters; the skies sent out a sound; Thine arrows also went abroad.

verses.he: ק֤וֹל רַעַמְךָ֨ בַּגַּלְגַּ֗ל הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקִ֣ים תֵּבֵ֑ל רָגְזָ֖ה וַתִּרְעַ֣שׁ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: The voice of Thy thunder was in the whirlwind; the lightnings lighted up the world; the earth trembled and shook.

verses.he: בַּיָּ֤ם דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ ושביליךושביליךוּֽ֭שְׁבִֽילְךָבְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝עִקְּבוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א נֹדָֽעוּ׃
verses.en: Thy way was in the sea, and Thy path in the great waters, and Thy footsteps were not known.

verses.he: נָחִ֣יתָ כַצֹּ֣אן עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּֽיַד מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.en: Thou didst lead Thy people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

verses.he: מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְאָ֫סָ֥ף הַאֲזִ֣ינָה עַ֭מִּי תּוֹרָתִ֑י הַטּ֥וּ אָ֝זְנְכֶ֗ם לְאִמְרֵי פִֽי׃
verses.en: Maschil of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, to my teaching; incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

verses.he: אֶפְתְּחָ֣ה בְמָשָׁ֣ל פִּ֑י אַבִּ֥יעָה חִ֝יד֗וֹת מִנִּי קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.en: I will open my mouth with a parable; I will utter dark sayings concerning days of old;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁ֭מַעְנוּ וַנֵּדָעֵ֑ם וַ֝אֲבוֹתֵ֗ינוּ סִפְּרוּ לָֽנוּ׃
verses.en: That which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us,

verses.he: לֹ֤א נְכַחֵ֨ד מִבְּנֵיהֶ֗ם לְד֥וֹר אַחֲר֗וֹן מְֽ֭סַפְּרִים תְּהִלּ֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה וֶעֱזוּז֥וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.en: We will not hide from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of HaShem, and His strength, and His wondrous works that He hath done.

verses.he: וַיָּ֤קֶם עֵד֨וּת בְּֽיַעֲקֹ֗ב וְתוֹרָה֮ שָׂ֤ם בְּיִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִ֭וָּה אֶת אֲבוֹתֵ֑ינוּ לְ֝הוֹדִיעָ֗ם לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: For He established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

verses.he: לְמַ֤עַן יֵדְע֨וּ דּ֣וֹר אַ֭חֲרוֹן בָּנִ֣ים יִוָּלֵ֑דוּ יָ֝קֻ֗מוּ וִֽיסַפְּר֥וּ לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: That the generation to come might know them, even the children that should be born; who should arise and tell them to their children,

verses.he: וְיָשִׂ֥ימוּ בֵֽאלֹהִ֗ים כִּ֫סְלָ֥ם וְלֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁכְּחוּ מַֽעַלְלֵי אֵ֑ל וּמִצְוֺתָ֥יו יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃
verses.en: That they might put their confidence in G-d, and not forget the works of G-d, but keep His commandments;

verses.he: וְלֹ֤א יִהְי֨וּ כַּאֲבוֹתָ֗ם דּוֹר֮ סוֹרֵ֪ר וּמֹ֫רֶ֥ה דּ֭וֹר לֹא הֵכִ֣ין לִבּ֑וֹ וְלֹא נֶאֶמְנָ֖ה אֶת אֵ֣ל רוּחֽוֹ׃
verses.en: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with G-d.

verses.he: בְּֽנֵי אֶפְרַ֗יִם נוֹשְׁקֵ֥י רוֹמֵי קָ֑שֶׁת הָ֝פְכ֗וּ בְּי֣וֹם קְרָֽב׃
verses.en: The children of Ephraim were as archers handling the bow, that turned back in the day of battle.

verses.he: לֹ֣א שָׁ֭מְרוּ בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּ֝בְתוֹרָת֗וֹ מֵאֲנ֥וּ לָלֶֽכֶת׃
verses.en: They kept not the covenant of G-d, and refused to walk in His law;

verses.he: וַיִּשְׁכְּח֥וּ עֲלִילוֹתָ֑יו וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶרְאָֽם׃
verses.en: And they forgot His doings, and His wondrous works that He had shown them.

verses.he: נֶ֣גֶד אֲ֭בוֹתָם עָ֣שָׂה פֶ֑לֶא בְּאֶ֖רֶץ מִצְרַ֣יִם שְׂדֵה צֹֽעַן׃
verses.en: Marvellous things did He in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

verses.he: בָּ֣קַע יָ֭ם וַיַּֽעֲבִירֵ֑ם וַֽיַּצֶּב מַ֥יִם כְּמוֹ נֵֽד׃
verses.en: He cleaved the sea, and caused them to pass through; and He made the waters to stand as a heap.

verses.he: וַיַּנְחֵ֣ם בֶּעָנָ֣ן יוֹמָ֑ם וְכָל הַ֝לַּ֗יְלָה בְּא֣וֹר אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.en: By day also He led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

verses.he: יְבַקַּ֣ע צֻ֭רִים בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַ֝יַּ֗שְׁקְ כִּתְהֹמ֥וֹת רַבָּֽה׃
verses.en: He cleaved rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the great deep.

verses.he: וַיּוֹצִ֣א נוֹזְלִ֣ים מִסָּ֑לַע וַיּ֖וֹרֶד כַּנְּהָר֣וֹת מָֽיִם׃
verses.en: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

verses.he: וַיּוֹסִ֣יפוּ ע֭וֹד לַחֲטֹא ל֑וֹ לַֽמְר֥וֹת עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּצִּיָּֽה׃
verses.en: Yet went they on still to sin against Him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

verses.he: וַיְנַסּוּ אֵ֥ל בִּלְבָבָ֑ם לִֽשְׁאָל אֹ֥כֶל לְנַפְשָֽׁם׃
verses.en: And they tried G-d in their heart by asking food for their craving.

verses.he: וַֽיְדַבְּר֗וּ בֵּֽאלֹ֫הִ֥ים אָ֭מְרוּ הֲי֣וּכַל אֵ֑ל לַעֲרֹ֥ךְ שֻׁ֝לְחָ֗ן בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.en: Yea, they spoke against G-d; they said: 'Can G-d prepare a table in the wilderness?

verses.he: הֵ֤ן הִכָּה צ֨וּר וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מַיִם֮ וּנְחָלִ֪ים יִ֫שְׁטֹ֥פוּ הֲגַם לֶ֭חֶם י֣וּכַל תֵּ֑ת אִם יָכִ֖ין שְׁאֵ֣ר לְעַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Behold, He smote the rock, that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed; can He give bread also? or will He provide flesh for His people?'

verses.he: לָכֵ֤ן שָׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֗ה וַֽיִּתְעַבָּ֥ר וְ֭אֵשׁ נִשְּׂקָ֣ה בְיַעֲקֹ֑ב וְגַם אַ֝֗ף עָלָ֥ה בְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.en: Therefore HaShem heard, and was wroth; and a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also went up against Israel;

verses.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א הֶ֭אֱמִינוּ בֵּאלֹהִ֑ים וְלֹ֥א בָ֝טְח֗וּ בִּֽישׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Because they believed not in G-d, and trusted not in His salvation.

verses.he: וַיְצַ֣ו שְׁחָקִ֣ים מִמָּ֑עַל וְדַלְתֵ֖י שָׁמַ֣יִם פָּתָֽח׃
verses.en: And He commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven;

verses.he: וַיַּמְטֵ֬ר עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מָ֣ן לֶאֱכֹ֑ל וּדְגַן שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם נָ֣תַן לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: And He caused manna to rain upon them for food, and gave them of the corn of heaven.

verses.he: לֶ֣חֶם אַ֭בִּירִים אָ֣כַל אִ֑ישׁ צֵידָ֬ה שָׁלַ֖ח לָהֶ֣ם לָשֹֽׂבַע׃
verses.en: Man did eat the bread of the mighty; He sent them provisions to the full.

verses.he: יַסַּ֣ע קָ֭דִים בַּשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַיְנַהֵ֖ג בְּעֻזּ֣וֹ תֵימָֽן׃
verses.en: He caused the east wind to set forth in heaven; and by His power He brought on the south wind.

verses.he: וַיַּמְטֵ֬ר עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּעָפָ֣ר שְׁאֵ֑ר וּֽכְח֥וֹל יַ֝מִּ֗ים ע֣וֹף כָּנָֽף׃
verses.en: He caused flesh also to rain upon them as the dust, and winged fowl as the sand of the seas;

verses.he: וַ֭יַּפֵּל בְּקֶ֣רֶב מַחֲנֵ֑הוּ סָ֝בִ֗יב לְמִשְׁכְּנֹתָֽיו׃
verses.en: And He let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their dwellings.

verses.he: וַיֹּאכְל֣וּ וַיִּשְׂבְּע֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝תַֽאֲוָתָ֗ם יָבִ֥א לָהֶֽם׃
verses.en: So they did eat, and were well filled; and He gave them that which they craved.

verses.he: לֹא זָר֥וּ מִתַּאֲוָתָ֑ם ע֝֗וֹד אָכְלָ֥ם בְּפִיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: They were not estranged from their craving, their food was yet in their mouths,

verses.he: וְאַ֤ף אֱלֹהִ֨ים עָ֘לָ֤ה בָהֶ֗ם וַֽ֭יַּהֲרֹג בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּיהֶ֑ם וּבַחוּרֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הִכְרִֽיעַ׃
verses.en: When the anger of G-d went up against them, and slew of the lustieth among them, and smote down the young men of Israel.

verses.he: בְּכָל זֹ֭את חָֽטְאוּ ע֑וֹד וְלֹֽא הֶ֝אֱמִ֗ינוּ בְּנִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.en: For all this they sinned still, and believed not in His wondrous works.

verses.he: וַיְכַל בַּהֶ֥בֶל יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וּ֝שְׁנוֹתָ֗ם בַּבֶּהָלָֽה׃
verses.en: Therefore He ended their days as a breath, and their years in terror.

verses.he: אִם הֲרָגָ֥ם וּדְרָשׁ֑וּהוּ וְ֝שָׁ֗בוּ וְשִֽׁחֲרוּ אֵֽל׃
verses.en: When He slew them, then they would inquire after Him, and turn back and seek G-d earnestly.

verses.he: וַֽ֭יִּזְכְּרוּ כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֣ים צוּרָ֑ם וְאֵ֥ל עֶ֝לְיוֹן גֹּאֲלָֽם׃
verses.en: And they remembered that G-d was their Rock, and the Most High G-d their redeemer.

verses.he: וַיְפַתּ֥וּהוּ בְּפִיהֶ֑ם וּ֝בִלְשׁוֹנָ֗ם יְכַזְּבוּ לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: But they beguiled Him with their mouth, and lied unto Him with their tongue.

verses.he: וְ֭לִבָּם לֹא נָכ֣וֹן עִמּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א נֶ֝אֶמְנ֗וּ בִּבְרִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: For their heart was not stedfast with Him, neither were they faithful in His covenant.

verses.he: וְה֤וּא רַח֨וּם יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָוֺן֮ וְֽלֹא יַ֫שְׁחִ֥ית וְ֭הִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא יָ֝עִיר כָּל חֲמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: But He, being full of compassion, forgiveth iniquity, and destroyeth not; yea, many a time doth He turn His anger away, and doth not stir up all His wrath.

verses.he: וַ֭יִּזְכֹּר כִּי בָשָׂ֣ר הֵ֑מָּה ר֥וּחַ ה֝וֹלֵ֗ךְ וְלֹ֣א יָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.en: So He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

verses.he: כַּ֭מָּה יַמְר֣וּהוּ בַמִּדְבָּ֑ר יַ֝עֲצִיב֗וּהוּ בִּֽישִׁימֽוֹן׃
verses.en: How oft did they rebel against Him in the wilderness, and grieve Him in the desert!

verses.he: וַיָּשׁ֣וּבוּ וַיְנַסּ֣וּ אֵ֑ל וּקְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הִתְווּ׃
verses.en: And still again they tried G-d, and set bounds to the Holy One of Israel.

verses.he: לֹא זָכְר֥וּ אֶת יָד֑וֹ י֝֗וֹם אֲֽשֶׁר פָּדָ֥ם מִנִּי צָֽר׃
verses.en: They remembered not His hand, nor the day when He redeemed them from the adversary.

verses.he: אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֣ם בְּ֭מִצְרַיִם אֹֽתוֹתָ֑יו וּ֝מוֹפְתָ֗יו בִּשְׂדֵה צֹֽעַן׃
verses.en: How He set His signs in Egypt, and His wonders in the field of Zoan;

verses.he: וַיַּהֲפֹ֣ךְ לְ֭דָם יְאֹרֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹזְלֵיהֶ֗ם בַּל יִשְׁתָּיֽוּן׃
verses.en: And turned their rivers into blood, so that they could not drink their streams.

verses.he: יְשַׁלַּ֬ח בָּהֶ֣ם עָ֭רֹב וַיֹּאכְלֵ֑ם וּ֝צְפַרְדֵּ֗עַ וַתַּשְׁחִיתֵֽם׃
verses.en: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

verses.he: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לֶחָסִ֣יל יְבוּלָ֑ם וִֽ֝יגִיעָ֗ם לָאַרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.en: He gave also their increase unto the caterpillar, and their labour unto the locust.

verses.he: יַהֲרֹ֣ג בַּבָּרָ֣ד גַּפְנָ֑ם וְ֝שִׁקְמוֹתָ֗ם בַּֽחֲנָמַֽל׃
verses.en: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycamore-trees with frost.

verses.he: וַיַּסְגֵּ֣ר לַבָּרָ֣ד בְּעִירָ֑ם וּ֝מִקְנֵיהֶ֗ם לָרְשָׁפִֽים׃
verses.en: He gave over their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to fiery bolts.

verses.he: יְשַׁלַּח בָּ֨ם חֲר֬וֹן אַפּ֗וֹ עֶבְרָ֣ה וָזַ֣עַם וְצָרָ֑ה מִ֝שְׁלַ֗חַת מַלְאֲכֵ֥י רָעִֽים׃
verses.en: He sent forth upon them the fierceness of His anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, a sending of messengers of evil.

verses.he: יְפַלֵּ֥ס נָתִ֗יב לְאַ֫פּ֥וֹ לֹא חָשַׂ֣ךְ מִמָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם לַדֶּ֥בֶר הִסְגִּֽיר׃
verses.en: He levelled a path for His anger; He spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;

verses.he: וַיַּ֣ךְ כָּל בְּכ֣וֹר בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם רֵאשִׁ֥ית א֝וֹנִ֗ים בְּאָהֳלֵי חָֽם׃
verses.en: And smote all the first-born in Egypt, the first-fruits of their strength in the tents of Ham;

verses.he: וַיַּסַּ֣ע כַּצֹּ֣אן עַמּ֑וֹ וַֽיְנַהֲגֵ֥ם כַּ֝עֵ֗דֶר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.en: But He made His own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

verses.he: וַיַּנְחֵ֣ם לָ֭בֶטַח וְלֹ֣א פָחָ֑דוּ וְאֶת א֝וֹיְבֵיהֶ֗ם כִּסָּ֥ה הַיָּֽם׃
verses.en: And He led them safely, and they feared not; but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

verses.he: וַ֭יְבִיאֵם אֶל גְּב֣וּל קָדְשׁ֑וֹ הַר זֶ֝֗ה קָנְתָ֥ה יְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.en: And He brought them to His holy border, to the mountain, which His right hand had gotten.

verses.he: וַיְגָ֤רֶשׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֨ם גּוֹיִ֗ם וַֽ֭יַּפִּילֵם בְּחֶ֣בֶל נַחֲלָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֥ן בְּ֝אָהֳלֵיהֶ֗ם שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.en: He drove out the nations also before them, and allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

verses.he: וַיְנַסּ֣וּ וַ֭יַּמְרוּ אֶת אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְי֑וֹן וְ֝עֵדוֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א שָׁמָֽרוּ׃
verses.en: Yet they tried and provoked G-d, the Most High, and kept not His testimonies;

verses.he: וַיִּסֹּ֣גוּ וַֽ֭יִּבְגְּדוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָ֑ם נֶ֝הְפְּכ֗וּ כְּקֶ֣שֶׁת רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.en: But turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers; they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

verses.he: וַיַּכְעִיס֥וּהוּ בְּבָמוֹתָ֑ם וּ֝בִפְסִילֵיהֶ֗ם יַקְנִיאֽוּהוּ׃
verses.en: For they provoked Him with their high places, and moved Him to jealousy with their graven images.

verses.he: שָׁמַ֣ע אֱ֭לֹהִים וַֽיִּתְעַבָּ֑ר וַיִּמְאַ֥ס מְ֝אֹ֗ד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.en: G-d heard, and was wroth, and He greatly abhorred Israel;
And He forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which He had made to dwell among men;

verses.he: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לַשְּׁבִ֣י עֻזּ֑וֹ וְֽתִפְאַרְתּ֥וֹ בְיַד צָֽר׃
verses.en: And delivered His strength into captivity, and His glory into the adversary's hand.

verses.he: וַיַּסְגֵּ֣ר לַחֶ֣רֶב עַמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְנַחֲלָת֗וֹ הִתְעַבָּֽר׃
verses.en: He gave His people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with His inheritance.

verses.he: בַּחוּרָ֥יו אָֽכְלָה אֵ֑שׁ וּ֝בְתוּלֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א הוּלָּֽלוּ׃
verses.en: Fire devoured their young men; and their virgins had no marriage-song.

verses.he: כֹּ֭הֲנָיו בַּחֶ֣רֶב נָפָ֑לוּ וְ֝אַלְמְנֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה׃
verses.en: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.

verses.he: וַיִּקַ֖ץ כְּיָשֵׁ֥ן אֲדֹנָ֑י כְּ֝גִבּ֗וֹר מִתְרוֹנֵ֥ן מִיָּֽיִן׃
verses.en: Then the L-rd awaked as one asleep, like a mighty man recovering from wine.

verses.he: וַיַּךְ צָרָ֥יו אָח֑וֹר חֶרְפַּ֥ת ע֝וֹלָ֗ם נָ֣תַן לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: And He smote His adversaries backward; He put upon them a perpetual reproach.

verses.he: וַ֭יִּמְאַס בְּאֹ֣הֶל יוֹסֵ֑ף וּֽבְשֵׁ֥בֶט אֶ֝פְרַ֗יִם לֹ֣א בָחָֽר׃
verses.en: Moreover He abhorred the tent of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim;

verses.he: וַ֭יִּבְחַר אֶת שֵׁ֣בֶט יְהוּדָ֑ה אֶֽת הַ֥ר צִ֝יּ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהֵֽב׃
verses.en: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which He loved.

verses.he: וַיִּ֣בֶן כְּמוֹ רָ֭מִים מִקְדָּשׁ֑וֹ כְּ֝אֶ֗רֶץ יְסָדָ֥הּ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.en: And He built His sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which He hath founded for ever.

verses.he: וַ֭יִּבְחַר בְּדָוִ֣ד עַבְדּ֑וֹ וַ֝יִּקָּחֵ֗הוּ מִֽמִּכְלְאֹ֥ת צֹֽאן׃
verses.en: He chose David also His servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

verses.he: מֵאַחַ֥ר עָל֗וֹת הֱ֫בִיא֥וֹ לִ֭רְעוֹת בְּיַעֲקֹ֣ב עַמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: From following the ewes that give suck He brought him, to be shepherd over Jacob His people, and Israel His inheritance.

verses.he: וַ֭יִּרְעֵם כְּתֹ֣ם לְבָב֑וֹ וּבִתְבוּנ֖וֹת כַּפָּ֣יו יַנְחֵֽם׃
verses.en: So he shepherded them according to the integrity of his heart; and lead them by the skilfulness of his hands.

verses.he: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֱֽלֹהִ֡ים בָּ֤אוּ גוֹיִ֨ם בְּֽנַחֲלָתֶ֗ךָ טִ֭מְּאוּ אֶת הֵיכַ֣ל קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ שָׂ֖מוּ אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֣ם לְעִיִּֽים׃
verses.en: A Psalm of Asaph. O G-d, the heathen are come into Thine inheritance; they have defiled Thy holy temple; they have made Jerusalem into heaps.

verses.he: נָֽתְנ֡וּ אֶת נִבְלַ֬ת עֲבָדֶ֗יךָ מַ֭אֲכָל לְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם בְּשַׂ֥ר חֲ֝סִידֶ֗יךָ לְחַיְתוֹ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: They have given the dead bodies of Thy servants to be food unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of Thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

verses.he: שָׁפְכ֬וּ דָמָ֨ם כַּמַּ֗יִם סְֽבִ֘יב֤וֹת יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם וְאֵ֣ין קוֹבֵֽר׃
verses.en: They have shed their blood like water round about Jerusalem, with none to bury them.

verses.he: הָיִ֣ינוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝קֶ֗לֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.en: We are become a taunt to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

verses.he: עַד מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תֶּאֱנַ֣ף לָנֶ֑צַח תִּבְעַ֥ר כְּמוֹ אֵ֝֗שׁ קִנְאָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: How long, O HaShem, wilt Thou be angry for ever? How long will Thy jealousy burn like fire?

verses.he: שְׁפֹ֤ךְ חֲמָתְךָ֨ אֶֽל הַגּוֹיִם֮ אֲשֶׁ֪ר לֹא יְדָ֫ע֥וּךָ וְעַ֥ל מַמְלָכ֑וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃
verses.en: Pour out Thy wrath upon the nations that know Thee not, and upon the kingdoms that call not upon Thy name.

verses.he: כִּ֭י אָכַ֣ל אֶֽת יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְֽאֶת נָוֵ֥הוּ הֵשַֽׁמּוּ׃
verses.en: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his habitation.

verses.he: אַֽל תִּזְכָּר לָנוּ֮ עֲוֺנֹ֪ת רִאשֹׁ֫נִ֥ים מַ֭הֵר יְקַדְּמ֣וּנוּ רַחֲמֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י דַלּ֣וֹנוּ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.en: Remember not against us the iniquities of our forefathers; let Thy compassions speedily come to meet us; for we are brought very low.

verses.he: עָזְרֵ֤נוּ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׁעֵ֗נוּ עַל דְּבַ֥ר כְּבֽוֹד שְׁמֶ֑ךָ וְהַצִּילֵ֥נוּ וְכַפֵּ֥ר עַל חַ֝טֹּאתֵ֗ינוּ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Help us, O G-d of our salvation, for the sake of the glory of Thy name; and deliver us, and forgive our sins, for Thy name's sake.

verses.he: לָ֤מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ הַגּוֹיִם֮ אַיֵּ֪ה אֱֽלֹהֵ֫יהֶ֥ם יִוָּדַ֣ע בגייםבגייםבַּגּוֹיִ֣םלְעֵינֵ֑ינוּ נִ֝קְמַ֗ת דַּֽם עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ הַשָּׁפֽוּךְ׃
verses.en: Wherefore should the nations say: 'Where is their G-d?' Let the avenging of Thy servants' blood that is shed be made known among the nations in our sight.

verses.he: תָּ֤ב֣וֹא לְפָנֶיךָ֮ אֶנְקַ֪ת אָ֫סִ֥יר כְּגֹ֥דֶל זְרוֹעֲךָ֑ ה֝וֹתֵ֗ר בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה׃
verses.en: Let the groaning of the prisoner come before Thee; according to the greatness of Thy power set free those that are appointed to death;

verses.he: וְהָ֘שֵׁ֤ב לִשְׁכֵנֵ֣ינוּ שִׁ֭בְעָתַיִם אֶל חֵיקָ֑ם חֶרְפָּ֘תָ֤ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר חֵרְפ֣וּךָ אֲדֹנָֽי׃
verses.en: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached Thee, O L-rd.

verses.he: וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַמְּךָ֨ וְצֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתֶךָ֮ נ֤וֹדֶ֥ה לְּךָ֗ לְע֫וֹלָ֥ם לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֑ר נְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: So we that are Thy people and the flock of Thy pasture will give Thee thanks for ever; we will tell of Thy praise to all generations.

verses.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אֶל שֹׁשַׁנִּ֑ים עֵד֖וּת לְאָסָ֣ף מִזְמֽוֹר׃
verses.en: For the Leader; upon Shoshannim. A testimony. A Psalm of Asaph.

verses.he: רֹ֘עֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל הַאֲזִ֗ינָה נֹהֵ֣ג כַּצֹּ֣אן יוֹסֵ֑ף יֹשֵׁ֖ב הַכְּרוּבִ֣ים הוֹפִֽיעָה׃
verses.en: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, Thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; Thou that art enthroned upon the cherubim, shine forth.

verses.he: לִפְנֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֨יִם וּבִנְיָ֘מִ֤ן וּמְנַשֶּׁ֗ה עוֹרְרָ֥ה אֶת גְּבֽוּרָתֶ֑ךָ וּלְכָ֖ה לִישֻׁעָ֣תָה לָּֽנוּ׃
verses.en: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up Thy might, and come to save us.

verses.he: אֱלֹהִ֥ים הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ וְהָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃
verses.en: O G-d, restore us; and cause Thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

verses.he: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֑וֹת עַד מָתַ֥י עָ֝שַׁ֗נְתָּ בִּתְפִלַּ֥ת עַמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: O HaShem G-d of hosts, how long wilt Thou be angry against the prayer of Thy people?

verses.he: הֶ֭אֱכַלְתָּם לֶ֣חֶם דִּמְעָ֑ה וַ֝תַּשְׁקֵ֗מוֹ בִּדְמָע֥וֹת שָׁלִֽישׁ׃
verses.en: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

verses.he: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ מָ֭דוֹן לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ וְ֝אֹיְבֵ֗ינוּ יִלְעֲגוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours; and our enemies mock as they please.

verses.he: אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֣וֹת הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ וְהָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃
verses.en: O G-d of hosts, restore us; and cause Thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

verses.he: גֶּ֭פֶן מִמִּצְרַ֣יִם תַּסִּ֑יעַ תְּגָרֵ֥שׁ גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם וַתִּטָּעֶֽהָ׃
verses.en: Thou didst pluck up a vine out of Egypt; Thou didst drive out the nations, and didst plant it.

verses.he: פִּנִּ֥יתָ לְפָנֶ֑יהָ וַתַּשְׁרֵ֥שׁ שָׁ֝רָשֶׁ֗יהָ וַתְּמַלֵּא אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Thou didst clear a place before it, and it took deep root, and filled the land.

verses.he: כָּסּ֣וּ הָרִ֣ים צִלָּ֑הּ וַ֝עֲנָפֶ֗יהָ אַֽרְזֵי אֵֽל׃
verses.en: The mountains were covered with the shadow of it, and the mighty cedars with the boughs thereof.

verses.he: תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח קְצִירֶ֣הָ עַד יָ֑ם וְאֶל נָ֝הָ֗ר יֽוֹנְקוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.en: She sent out her branches unto the sea, and her shoots unto the River.

verses.he: לָ֭מָּה פָּרַ֣צְתָּ גְדֵרֶ֑יהָ וְ֝אָר֗וּהָ כָּל עֹ֥בְרֵי דָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.en: Why hast Thou broken down her fences, so that all they that pass by the way do pluck her?

verses.he: יְכַרְסְמֶ֣נָּֽה חֲזִ֣יר מִיָּ֑ עַרוְזִ֖יז שָׂדַ֣י יִרְעֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: The boar out of the wood doth ravage it, that which moveth in the field feedeth on it.

verses.he: אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָאוֹת֮ שֽׁ֫וּב נָ֥א הַבֵּ֣ט מִשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּרְאֵ֑ה וּ֝פְקֹ֗ד גֶּ֣פֶן זֹֽאת׃
verses.en: O G-d of hosts, return, we beseech Thee; look from heaven, and behold, and be mindful of this vine,

verses.he: וְ֭כַנָּה אֲשֶׁר נָטְעָ֣ה יְמִינֶ֑ךָ וְעַל בֵּ֝֗ן אִמַּ֥צְתָּה לָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: And of the stock which Thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that Thou madest strong for Thyself.

verses.he: שְׂרֻפָ֣ה בָאֵ֣שׁ כְּסוּחָ֑ה מִגַּעֲרַ֖ת פָּנֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.en: It is burned with fire, it is cut down; they perish at the rebuke of Thy countenance.

verses.he: תְּֽהִי יָ֭דְךָ עַל אִ֣ישׁ יְמִינֶ֑ךָ עַל בֶּן אָ֝דָ֗ם אִמַּ֥צְתָּ לָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: Let Thy hand be upon the man of Thy right hand, upon the son of man whom Thou madest strong for Thyself.

verses.he: וְלֹא נָס֥וֹג מִמֶּ֑ךָּ תְּ֝חַיֵּ֗נוּ וּבְשִׁמְךָ֥ נִקְרָֽא׃
verses.en: So shall we not turn back from Thee; quicken Thou us, and we will call upon Thy name.

verses.he: יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֣וֹת הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ הָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃
verses.en: O HaShem G-d of hosts, restore us; cause Thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

verses.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ עַֽל הַגִּתִּ֬ית לְאָסָֽף׃
הַ֭רְנִינוּ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים עוּזֵּ֑נוּ הָ֝רִ֗יעוּ לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.en: Sing aloud unto G-d our strength; shout unto the G-d of Jacob.

verses.he: שְֽׂאוּ זִ֭מְרָה וּתְנוּ תֹ֑ף כִּנּ֖וֹר נָעִ֣ים עִם נָֽבֶל׃
verses.en: Take up the melody, and sound the timbrel, the sweet harp with the psaltery.

verses.he: תִּקְע֣וּ בַחֹ֣דֶשׁ שׁוֹפָ֑ר בַּ֝כֵּ֗סֶה לְי֣וֹם חַגֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.en: Blow the horn at the new moon, at the full moon for our feast-day.

verses.he: כִּ֤י חֹ֣ק לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל ה֑וּא מִ֝שְׁפָּ֗ט לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.en: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the G-d of Jacob.

verses.he: עֵ֤דוּת בִּֽיה֘וֹסֵ֤ף שָׂמ֗וֹ בְּ֭צֵאתוֹ עַל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם שְׂפַ֖ת לֹא יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.en: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, when He went forth against the land of Egypt. The speech of one that I knew not did I hear:

verses.he: הֲסִיר֣וֹתִי מִסֵּ֣בֶל שִׁכְמ֑וֹ כַּ֝פָּ֗יו מִדּ֥וּד תַּעֲבֹֽרְנָה׃
verses.en: 'I removed his shoulder from the burden; His hands were freed from the basket.

verses.he: בַּצָּרָ֥ה קָרָ֗אתָ וָאֲחַ֫לְּצֶ֥ךָּ אֶ֭עֶנְךָ בְּסֵ֣תֶר רַ֑עַם אֶבְחָֽנְךָ֨ עַל מֵ֖י מְרִיבָ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: Thou didst call in trouble, and I rescued thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder; I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah

verses.he: שְׁמַ֣ע עַ֭מִּי וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑ךְ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם תִּֽשְׁמַֽע לִֽי׃
verses.en: Hear, O My people, and I will admonish thee: O Israel, if thou wouldest hearken unto Me!

verses.he: לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֣ה בְ֭ךָ אֵ֣ל זָ֑ר וְלֹ֥א תִ֝שְׁתַּחֲוֶ֗ה לְאֵ֣ל נֵכָֽר׃
verses.en: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any foreign god.

verses.he: אָנֹכִ֨י יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ הַֽ֭מַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הַרְחֶב פִּ֝֗יךָ וַאֲמַלְאֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: I am HaShem thy G-d, who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt; open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

verses.he: וְלֹא שָׁמַ֣ע עַמִּ֣י לְקוֹלִ֑י וְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֹא אָ֥בָה לִֽי׃
verses.en: But My people hearkened not to My voice; and Israel would none of Me.

verses.he: וָֽ֭אֲשַׁלְּחֵהוּ בִּשְׁרִיר֣וּת לִבָּ֑ם יֵ֝לְכ֗וּ בְּֽמוֹעֲצוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their heart, that they might walk in their own counsels.

verses.he: ל֗וּ עַ֭מִּי שֹׁמֵ֣עַֽ לִ֑י יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל בִּדְרָכַ֥י יְהַלֵּֽכוּ׃
verses.en: Oh that My people would hearken unto Me, that Israel would walk in My ways!

verses.he: כִּ֭מְעַט אוֹיְבֵיהֶ֣ם אַכְנִ֑יעַ וְעַ֥ל צָ֝רֵיהֶ֗ם אָשִׁ֥יב יָדִֽי׃
verses.en: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn My hand against their adversaries.

verses.he: מְשַׂנְאֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה יְכַֽחֲשׁוּ ל֑וֹ וִיהִ֖י עִתָּ֣ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.en: The haters of HaShem should dwindle away before Him; and their punishment should endure for ever.

verses.he: וַֽ֭יַּאֲכִילֵהוּ מֵחֵ֣לֶב חִטָּ֑ה וּ֝מִצּ֗וּר דְּבַ֣שׁ אַשְׂבִּיעֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: They should also be fed with the fat of wheat; and with honey out of the rock would I satisfy thee.'

verses.he: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים נִצָּ֥ב בַּעֲדַת אֵ֑ל בְּקֶ֖רֶב אֱלֹהִ֣ים יִשְׁפֹּֽט׃
verses.en: A Psalm of Asaph. G-d standeth in the congregation of G-d; in the midst of the judges He judgeth:

verses.he: עַד מָתַ֥י תִּשְׁפְּטוּ עָ֑וֶל וּפְנֵ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תִּשְׂאוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: 'How long will ye judge unjustly, and respect the persons of the wicked? Selah

verses.he: שִׁפְטוּ דַ֥ל וְיָת֑וֹם עָנִ֖י וָרָ֣שׁ הַצְדִּֽיקוּ׃
verses.en: Judge the poor and fatherless; do justice to the afflicted and destitute.

verses.he: פַּלְּטוּ דַ֥ל וְאֶבְי֑וֹן מִיַּ֖ד רְשָׁעִ֣ים הַצִּֽילוּ׃
verses.en: Rescue the poor and needy; deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.he: לֹ֤א יָֽדְע֨וּ וְלֹ֥א יָבִ֗ינוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָ֥ה יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ יִ֝מּ֗וֹטוּ כָּל מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: They know not, neither do they understand; they go about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are moved.

verses.he: אֲֽנִי אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִ֣ים אַתֶּ֑ם וּבְנֵ֖י עֶלְי֣וֹן כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃
verses.en: I said: Ye are godlike beings, and all of you sons of the Most High.

verses.he: אָ֭כֵן כְּאָדָ֣ם תְּמוּת֑וּן וּכְאַחַ֖ד הַשָּׂרִ֣ים תִּפֹּֽלוּ׃
verses.en: Nevertheless ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.'

verses.he: קוּמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שָׁפְטָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי אַתָּ֥ה תִ֝נְחַ֗ל בְּכָל הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.en: Arise, O G-d, judge the earth; for Thou shalt possess all nations.

verses.he: שִׁ֖יר מִזְמ֣וֹר לְאָסָֽף׃
verses.en: A Song, a Psalm of Asaph.

verses.he: אֱלֹהִ֥ים אַל דֳּמִי לָ֑ךְ אַל תֶּחֱרַ֖שׁ וְאַל תִּשְׁקֹ֣ט אֵֽל׃
verses.en: O G-d, keep not Thou silence; hold not Thy peace, and be not still, O G-d.

verses.he: כִּֽי הִנֵּ֣ה א֭וֹיְבֶיךָ יֶהֱמָי֑וּן וּ֝מְשַׂנְאֶ֗יךָ נָ֣שְׂאוּ רֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.en: For, lo, Thine enemies are in an uproar; and they that hate Thee have lifted up the head.

verses.he: עַֽל עַ֭מְּךָ יַעֲרִ֣ימוּ ס֑וֹד וְ֝יִתְיָעֲצ֗וּ עַל צְפוּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: They hold crafty converse against Thy people, and take counsel against Thy treasured ones.

verses.he: אָמְר֗וּ לְ֭כוּ וְנַכְחִידֵ֣ם מִגּ֑וֹי וְלֹֽא יִזָּכֵ֖ר שֵֽׁם יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עֽוֹד׃
verses.en: They have said: 'Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.'

verses.he: כִּ֤י נוֹעֲצ֣וּ לֵ֣ב יַחְדָּ֑ו עָ֝לֶ֗יךָ בְּרִ֣ית יִכְרֹֽתוּ׃
verses.en: For they have consulted together with one consent; against Thee do they make a covenant;

verses.he: אָהֳלֵ֣י אֱ֭דוֹם וְיִשְׁמְעֵאלִ֗ים מוֹאָ֥ב וְהַגְרִֽים׃
verses.en: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

verses.he: גְּבָ֣ל וְ֭עַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵ֑ק פְּ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת עִם יֹ֥שְׁבֵי צֽוֹר׃
verses.en: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

verses.he: גַּם אַ֭שּׁוּר נִלְוָ֣ה עִמָּ֑ם הָ֤י֥וּ זְר֖וֹעַ לִבְנֵי ל֣וֹט סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: Assyria also is joined with them; they have been an arm to the children of Lot. Selah

verses.he: עֲשֵֽׂה לָהֶ֥ם כְּמִדְיָ֑ן כְּֽסִֽיסְרָ֥א כְ֝יָבִ֗ין בְּנַ֣חַל קִישֽׁוֹן׃
verses.en: Do Thou unto them as unto Midian; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook Kishon;

verses.he: נִשְׁמְד֥וּ בְֽעֵין דֹּ֑אר הָ֥יוּ דֹּ֝֗מֶן לָאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.en: Who were destroyed at En-dor; they became as dung for the earth.

verses.he: שִׁיתֵ֣מוֹ נְ֭דִיבֵמוֹ כְּעֹרֵ֣ב וְכִזְאֵ֑ב וּֽכְזֶ֥בַח וּ֝כְצַלְמֻנָּ֗ע כָּל נְסִיכֵֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, and like Zebah and Zalmunna all their princes;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָ֭מְרוּ נִ֣ירֲשָׁה לָּ֑נוּ אֵ֝֗ת נְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.en: Who said: 'Let us take to ourselves in possession the habitations of G-d.'

verses.he: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י שִׁיתֵ֥מוֹ כַגַּלְגַּ֑ל כְּ֝קַ֗שׁ לִפְנֵי רֽוּחַ׃
verses.en: O my G-d, make them like the whirling dust; as stubble before the wind.

verses.he: כְּאֵ֥שׁ תִּבְעַר יָ֑עַר וּ֝כְלֶהָבָ֗ה תְּלַהֵ֥ט הָרִֽים׃
verses.en: As the fire that burneth the forest, and as the flame that setteth the mountains ablaze;

verses.he: כֵּ֭ן תִּרְדְּפֵ֣ם בְּסַעֲרֶ֑ךָ וּבְסוּפָתְךָ֥ תְבַהֲלֵֽם׃
verses.en: So pursue them with Thy tempest, and affright them with Thy storm.

verses.he: מַלֵּ֣א פְנֵיהֶ֣ם קָל֑וֹן וִֽיבַקְשׁ֖וּ שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek Thy name, O HaShem.

verses.he: יֵבֹ֖שׁוּ וְיִבָּהֲל֥וּ עֲדֵי עַ֗ד וְֽיַחְפְּר֥וּ וְיֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.en: Let them be ashamed and affrighted for ever; yea, let them be abashed and perish;

verses.he: וְֽיֵדְע֗וּ כִּֽי אַתָּ֬ה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה לְבַדֶּ֑ךָ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן עַל כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: That they may know that it is Thou alone whose name is HaShem, the Most High over all the earth.

verses.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל הַגִּתִּ֑ית לִבְנֵי קֹ֥רַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃
verses.en: For the Leader; upon the Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.

verses.he: מַה יְּדִיד֥וֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶ֗יךָ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.en: How lovely are Thy tabernacles, O HaShem of hosts!

verses.he: נִכְסְפָ֬ה וְגַם כָּלְתָ֨ה נַפְשִׁי֮ לְחַצְר֪וֹת יְה֫וָ֥ה לִבִּ֥י וּבְשָׂרִ֑י יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ אֶ֣ל אֵֽל חָֽי׃
verses.en: My soul yearneth, yea, even pineth for the courts of HaShem; my heart and my flesh sing for joy unto the living G-d.

verses.he: גַּם צִפּ֨וֹר מָ֪צְאָה בַ֡יִת וּדְר֤וֹר קֵ֥ן לָהּ֮ אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֪תָה אֶפְרֹ֫חֶ֥יהָ אֶֽת מִ֭זְבְּחוֹתֶיךָ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת מַ֝לְכִּ֗י וֵאלֹהָֽי׃
verses.en: Yea, the sparrow hath found a house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young; Thine altars, O HaShem of hosts, my King, and my G-d--.

verses.he: אַ֭שְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י בֵיתֶ֑ךָ ע֝֗וֹד יְֽהַלְל֥וּךָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.en: Happy are they that dwell in Thy house, they are ever praising Thee. Selah

verses.he: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם עֽוֹז ל֥וֹ בָ֑ךְ מְ֝סִלּ֗וֹת בִּלְבָבָֽם׃
verses.en: Happy is the man whose strength is in Thee; in whose heart are the highways.

verses.he: עֹבְרֵ֤י בְּעֵ֣מֶק הַ֭בָּכָא מַעְיָ֣ן יְשִׁית֑וּהוּ גַּם בְּ֝רָכ֗וֹת יַעְטֶ֥ה מוֹרֶֽה׃
verses.en: Passing through the valley of Baca they make it a place of springs; yea, the early rain clotheth it with blessings.

verses.he: יֵ֭לְכוּ מֵחַ֣יִל אֶל חָ֑יִל יֵרָאֶ֖ה אֶל אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּצִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.en: They go from strength to strength, every one of them appeareth before G-d in Zion.

verses.he: יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְ֭בָאוֹת שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י הַאֲזִ֨ינָה אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: O HaShem G-d of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O G-d of Jacob. Selah

verses.he: מָ֭גִנֵּנוּ רְאֵ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ֝הַבֵּ֗ט פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Behold, O G-d our shield, and look upon the face of Thine anointed.

verses.he: כִּ֤י טֽוֹב י֥וֹם בַּחֲצֵרֶ֗יךָ מֵ֫אָ֥לֶף בָּחַ֗רְתִּי הִ֭סְתּוֹפֵף בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהַ֑י מִ֝דּ֗וּר בְּאָהֳלֵי רֶֽשַׁע׃
verses.en: For a day in Thy courts is better than a thousand; I had rather stand at the threshold of the house of my G-d, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

verses.he: כִּ֤י שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ וּמָגֵן֮ יְהוָ֪ה אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֣ן וְ֭כָבוֹד יִתֵּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֥א יִמְנַע ט֝֗וֹב לַֽהֹלְכִ֥ים בְּתָמִֽים׃
verses.en: For HaShem G-d is a sun and a shield; HaShem giveth grace and glory; no good thing will He withhold from them that walk uprightly.

verses.he: יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י אָ֝דָ֗ם בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: O HaShem of hosts, happy is the man that trusteth in Thee.

verses.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ לִבְנֵי קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃
verses.en: For the Leader. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.

verses.he: רָצִ֣יתָ יְהוָ֣ה אַרְצֶ֑ךָ שַׁ֝֗בְתָּ שבותשבותשְׁבִ֣יתיַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.en: HaShem, Thou hast been favourable unto Thy land, Thou hast turned the captivity of Jacob.

verses.he: נָ֭שָׂאתָ עֲוֺ֣ן עַמֶּ֑ךָ כִּסִּ֖יתָ כָל חַטָּאתָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of Thy people, Thou hast pardoned all their sin. Selah

verses.he: אָסַ֥פְתָּ כָל עֶבְרָתֶ֑ךָ הֱ֝שִׁיב֗וֹתָ מֵחֲר֥וֹן אַפֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: Thou hast withdrawn all Thy wrath; Thou hast turned from the fierceness of Thine anger.

verses.he: שׁ֭וּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ וְהָפֵ֖ר כַּֽעַסְךָ֣ עִמָּֽנוּ׃
verses.en: Restore us, O G-d of our salvation, and cause Thine indignation toward us to cease.

verses.he: הַלְעוֹלָ֥ם תֶּֽאֱנַף בָּ֑נוּ תִּמְשֹׁ֥ךְ אַ֝פְּךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.en: Wilt Thou be angry with us for ever? Wilt Thou draw out Thine anger to all generations?

verses.he: הֲֽלֹא אַ֭תָּה תָּשׁ֣וּב תְּחַיֵּ֑נוּ וְ֝עַמְּךָ֗ יִשְׂמְחוּ בָֽךְ׃
verses.en: Wilt Thou not quicken us again, that Thy people may rejoice in Thee?

verses.he: הַרְאֵ֣נוּ יְהוָ֣ה חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝יֶשְׁעֲךָ֗ תִּתֶּן לָֽנוּ׃
verses.en: Show us Thy mercy, O HaShem, and grant us Thy salvation.

verses.he: אֶשְׁמְעָ֗ה מַה יְדַבֵּר֮ הָאֵ֪ל יְה֫וָ֥ה כִּ֤י יְדַבֵּ֬ר שָׁל֗וֹם אֶל עַמּ֥וֹ וְאֶל חֲסִידָ֑יו וְֽאַל יָשׁ֥וּבוּ לְכִסְלָֽה׃
verses.en: I will hear what G-d HaShem will speak; for He will speak peace unto His people, and to His saints; but let them not turn back to folly.

verses.he: אַ֤ךְ קָר֣וֹב לִירֵאָ֣יו יִשְׁע֑וֹ לִשְׁכֹּ֖ן כָּב֣וֹד בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ׃
verses.en: Surely His salvation is nigh them that fear Him; that glory may dwell in our land.

verses.he: חֶֽסֶד וֶאֱמֶ֥ת נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ צֶ֖דֶק וְשָׁל֣וֹם נָשָֽׁקוּ׃
verses.en: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

verses.he: אֱ֭מֶת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תִּצְמָ֑ח וְ֝צֶ֗דֶק מִשָּׁמַ֥יִם נִשְׁקָֽף׃
verses.en: Truth springeth out of the earth; and righteousness hath looked down from heaven.

verses.he: גַּם יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן הַטּ֑וֹב וְ֝אַרְצֵ֗נוּ תִּתֵּ֥ן יְבוּלָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Yea, HaShem will give that which is good; and our land shall yield her produce.

verses.he: צֶ֭דֶק לְפָנָ֣יו יְהַלֵּ֑ךְ וְיָשֵׂ֖ם לְדֶ֣רֶךְ פְּעָמָֽיו׃
verses.en: Righteousness shall go before Him, and shall make His footsteps a way.

verses.he: תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הַטֵּֽה יְהוָ֣ה אָזְנְךָ֣ עֲנֵ֑נִי כִּֽי עָנִ֖י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן אָֽנִי׃
verses.en: A Prayer of David. Incline Thine ear, O HaShem, and answer me; for I am poor and needy.

verses.he: שָֽׁמְרָ֣ה נַפְשִׁי֮ כִּֽי חָסִ֪יד אָ֥נִי הוֹשַׁ֣ע עַ֭בְדְּךָ אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֑י הַבּוֹטֵ֥חַ אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Keep my soul, for I am godly; O Thou my G-d, save Thy servant that trusteth in Thee.

verses.he: חָנֵּ֥נִי אֲדֹנָ֑י כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֶ֝קְרָ֗א כָּל הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.en: Be gracious unto me, O L-rd; for unto Thee do I cry all the day.

verses.he: שַׂ֭מֵּחַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא׃
verses.en: Rejoice the soul of Thy servant; for unto Thee, O L-rd, do I lift up my soul.

verses.he: כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי ט֣וֹב וְסַלָּ֑ח וְרַב חֶ֝֗סֶד לְכָל קֹרְאֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: For Thou, L-rd, art good, and ready to pardon, and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon Thee.

verses.he: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה יְ֭הוָה תְּפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבָה בְּק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנוֹתָֽי׃
verses.en: Give ear, O HaShem, unto my prayer; and attend unto the voice of my supplications.

verses.he: בְּי֣וֹם צָ֭רָתִ֥י אֶקְרָאֶ֗ךָּ כִּ֣י תַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: In the day of my trouble I call upon Thee; for Thou wilt answer me.

verses.he: אֵין כָּמ֖וֹךָ בָאֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲדֹנָ֗י וְאֵ֣ין כְּֽמַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ׃
verses.en: There is none like unto Thee among the gods, O L-rd, and there are no works like Thine.

verses.he: כָּל גּוֹיִ֤ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֗יתָ יָב֤וֹאוּ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְפָנֶ֣יךָ אֲדֹנָ֑י וִֽיכַבְּד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: All nations whom Thou hast made shall come and prostrate themselves before Thee, O L-rd; and they shall glorify Thy name.

verses.he: כִּֽי גָד֣וֹל אַ֭תָּה וְעֹשֵׂ֣ה נִפְלָא֑וֹת אַתָּ֖ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: For Thou art great, and doest wondrous things; Thou art G-d alone.

verses.he: ה֘וֹרֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֨ה דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ אֲהַלֵּ֥ךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ יַחֵ֥ד לְ֝בָבִ֗י לְיִרְאָ֥ה שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Teach me, O HaShem, Thy way, that I may walk in Thy truth; make one my heart to fear Thy name.

verses.he: אוֹדְךָ֤ אֲדֹנָ֣י אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּכָל לְבָבִ֑י וַאֲכַבְּדָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.en: I will thank Thee, O L-rd my G-d, with my whole heart; and I will glorify Thy name for evermore.

verses.he: כִּֽי חַ֭סְדְּךָ גָּד֣וֹל עָלָ֑י וְהִצַּ֥לְתָּ נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י מִשְּׁא֥וֹל תַּחְתִּיָּֽה׃
verses.en: For great is Thy mercy toward me; and Thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest nether-world.

verses.he: אֱלֹהִ֤ים זֵ֘דִ֤ים קָֽמוּ עָלַ֗י וַעֲדַ֣ת עָ֭רִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א שָׂמ֣וּךָ לְנֶגְדָּֽם׃
verses.en: O G-d, the proud are risen up against me, and the company of violent men have sought after my soul, and have not set Thee before them.

verses.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי אֵל רַח֣וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וְרַב חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃
verses.en: But Thou, O L-rd, art a G-d full of compassion and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

verses.he: פְּנֵ֥ה אֵלַ֗י וְחָ֫נֵּ֥נִי תְּנָֽה עֻזְּךָ֥ לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעָה לְבֶן אֲמָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: O turn unto me, and be gracious unto me; give Thy strength unto Thy servant, and save the son of Thy handmaid.

verses.he: עֲשֵֽׂה עִמִּ֥י א֗וֹת לְט֫וֹבָ֥ה וְיִרְא֣וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣י וְיֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי אַתָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עֲזַרְתַּ֥נִי וְנִחַמְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.en: Work in my behalf a sign for good; that they that hate me may see it, and be put to shame, because Thou, HaShem, hast helped me, and comforted me.

verses.he: לִבְנֵי קֹ֭רַח מִזְמ֣וֹר שִׁ֑יר יְ֝סוּדָת֗וֹ בְּהַרְרֵי קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.en: A Psalm of the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.

verses.he: אֹהֵ֣ב יְ֭הוָה שַׁעֲרֵ֣י צִיּ֑וֹן מִ֝כֹּ֗ל מִשְׁכְּנ֥וֹת יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.en: HaShem loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

verses.he: נִ֭כְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּ֣ר בָּ֑ךְ עִ֖יר הָאֱלֹהִ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: Glorious things are spoken of Thee, O city of G-d. Selah

verses.he: אַזְכִּ֤יר רַ֥הַב וּבָבֶ֗ל לְֽיֹ֫דְעָ֥י הִנֵּ֤ה פְלֶ֣שֶׁת וְצ֣וֹר עִם כּ֑וּשׁ זֶ֝֗ה יֻלַּד שָֽׁם׃
verses.en: 'I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon as among them that know Me; behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this one was born there.'

verses.he: וּֽלֲצִיּ֨וֹן יֵאָמַ֗ר אִ֣ישׁ וְ֭אִישׁ יֻלַּד בָּ֑הּ וְה֖וּא יְכוֹנְנֶ֣הָ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.en: But of Zion it shall be said: 'This man and that was born in her; and the Most High Himself doth establish her.'

verses.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה יִ֭סְפֹּר בִּכְת֣וֹב עַמִּ֑ים זֶ֖ה יֻלַּד שָׁ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: HaShem shall count in the register of the peoples: 'This one was born there.' Selah

verses.he: וְשָׁרִ֥ים כְּחֹלְלִ֑ים כָּֽל מַעְיָנַ֥י בָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: And whether they sing or dance, all my thoughts are in Thee.

verses.he: שִׁ֥יר מִזְמ֗וֹר לִבְנֵ֫י קֹ֥רַח לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ עַל מָחֲלַ֣ת לְעַנּ֑וֹת מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְהֵימָ֥ן הָאֶזְרָחִֽי׃
verses.en: A Song, a Psalm of the sons of Korah; for the Leader; upon Mahalath Leannoth. Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.

verses.he: יְ֭הוָה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יְשׁוּעָתִ֑י יוֹם צָעַ֖קְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: O HaShem, G-d of my salvation, what time I cry in the night before Thee,

verses.he: תָּב֣וֹא לְ֭פָנֶיךָ תְּפִלָּתִ֑י הַטֵּֽה אָ֝זְנְךָ֗ לְרִנָּתִֽי׃
verses.en: Let my prayer come before Thee, incline Thine ear unto my cry.

verses.he: כִּֽי שָֽׂבְעָ֣ה בְרָע֣וֹת נַפְשִׁ֑י וְחַיַּ֗י לִשְׁא֥וֹל הִגִּֽיעוּ׃
verses.en: For my soul is sated with troubles, and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.

verses.he: נֶ֭חְשַׁבְתִּי עִם י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֑וֹר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּגֶ֣בֶר אֵֽין אֱיָֽל׃
verses.en: I am counted with them that go down into the pit; I am become as a man that hath no help;

verses.he: בַּמֵּתִ֗ים חָ֫פְשִׁ֥י כְּמ֤וֹ חֲלָלִ֨ים שֹׁ֥כְבֵי קֶ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹ֣א זְכַרְתָּ֣ם ע֑וֹד וְ֝הֵ֗מָּה מִיָּדְךָ֥ נִגְזָֽרוּ׃
verses.en: Set apart among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom Thou rememberest no more; and they are cut off from Thy hand.

verses.he: שַׁ֭תַּנִי בְּב֣וֹר תַּחְתִּיּ֑וֹת בְּ֝מַחֲשַׁכִּ֗ים בִּמְצֹלֽוֹת׃
verses.en: Thou hast laid me in the nether-most pit, in dark places, in the deeps.

verses.he: עָ֭לַי סָמְכָ֣ה חֲמָתֶ֑ךָ וְכָל מִ֝שְׁבָּרֶ֗יךָ עִנִּ֥יתָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.en: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and all Thy waves Thou pressest down. Selah

verses.he: הִרְחַ֥קְתָּ מְיֻדָּעַ֗י מִ֫מֶּ֥נִּי שַׁתַּ֣נִי תוֹעֵב֣וֹת לָ֑מוֹ כָּ֝לֻ֗א וְלֹ֣א אֵצֵֽא׃
verses.en: Thou hast put mine acquaintance far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination unto them; I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

verses.he: עֵינִ֥י דָאֲבָ֗ה מִנִּ֫י עֹ֥נִי קְרָאתִ֣יךָ יְהוָ֣ה בְּכָל י֑וֹם שִׁטַּ֖חְתִּי אֵלֶ֣יךָ כַפָּֽי׃
verses.en: Mine eye languisheth by reason of affliction; I have called upon Thee, O HaShem, every day, I have spread forth my hands unto Thee.

verses.he: הֲלַמֵּתִ֥ים תַּעֲשֶׂה פֶּ֑לֶא אִם רְ֝פָאִ֗ים יָק֤וּמוּ יוֹד֬וּךָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.en: Wilt Thou work wonders for the dead? Or shall the shades arise and give Thee thanks? Selah

verses.he: הַיְסֻפַּ֣ר בַּקֶּ֣בֶר חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ אֱ֝מֽוּנָתְךָ֗ בָּאֲבַדּֽוֹן׃
verses.en: Shall Thy mercy be declared in the grave? or Thy faithfulness in destruction?

verses.he: הֲיִוָּדַ֣ע בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ פִּלְאֶ֑ךָ וְ֝צִדְקָתְךָ֗ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ נְשִׁיָּֽה׃
verses.en: Shall Thy wonders be known in the dark? and Thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

verses.he: וַאֲנִ֤י אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְהוָ֣ה שִׁוַּ֑עְתִּי וּ֝בַבֹּ֗קֶר תְּֽפִלָּתִ֥י תְקַדְּמֶֽךָּ׃
verses.en: But as for me, unto Thee, O HaShem, do I cry, and in the morning doth my prayer come to meet Thee.

verses.he: לָמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תִּזְנַ֣ח נַפְשִׁ֑י תַּסְתִּ֖יר פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.en: HaShem, why castest Thou off my soul? Why hidest Thou Thy face from me?

verses.he: עָ֘נִ֤י אֲנִ֣י וְגֹוֵ֣עַ מִנֹּ֑עַר נָשָׂ֖אתִי אֵמֶ֣יךָ אָפֽוּנָה׃
verses.en: I am afflicted and at the point of death from my youth up; I have borne Thy terrors, I am distracted.

verses.he: עָ֭לַי עָבְר֣וּ חֲרוֹנֶ֑יךָ בִּ֝עוּתֶ֗יךָ צִמְּתוּתֻֽנִי׃
verses.en: Thy fierce wrath is gone over me; Thy terrors have cut me off.

verses.he: סַבּ֣וּנִי כַ֭מַּיִם כָּל הַיּ֑וֹם הִקִּ֖יפוּ עָלַ֣י יָֽחַד׃
verses.en: They came round about me like water all the day; they compassed me about together.

verses.he: הִרְחַ֣קְתָּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי אֹהֵ֣ב וָרֵ֑עַ מְֽיֻדָּעַ֥י מַחְשָֽׁךְ׃
verses.en: Friend and companion hast Thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.

verses.he: מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְאֵיתָ֥ן הָֽאֶזְרָחִֽי׃
verses.en: Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.

verses.he: חַֽסְדֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה עוֹלָ֣ם אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֓ר אוֹדִ֖יעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בְּפִֽי׃
verses.en: I will sing of the mercies of HaShem for ever; to all generations will I make known Thy faithfulness with my mouth.

verses.he: כִּֽי אָמַ֗רְתִּי ע֭וֹלָם חֶ֣סֶד יִבָּנֶ֑ה שָׁמַ֓יִם תָּכִ֖ן אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בָהֶֽם׃
verses.en: For I have said: 'For ever is mercy built; in the very heavens Thou dost establish Thy faithfulness.

verses.he: כָּרַ֣תִּֽי בְ֭רִית לִבְחִירִ֑י נִ֝שְׁבַּ֗עְתִּי לְדָוִ֥ד עַבְדִּֽי׃
verses.en: I have made a covenant with My chosen, I have sworn unto David My servant:

verses.he: עַד ע֭וֹלָם אָכִ֣ין זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וּבָנִ֨יתִי לְדֹר וָד֖וֹר כִּסְאֲךָ֣ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: For ever will I establish thy seed, and build up thy throne to all generations.' Selah

verses.he: וְי֘וֹד֤וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם פִּלְאֲךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה אַף אֱ֝מֽוּנָתְךָ֗ בִּקְהַ֥ל קְדֹשִֽׁים׃
verses.en: So shall the heavens praise Thy wonders, O HaShem, Thy faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

verses.he: כִּ֤י מִ֣י בַ֭שַּׁחַק יַעֲרֹ֣ךְ לַיהוָ֑ה יִדְמֶ֥ה לַ֝יהוָ֗ה בִּבְנֵ֥י אֵלִים׃
verses.en: For who in the skies can be compared unto HaShem, who among the sons of might can be likened unto HaShem,

verses.he: אֵ֣ל נַ֭עֲרָץ בְּסוֹד קְדֹשִׁ֣ים רַבָּ֑ה וְ֝נוֹרָ֗א עַל כָּל סְבִיבָֽיו׃
verses.en: A G-d dreaded in the great council of the holy ones, and feared of all them that are about Him?

verses.he: יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צְבָא֗וֹת מִֽי כָֽמ֖וֹךָ חֲסִ֥ין יָ֑הּ וֶ֝אֱמֽוּנָתְךָ֗ סְבִיבוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: O HaShem G-d of hosts, who is a mighty one, like unto Thee, O HaShem? And Thy faithfulness is round about Thee.

verses.he: אַתָּ֣ה מ֭וֹשֵׁל בְּגֵא֣וּת הַיָּ֑ם בְּשׂ֥וֹא גַ֝לָּ֗יו אַתָּ֥ה תְשַׁבְּחֵֽם׃
verses.en: Thou rulest the proud swelling of the sea; when the waves thereof arise, Thou stillest them.

verses.he: אַתָּ֤ה דִכִּ֣אתָ כֶחָלָ֣ל רָ֑הַב בִּזְר֥וֹעַ עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ פִּזַּ֥רְתָּ אוֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Thou didst crush Rahab, as one that is slain; Thou didst scattered Thine enemies with the arm of Thy strength.

verses.he: לְךָ֣ שָׁ֭מַיִם אַף לְךָ֥ אָ֑רֶץ תֵּבֵ֥ל וּ֝מְלֹאָ֗הּ אַתָּ֥ה יְסַדְתָּֽם׃
verses.en: Thine are the heavens, Thine also the earth; the world and the fulness thereof, Thou hast founded them.

verses.he: צָפ֣וֹן וְ֭יָמִין אַתָּ֣ה בְרָאתָ֑ם תָּב֥וֹר וְ֝חֶרְמ֗וֹן בְּשִׁמְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.en: The north and the south, Thou hast created them; Tabor and Hermon rejoice in Thy name.

verses.he: לְךָ֣ זְ֭רוֹעַ עִם גְּבוּרָ֑ה תָּעֹ֥ז יָ֝דְךָ֗ תָּר֥וּם יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Thine is an arm with might; strong is Thy hand, and exalted is Thy right hand.

verses.he: צֶ֣דֶק וּ֭מִשְׁפָּט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֶ֑ךָ חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת יְֽקַדְּמ֥וּ פָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Thy throne; mercy and truth go before Thee.

verses.he: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭עָם יוֹדְעֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה בְּֽאוֹר פָּנֶ֥יךָ יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃
verses.en: Happy is the people that know the joyful shout; they walk, O HaShem, in the light of Thy countenance.

verses.he: בְּ֭שִׁמְךָ יְגִיל֣וּן כָּל הַיּ֑וֹם וּבְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יָרֽוּמוּ׃
verses.en: In Thy name do they rejoice all the day; and through Thy righteousness are they exalted.

verses.he: כִּֽי תִפְאֶ֣רֶת עֻזָּ֣מוֹ אָ֑תָּה וּ֝בִרְצֹנְךָ֗ תריםתריםתָּר֥וּםקַרְנֵֽנוּ׃
verses.en: For Thou art the glory of their strength; and in Thy favour our horn is exalted.

verses.he: כִּ֣י לַֽ֭יהוָה מָֽגִנֵּ֑נוּ וְלִקְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מַלְכֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.en: For of HaShem is our shield; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.

verses.he: אָ֤ז דִּבַּ֥רְתָּֽ בְחָ֡זוֹן לַֽחֲסִידֶ֗יךָ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר שִׁוִּ֣יתִי עֵ֭זֶר עַל גִּבּ֑וֹר הֲרִימ֖וֹתִי בָח֣וּר מֵעָֽם׃
verses.en: Then Thou spokest in vision to Thy godly ones, and saidst: 'I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

verses.he: מָ֭צָאתִי דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֑י בְּשֶׁ֖מֶן קָדְשִׁ֣י מְשַׁחְתִּֽיו׃
verses.en: I have found David My servant; with My holy oil have I anointed him;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָ֭דִי תִּכּ֣וֹן עִמּ֑וֹ אַף זְרוֹעִ֥י תְאַמְּצֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: With whom My hand shall be established; Mine arm also shall strengthen him.

verses.he: לֹֽא יַשִּׁ֣א אוֹיֵ֣ב בּ֑וֹ וּבֶן עַ֝וְלָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: The enemy shall not exact from him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

verses.he: וְכַתּוֹתִ֣י מִפָּנָ֣יו צָרָ֑יו וּמְשַׂנְאָ֥יו אֶגּֽוֹף׃
verses.en: And I will beat to pieces his adversaries before him, and smite them that hate him.

verses.he: וֶֽאֶֽמוּנָתִ֣י וְחַסְדִּ֣י עִמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בִשְׁמִ֗י תָּר֥וּם קַרְנֽוֹ׃
verses.en: But My faithfulness and My mercy shall be with him; and through My name shall his horn be exalted.

verses.he: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י בַיָּ֣ם יָד֑וֹ וּֽבַנְּהָר֥וֹת יְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.en: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

verses.he: ה֣וּא יִ֭קְרָאֵנִי אָ֣בִי אָ֑תָּה אֵ֝לִ֗י וְצ֣וּר יְשׁוּעָתִֽי׃
verses.en: He shall call unto Me: Thou art my Father, my G-d, and the rock of my salvation.

verses.he: אַף אָ֭נִי בְּכ֣וֹר אֶתְּנֵ֑הוּ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן לְמַלְכֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: I also will appoint him first-born, the highest of the kings of the earth.

verses.he: לְ֭עוֹלָ֗ם אשמוראשמוראֶשְׁמָר ל֣וֹ חַסְדִּ֑י וּ֝בְרִיתִ֗י נֶאֱמֶ֥נֶת לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: For ever will I keep for him My mercy, and My covenant shall stand fast with him.

verses.he: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י לָעַ֣ד זַרְע֑וֹ וְ֝כִסְא֗וֹ כִּימֵ֥י שָׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.en: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

verses.he: אִם יַֽעַזְב֣וּ בָ֭נָיו תּוֹרָתִ֑י וּ֝בְמִשְׁפָּטַ֗י לֹ֣א יֵלֵכֽוּן׃
verses.en: If his children forsake My law, and walk not in Mine ordinances;

verses.he: אִם חֻקֹּתַ֥י יְחַלֵּ֑לוּ וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י לֹ֣א יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ׃
verses.en: If they profane My statutes, and keep not My commandments;

verses.he: וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י בְשֵׁ֣בֶט פִּשְׁעָ֑ם וּבִנְגָעִ֥ים עֲוֺנָֽם׃
verses.en: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with strokes.

verses.he: וְ֭חַסְדִּי לֹֽא אָפִ֣יר מֵֽעִמּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא אֲ֝שַׁקֵּ֗ר בֶּאֱמוּנָתִֽי׃
verses.en: But My mercy will I not break off from him, nor will I be false to My faithfulness.

verses.he: לֹא אֲחַלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתִ֑י וּמוֹצָ֥א שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י לֹ֣א אֲשַׁנֶּֽה׃
verses.en: My covenant will I not profane, nor alter that which is gone out of My lips.

verses.he: אַ֭חַת נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי בְקָדְשִׁ֑י אִֽם לְדָוִ֥ד אֲכַזֵּֽב׃
verses.en: Once have I sworn by My holiness: Surely I will not be false unto David;

verses.he: זַ֭רְעוֹ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יִהְיֶ֑ה וְכִסְא֖וֹ כַשֶּׁ֣מֶשׁ נֶגְדִּֽי׃
verses.en: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before Me.

verses.he: כְּ֭יָרֵחַ יִכּ֣וֹן עוֹלָ֑ם וְעֵ֥ד בַּ֝שַּׁ֗חַק נֶאֱמָ֥ן סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: It shall be established for ever as the moon; and be stedfast as the witness in sky.' Selah

verses.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַתִּמְאָ֑ס הִ֝תְעַבַּ֗רְתָּ עִם מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: But Thou hast cast off and rejected, Thou hast been wroth with Thine anointed.

verses.he: נֵ֭אַרְתָּה בְּרִ֣ית עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ חִלַּ֖לְתָּ לָאָ֣רֶץ נִזְרֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Thou hast abhorred the covenant of Thy servant; Thou hast profaned his crown even to the ground.

verses.he: פָּרַ֥צְתָּ כָל גְּדֵרֹתָ֑יו שַׂ֖מְתָּ מִבְצָרָ֣יו מְחִתָּה׃
verses.en: Thou hast broken down all his fences; Thou hast brought his strongholds to ruin.

verses.he: שַׁ֭סֻּהוּ כָּל עֹ֣בְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ הָיָ֥ה חֶ֝רְפָּ֗ה לִשְׁכֵנָֽיו׃
verses.en: All that pass by the way spoil him; he is become a taunt to his neighbours.

verses.he: הֲ֭רִימוֹתָ יְמִ֣ין צָרָ֑יו הִ֝שְׂמַ֗חְתָּ כָּל אוֹיְבָֽיו׃
verses.en: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his adversaries; Thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

verses.he: אַף תָּ֭שִׁיב צ֣וּר חַרְבּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א הֲ֝קֵימֹת֗וֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.en: Yea, Thou turnest back the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

verses.he: הִשְׁבַּ֥תָּ מִטְּהָר֑וֹ וְ֝כִסְא֗וֹ לָאָ֥רֶץ מִגַּֽרְתָּה׃
verses.en: Thou hast made his brightness to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.

verses.he: הִ֭קְצַרְתָּ יְמֵ֣י עֲלוּמָ֑יו הֶֽעֱטִ֨יתָ עָלָ֖יו בּוּשָׁ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: The days of his youth hast Thou shortened; Thou hast covered him with shame. Selah

verses.he: עַד מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תִּסָּתֵ֣ר לָנֶ֑צַח תִּבְעַ֖ר כְּמוֹ אֵ֣שׁ חֲמָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: How long, O HaShem, wilt Thou hide Thyself for ever? How long shall Thy wrath burn like fire?

verses.he: זְכָר אֲנִ֥י מֶה חָ֑לֶד עַל מַה שָּׁ֝֗וְא בָּרָ֥אתָ כָל בְּנֵי אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: O remember how short my time is; for what vanity hast Thou created all the children of men!

verses.he: מִ֤י גֶ֣בֶר יִֽ֭חְיֶה וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֶה מָּ֑וֶת יְמַלֵּ֨ט נַפְשׁ֖וֹ מִיַּד שְׁא֣וֹל סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: What man is he that liveth and shall not see death, that shall deliver his soul from the power of the grave? Selah

verses.he: אַיֵּ֤ה חֲסָדֶ֖יךָ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֥ים אֲדֹנָ֑י נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לְ֝דָוִ֗ד בֶּאֱמוּנָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Where are Thy former mercies, O L-rd, which Thou didst swear unto David in Thy faithfulness?

verses.he: זְכֹ֣ר אֲ֭דֹנָי חֶרְפַּ֣ת עֲבָדֶ֑יךָ שְׂאֵתִ֥י בְ֝חֵיקִ֗י כָּל רַבִּ֥ים עַמִּֽים׃
verses.en: Remember, L-rd, the taunt of Thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the taunt of so many peoples;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר חֵרְפ֖וּ אוֹיְבֶ֥יךָ יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חֵ֝רְפ֗וּ עִקְּב֥וֹת מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Wherewith Thine enemies have taunted, O HaShem, wherewith they have taunted the footsteps of Thine anointed.

verses.he: בָּר֖וּךְ יְהוָ֥ה לְ֝עוֹלָ֗ם אָ֘מֵ֥ן וְאָמֵֽן׃
verses.en: Blessed be HaShem for evermore. Amen, and Amen. BOOK IV

verses.he: תְּפִלָּה֮ לְמֹשֶׁ֪ה אִֽישׁ הָאֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים אֲֽדֹנָ֗י מָע֣וֹן אַ֭תָּה הָיִ֥יתָ לָּ֗נוּ בְּדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.en: A Prayer of Moses the man of G-d. L-rd, Thou hast been our dwelling-place in all generations.

verses.he: בְּטֶ֤רֶם הָ֘רִ֤ים יֻלָּ֗דוּ וַתְּח֣וֹלֵֽל אֶ֣רֶץ וְתֵבֵ֑ל וּֽמֵעוֹלָ֥ם עַד ע֝וֹלָ֗ם אַתָּ֥ה אֵֽל׃
verses.en: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever Thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, Thou art G-d.

verses.he: תָּשֵׁ֣ב אֱ֭נוֹשׁ עַד דַּכָּ֑א וַ֝תֹּ֗אמֶר שׁ֣וּבוּ בְנֵי אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: Thou turnest man to contrition; and sayest: 'Return, ye children of men.'

verses.he: כִּ֤י אֶ֪לֶף שָׁנִ֡ים בְּֽעֵינֶ֗יךָ כְּי֣וֹם אֶ֭תְמוֹל כִּ֣י יַעֲבֹ֑ר וְאַשְׁמוּרָ֥ה בַלָּֽיְלָה׃
verses.en: For a thousand years in Thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.

verses.he: זְ֭רַמְתָּם שֵׁנָ֣ה יִהְי֑וּ בַּ֝בֹּ֗קֶר כֶּחָצִ֥יר יַחֲלֹֽף׃
verses.en: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep; in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

verses.he: בַּ֭בֹּקֶר יָצִ֣יץ וְחָלָ֑ף לָ֝עֶ֗רֶב יְמוֹלֵ֥ל וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃
verses.en: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

verses.he: כִּֽי כָלִ֥ינוּ בְאַפֶּ֑ךָ וּֽבַחֲמָתְךָ֥ נִבְהָֽלְנוּ׃
verses.en: For we are consumed in Thine anger, and by Thy wrath are we hurried away.

verses.he: שתשתשַׁתָּ֣העֲוֺנֹתֵ֣ינוּ לְנֶגְדֶּ֑ךָ עֲ֝לֻמֵ֗נוּ לִמְא֥וֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Thou hast set our iniquities before Thee, our secret sins in the light of Thy countenance.

verses.he: כִּ֣י כָל יָ֭מֵינוּ פָּנ֣וּ בְעֶבְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּלִּ֖ינוּ שָׁנֵ֣ינוּ כְמוֹ הֶֽגֶה׃
verses.en: For all our days are passed away in Thy wrath; we bring our years to an end as a tale that is told.

verses.he: יְמֵֽי שְׁנוֹתֵ֨ינוּ בָהֶ֥ם שִׁבְעִ֪ים שָׁנָ֡ה וְאִ֤ם בִּגְבוּרֹ֨ת שְׁמ֘וֹנִ֤ים שָׁנָ֗ה וְ֭רָהְבָּם עָמָ֣ל וָאָ֑וֶן כִּי גָ֥ז חִ֝֗ישׁ וַנָּעֻֽפָה׃
verses.en: The days of our years are threescore years and ten, or even by reason of strength fourscore years; yet is their pride but travail and vanity; for it is speedily gone, and we fly away.

verses.he: מִֽי י֭וֹדֵעַ עֹ֣ז אַפֶּ֑ךָ וּ֝כְיִרְאָתְךָ֗ עֶבְרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Who knoweth the power of Thine anger, and Thy wrath according to the fear that is due unto Thee?

verses.he: לִמְנ֣וֹת יָ֭מֵינוּ כֵּ֣ן הוֹדַ֑ע וְ֝נָבִ֗א לְבַ֣ב חָכְמָֽה׃
verses.en: So teach us to number our days, that we may get us a heart of wisdom.

verses.he: שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה עַד מָתָ֑י וְ֝הִנָּחֵ֗ם עַל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Return, O HaShem; how long? And let it repent Thee concerning Thy servants.

verses.he: שַׂבְּעֵ֣נוּ בַבֹּ֣קֶר חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וּֽנְרַנְּנָ֥ה וְ֝נִשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּכָל יָמֵֽינוּ׃
verses.en: O satisfy us in the morning with Thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

verses.he: שַׂ֭מְּחֵנוּ כִּימ֣וֹת עִנִּיתָ֑נוּ שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת רָאִ֥ינוּ רָעָֽה׃
verses.en: Make us glad according to the days wherein Thou hast afflicted us, according to the years wherein we have seen evil.

verses.he: יֵרָאֶ֣ה אֶל עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ פָעֳלֶ֑ךָ וַ֝הֲדָרְךָ֗ עַל בְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Let Thy work appear unto Thy servants, and Thy glory upon their children.

verses.he: וִיהִ֤י נֹ֤עַם אֲדֹנָ֥י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עָ֫לֵ֥ינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָ֭דֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָ֥ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דֵ֗ינוּ כּוֹנְנֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: And let the graciousness of the L-rd our G-d be upon us; establish Thou also upon us the work of our hands; yea, the work of our hands establish Thou it.

verses.he: יֹ֭שֵׁב בְּסֵ֣תֶר עֶלְי֑וֹן בְּצֵ֥ל שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְלוֹנָֽן׃
verses.en: O thou that dwellest in the covert of the Most High, and abidest in the shadow of the Almighty;

verses.he: אֹמַ֗ר לַֽ֭יהוָה מַחְסִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֑י אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֶבְטַח בּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: I will say of HaShem, who is my refuge and my fortress, my G-d, in whom I trust,

verses.he: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַ֭צִּֽילְךָ מִפַּ֥ח יָק֗וּשׁ מִדֶּ֥בֶר הַוּֽוֹת׃
verses.en: That He will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.

verses.he: בְּאֶבְרָת֨וֹ יָ֣סֶךְ לָ֭ךְ וְתַֽחַת כְּנָפָ֣יו תֶּחְסֶ֑ה צִנָּ֖ה וְֽסֹחֵרָ֣ה אֲמִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He will cover thee with His pinions, and under His wings shalt thou take refuge; His truth is a shield and a buckler.

verses.he: לֹא תִ֭ירָא מִפַּ֣חַד לָ֑יְלָה מֵ֝חֵ֗ץ יָע֥וּף יוֹמָֽם׃
verses.en: Thou shalt not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flieth by day;

verses.he: מִ֭דֶּבֶר בָּאֹ֣פֶל יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ מִ֝קֶּ֗טֶב יָשׁ֥וּד צָהֳרָֽיִם׃
verses.en: Of the pestilence that walketh in darkness, nor of the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

verses.he: יִפֹּ֤ל מִצִּדְּךָ֨ אֶ֗לֶף וּרְבָבָ֥ה מִימִינֶ֑ךָ אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִגָּֽשׁ׃
verses.en: A thousand may fall at Thy side, and ten thousand at Thy right hand; it shall not come nigh thee.

verses.he: רַ֭ק בְּעֵינֶ֣יךָ תַבִּ֑יט וְשִׁלֻּמַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.en: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, and see the recompense of the wicked.

verses.he: כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן שַׂ֣מְתָּ מְעוֹנֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: For thou hast made HaShem who is my refuge, even the Most High, thy habitation.

verses.he: לֹֽא תְאֻנֶּ֣ה אֵלֶ֣יךָ רָעָ֑ה וְ֝נֶ֗גַע לֹא יִקְרַ֥ב בְּאָהֳלֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.

verses.he: כִּ֣י מַ֭לְאָכָיו יְצַוֶּה לָּ֑ךְ לִ֝שְׁמָרְךָ֗ בְּכָל דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: For He will give His angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

verses.he: עַל כַּפַּ֥יִם יִשָּׂא֑וּנְךָ פֶּן תִּגֹּ֖ף בָּאֶ֣בֶן רַגְלֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: They shall bear thee upon their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

verses.he: עַל שַׁ֣חַל וָפֶ֣תֶן תִּדְרֹ֑ךְ תִּרְמֹ֖ס כְּפִ֣יר וְתַנִּֽין׃
verses.en: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and asp; the young lion and the serpent shalt thou trample under feet.

verses.he: כִּ֤י בִ֣י חָ֭שַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ אֲ֝שַׂגְּבֵ֗הוּ כִּֽי יָדַ֥ע שְׁמִֽי׃
verses.en: 'Because he hath set his love upon Me, therefore will I deliver him; I will set him on high, because he hath known My name.

verses.he: יִקְרָאֵ֨נִי וְֽאֶעֱנֵ֗הוּ עִמּֽוֹ אָנֹכִ֥י בְצָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלְּצֵ֗הוּ וַֽאֲכַבְּדֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: He shall call upon Me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble; I will rescue him, and bring him to honour.

verses.he: אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים אַשְׂבִּיעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝אַרְאֵ֗הוּ בִּֽישׁוּעָתִֽי׃
verses.en: With long life will I satisfy him, and make Him to behold My salvation.'

verses.he: מִזְמ֥וֹר שִׁ֗יר לְי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃
verses.en: A Psalm, a Song. For the sabbath day.

verses.he: ט֗וֹב לְהֹד֥וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה וּלְזַמֵּ֖ר לְשִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.en: It is a good thing to give thanks unto HaShem, and to sing praises unto Thy name, O Most High;

verses.he: לְהַגִּ֣יד בַּבֹּ֣קֶר חַסְֽדֶּ֑ךָ וֶ֝אֱמֽוּנָתְךָ֗ בַּלֵּילֽוֹת׃
verses.en: To declare Thy lovingkindness in the morning, and Thy faithfulness in the night seasons,

verses.he: עֲֽלֵי עָ֭שׂוֹר וַעֲלֵי נָ֑בֶל עֲלֵ֖י הִגָּי֣וֹן בְּכִנּֽוֹר׃
verses.en: With an instrument of ten strings, and with the psaltery; with a solemn sound upon the harp.

verses.he: כִּ֤י שִׂמַּחְתַּ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה בְּפָעֳלֶ֑ךָ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃
verses.en: For Thou, HaShem, hast made me glad through Thy work; I will exult in the works of Thy hands.

verses.he: מַה גָּדְל֣וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֣יךָ יְהוָ֑ה מְ֝אֹ֗ד עָמְק֥וּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: How great are Thy works, O HaShem! Thy thoughts are very deep.

verses.he: אִֽישׁ בַּ֭עַר לֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וּ֝כְסִ֗יל לֹא יָבִ֥ין אֶת זֹֽאת׃
verses.en: A brutish man knoweth not, neither doth a fool understand this.

verses.he: בִּפְרֹ֤חַ רְשָׁעִ֨ים כְּמ֥וֹ עֵ֗שֶׂב וַ֭יָּצִיצוּ כָּל פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן לְהִשָּֽׁמְדָ֥ם עֲדֵי עַֽד׃
verses.en: When the wicked spring up as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they may be destroyed for ever.

verses.he: וְאַתָּ֥ה מָר֗וֹם לְעֹלָ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: But Thou, O HaShem, art on high for evermore.

verses.he: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אֹיְבֶ֡יךָ יְֽהוָ֗ה כִּֽי הִנֵּ֣ה אֹיְבֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ יִ֝תְפָּרְד֗וּ כָּל פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: For, lo, Thine enemies, O HaShem, for, lo, Thine enemies shall perish: all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

verses.he: וַתָּ֣רֶם כִּרְאֵ֣ים קַרְנִ֑י בַּ֝לֹּתִ֗י בְּשֶׁ֣מֶן רַעֲנָֽן׃
verses.en: But my horn hast Thou exalted like the horn of the wild-ox; I am anointed with rich oil.

verses.he: וַתַּבֵּ֥ט עֵינִ֗י בְּשׁ֫וּרָ֥י בַּקָּמִ֖ים עָלַ֥י מְרֵעִ֗ים תִּשְׁמַ֥עְנָה אָזְנָֽי׃
verses.en: Mine eye also hath gazed on them that lie in wait for me, mine ears have heard my desire of the evil-doers that rise up against me.

verses.he: צַ֭דִּיק כַּתָּמָ֣ר יִפְרָ֑ח כְּאֶ֖רֶז בַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן יִשְׂגֶּֽה׃
verses.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree; he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

verses.he: שְׁ֭תוּלִים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּחַצְר֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ יַפְרִֽיחוּ׃
verses.en: Planted in the house of HaShem, they shall flourish in the courts of our G-d.

verses.he: ע֭וֹד יְנוּב֣וּן בְּשֵׂיבָ֑ה דְּשֵׁנִ֖ים וְרַֽעֲנַנִּ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.en: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be full of sap and richness;

verses.he: לְ֭הַגִּיד כִּֽי יָשָׁ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה צ֝וּרִ֗י וְֽלֹא עלתהעלתהעַוְלָ֥תָהבּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: To declare that HaShem is upright, my Rock, in whom there is no unrighteousness.

verses.he: יְהוָ֣ה מָלָךְ֮ גֵּא֪וּת לָ֫בֵ֥שׁ לָבֵ֣שׁ יְ֭הוָה עֹ֣ז הִתְאַזָּ֑ר אַף תִּכּ֥וֹן תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל בַּל תִּמּֽוֹט׃
verses.en: HaShem reigneth; He is clothed in majesty; HaShem is clothed, He hath girded Himself with strength; yea, the world is established, that it cannot be moved.

verses.he: נָכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֲךָ֣ מֵאָ֑ז מֵֽעוֹלָ֣ם אָֽתָּה׃
verses.en: Thy throne is established of old; Thou art from everlasting.

verses.he: נָשְׂא֤וּ נְהָר֨וֹת יְֽהוָ֗ה נָשְׂא֣וּ נְהָר֣וֹת קוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂא֖וּ נְהָר֣וֹת דָּכְיָֽם׃
verses.en: The floods have lifted up, O HaShem, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their roaring.

verses.he: מִקֹּל֨וֹת מַ֤יִם רַבִּ֗ים אַדִּירִ֣ים מִשְׁבְּרֵי יָ֑ם אַדִּ֖יר בַּמָּר֣וֹם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, HaShem on high is mighty.

verses.he: עֵֽדֹתֶ֨יךָ נֶאֶמְנ֬וּ מְאֹ֗ד לְבֵיתְךָ֥ נַאֲוָה קֹ֑דֶשׁ יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃
verses.en: Thy testimonies are very sure, holiness becometh Thy house, O HaShem, for evermore.

verses.he: אֵל נְקָמ֥וֹת יְהוָ֑ה אֵ֖ל נְקָמ֣וֹת הוֹפִֽיַע׃
verses.en: O HaShem, Thou G-d to whom vengeance belongeth, Thou G-d to whom vengeance belongeth, shine forth.

verses.he: הִ֭נָּשֵׂא שֹׁפֵ֣ט הָאָ֑רֶץ הָשֵׁ֥ב גְּ֝מ֗וּל עַל גֵּאִֽים׃
verses.en: Lift up Thyself, Thou Judge of the earth; render to the proud their recompense.

verses.he: עַד מָתַ֖י רְשָׁעִ֥ים יְהוָ֑ה עַד מָ֝תַ֗י רְשָׁעִ֥ים יַעֲלֹֽזוּ׃
verses.en: HaShem, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked exult?

verses.he: יַבִּ֣יעוּ יְדַבְּר֣וּ עָתָ֑ק יִֽ֝תְאַמְּר֗וּ כָּל פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: They gush out, they speak arrogancy; all the workers of iniquity bear themselves loftily.

verses.he: עַמְּךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה יְדַכְּא֑וּ וְֽנַחֲלָתְךָ֥ יְעַנּֽוּ׃
verses.en: They crush Thy people, O HaShem, and afflict Thy heritage.

verses.he: אַ֭לְמָנָה וְגֵ֣ר יַהֲרֹ֑גוּ וִֽיתוֹמִ֣ים יְרַצֵּֽחוּ׃
verses.en: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

verses.he: וַ֭יֹּ֣אמְרוּ לֹ֣א יִרְאֶה יָּ֑הּ וְלֹא יָ֝בִ֗ין אֱלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.en: And they say: 'The HaShem will not see, neither will the G-d of Jacob give heed.'

verses.he: בִּ֭ינוּ בֹּעֲרִ֣ים בָּעָ֑ם וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים מָתַ֥י תַּשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃
verses.en: Consider, ye brutish among the people; and ye fools, when will ye understand?

verses.he: הֲנֹ֣טַֽע אֹ֭זֶן הֲלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑ע אִֽם יֹ֥צֵֽר עַ֝֗יִן הֲלֹ֣א יַבִּֽיט׃
verses.en: He that planted the ear, shall He not hear? He that formed the eye, shall He not see?

verses.he: הֲיֹסֵ֣ר גּ֭וֹיִם הֲלֹ֣א יוֹכִ֑יחַ הַֽמְלַמֵּ֖ד אָדָ֣ם דָּֽעַת׃
verses.en: He that instructeth nations, shall not He correct? even He that teacheth man knowledge?

verses.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה יֹ֭דֵעַ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת אָדָ֑ם כִּי הֵ֥מָּה הָֽבֶל׃
verses.en: HaShem knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

verses.he: אַשְׁרֵ֤י הַגֶּ֣בֶר אֲשֶׁר תְּיַסְּרֶ֣נּוּ יָּ֑הּ וּֽמִתּוֹרָתְךָ֥ תְלַמְּדֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: Happy is the man whom Thou instructest, O HaShem, and teachest out of Thy law;

verses.he: לְהַשְׁקִ֣יט ל֭וֹ מִ֣ימֵי רָ֑ע עַ֤ד יִכָּרֶ֖ה לָרָשָׁ֣ע שָֽׁחַת׃
verses.en: That Thou mayest give him rest from the days of evil, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

verses.he: כִּ֤י לֹא יִטֹּ֣שׁ יְהוָ֣ה עַמּ֑וֹ וְ֝נַחֲלָת֗וֹ לֹ֣א יַעֲזֹֽב׃
verses.en: For HaShem will not cast off His people, neither will He forsake His inheritance.

verses.he: כִּֽי עַד צֶ֭דֶק יָשׁ֣וּב מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝אַחֲרָ֗יו כָּל יִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב׃
verses.en: For right shall return unto justice, and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

verses.he: מִֽי יָק֣וּם לִ֭י עִם מְרֵעִ֑ים מִֽי יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב לִ֝י עִם פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

verses.he: לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י כִּמְעַ֓ט שָֽׁכְנָ֖ה דוּמָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.en: Unless HaShem had been my help, my soul had soon dwelt in silence.

verses.he: אִם אָ֭מַרְתִּי מָ֣טָה רַגְלִ֑י חַסְדְּךָ֥ יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִסְעָדֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: If I say: 'My foot slippeth', Thy mercy, O HaShem, holdeth me up.

verses.he: בְּרֹ֣ב שַׂרְעַפַּ֣י בְּקִרְבִּ֑י תַּ֝נְחוּמֶ֗יךָ יְֽשַׁעַשְׁע֥וּ נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.en: When my cares are many within me, Thy comforts delight my soul.

verses.he: הַֽ֭יְחָבְרְךָ כִּסֵּ֣א הַוּ֑וֹת יֹצֵ֖ר עָמָ֣ל עֲלֵי חֹֽק׃
verses.en: Shall the seat of wickedness have fellowship with Thee, which frameth mischief by statute?

verses.he: יָ֭גוֹדּוּ עַל נֶ֣פֶשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וְדָ֖ם נָקִ֣י יַרְשִֽׁיעוּ׃
verses.en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn innocent blood.

verses.he: וַיְהִ֬י יְהוָ֣ה לִ֣י לְמִשְׂגָּ֑ב וֵ֝אלֹהַ֗י לְצ֣וּר מַחְסִֽי׃
verses.en: But HaShem hath been my high tower, and my G-d the rock of my refuge.

verses.he: וַיָּ֤שֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶ֨ם אֶת אוֹנָ֗ם וּבְרָעָתָ֥ם יַצְמִיתֵ֑ם יַ֝צְמִיתֵ֗ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.en: And He hath brought upon them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own evil; HaShem our G-d will cut them off.

verses.he: לְ֭כוּ נְרַנְּנָ֣ה לַיהוָ֑ה נָ֝רִ֗יעָה לְצ֣וּר יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ׃
verses.en: O come, let us sing unto HaShem; let us shout for joy to the Rock of our salvation.

verses.he: נְקַדְּמָ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּתוֹדָ֑ה בִּ֝זְמִר֗וֹת נָרִ֥יעַֽ לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Let us come before His presence with thanksgiving, let us shout for joy unto Him with psalms.

verses.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ל גָּד֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וּמֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝ד֗וֹל עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.en: For HaShem is a great G-d, and a great King above all gods;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭יָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְתוֹעֲפ֖וֹת הָרִ֣ים לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: In whose hand are the depths of the earth; the heights of the mountains are His also.

verses.he: אֲשֶׁר ל֣וֹ הַ֭יָּם וְה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑הוּ וְ֝יַבֶּ֗שֶׁת יָדָ֥יו יָצָֽרוּ׃
verses.en: The sea is His, and He made it; and His hands formed the dry land.

verses.he: בֹּ֭אוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֣ה וְנִכְרָ֑עָה נִ֝בְרְכָ֗ה לִֽפְנֵי יְהוָ֥ה עֹשֵֽׂנוּ׃
verses.en: O come, let us bow down and bend the knee; let us kneel before HaShem our Maker;

verses.he: כִּ֘י ה֤וּא אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַ֣ם מַ֭רְעִיתוֹ וְצֹ֣אן יָד֑וֹ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אִֽם בְּקֹל֥וֹ תִשְׁמָֽעוּ׃
verses.en: For He is our G-d, and we are the people of His pasture, and the flock of His hand. To-day, if ye would but hearken to His voice!

verses.he: אַל תַּקְשׁ֣וּ לְ֭בַבְכֶם כִּמְרִיבָ֑ה כְּי֥וֹם מַ֝סָּ֗ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.en: 'Harden not your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֭סּוּנִי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּ֝חָנ֗וּנִי גַּם רָא֥וּ פָעֳלִֽי׃
verses.en: When your fathers tried Me, proved Me, even though they saw My work.

verses.he: אַרְבָּ֘עִ֤ים שָׁנָ֨ה אָ֘ק֤וּט בְּד֗וֹר וָאֹמַ֗ר עַ֤ם תֹּעֵ֣י לֵבָ֣ב הֵ֑ם וְ֝הֵ֗ם לֹא יָדְע֥וּ דְרָכָֽי׃
verses.en: For forty years was I wearied with that generation, and said: It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known My ways;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי בְאַפִּ֑י אִם יְ֝בֹא֗וּן אֶל מְנוּחָתִֽי׃
verses.en: Wherefore I swore in My wrath, that they should not enter into My rest.'

verses.he: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ שִׁ֥ירוּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: O sing unto HaShem a new song; sing unto HaShem, all the earth.

verses.he: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה בָּרֲכ֣וּ שְׁמ֑וֹ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם לְ֝י֗וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Sing unto HaShem, bless His name; proclaim His salvation from day to day.

verses.he: סַפְּר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֣ם כְּבוֹד֑וֹ בְּכָל הָֽ֝עַמִּ֗ים נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.en: Declare His glory among the nations, His marvellous works among all the peoples.

verses.he: כִּ֥י גָ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד נוֹרָ֥א ה֝֗וּא עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.en: For great is HaShem, and highly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.

verses.he: כִּ֤י כָּל אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָעַמִּ֣ים אֱלִילִ֑ים וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.en: For all the gods of the peoples are things of nought; but HaShem made the heavens.

verses.he: הוֹד וְהָדָ֥ר לְפָנָ֑יו עֹ֥ז וְ֝תִפְאֶ֗רֶת בְּמִקְדָּשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: Honour and majesty are before Him; strength and beauty are in His sanctuary.

verses.he: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃
verses.en: Ascribe unto HaShem, ye kindreds of the peoples, ascribe unto HaShem glory and strength.

verses.he: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂאֽוּ מִ֝נְחָ֗ה וּבֹ֥אוּ לְחַצְרוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.en: Ascribe unto HaShem the glory due unto His name; bring an offering, and come into His courts.

verses.he: הִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה בְּהַדְרַת קֹ֑דֶשׁ חִ֥ילוּ מִ֝פָּנָ֗יו כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: O worship HaShem in the beauty of holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth.

verses.he: אִמְר֤וּ בַגּוֹיִ֨ם יְה֘וָ֤ה מָלָ֗ךְ אַף תִּכּ֣וֹן תֵּ֭בֵל בַּל תִּמּ֑וֹט יָדִ֥ין עַ֝מִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.en: Say among the nations: 'The HaShem reigneth.' The world also is established that it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.

verses.he: יִשְׂמְח֣וּ הַ֭שָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִֽרְעַ֥ם הַ֝יָּ֗ם וּמְלֹאֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;

verses.he: יַעֲלֹ֣ז שָׂ֭דַי וְכָל אֲשֶׁר בּ֑וֹ אָ֥ז יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ כָּל עֲצֵי יָֽעַר׃
verses.en: Let the field exult; and all that is therein; then shall all the trees of the wood sing for joy;

verses.he: לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָ֨ה כִּ֬י בָ֗א כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בֶּאֱמוּנָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Before HaShem, for He is come; for He is come to judge the earth; He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples in His faithfulness.

verses.he: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ תָּגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִ֝שְׂמְח֗וּ אִיִּ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃
verses.en: HaShem reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad.

verses.he: עָנָ֣ן וַעֲרָפֶ֣ל סְבִיבָ֑יו צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Clouds and darkness are round about Him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of His throne.

verses.he: אֵ֭שׁ לְפָנָ֣יו תֵּלֵ֑ךְ וּתְלַהֵ֖ט סָבִ֣יב צָרָֽיו׃
verses.en: A fire goeth before Him, and burneth up His adversaries round about.

verses.he: הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקָ֣יו תֵּבֵ֑ל רָאֲתָ֖ה וַתָּחֵ֣ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: His lightnings lighted up the world; the earth saw, and trembled.

verses.he: הָרִ֗ים כַּדּוֹנַ֗ג נָ֭מַסּוּ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֲד֣וֹן כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of HaShem, at the presence of the L-rd of the whole earth.

verses.he: הִגִּ֣ידוּ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם צִדְק֑וֹ וְרָא֖וּ כָל הָעַמִּ֣ים כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The heavens declared His righteousness, and all the peoples saw His glory.

verses.he: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ כָּל עֹ֬בְדֵי פֶ֗סֶל הַמִּֽתְהַלְלִ֥ים בָּאֱלִילִ֑ים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ ל֝וֹ כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.en: Ashamed be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of things of nought; bow down to Him, all ye gods.

verses.he: שָׁמְעָ֬ה וַתִּשְׂמַ֨ח צִיּ֗וֹן וַ֭תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְמַ֖עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Zion heard and was glad, and the daughters of Judah rejoiced; because of Thy judgments, O HaShem.

verses.he: כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה עֶלְי֥וֹן עַל כָּל הָאָ֑רֶץ מְאֹ֥ד נַ֝עֲלֵ֗יתָ עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.en: For Thou, HaShem, art most high above all the earth; Thou art exalted far above all gods.

verses.he: אֹהֲבֵ֥י יְהוָ֗ה שִׂנְא֫וּ רָ֥ע שֹׁ֭מֵר נַפְשׁ֣וֹת חֲסִידָ֑יו מִיַּ֥ד רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽם׃
verses.en: O ye that love HaShem, hate evil; He preserveth the souls of His saints; He delivered them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.he: א֭וֹר זָרֻ֣עַ לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּֽלְיִשְׁרֵי לֵ֥ב שִׂמְחָֽה׃
verses.en: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

verses.he: שִׂמְח֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהוָ֑ה וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: Be glad in HaShem, ye righteous; and give thanks to His holy name.

verses.he: מִזְמ֡וֹר שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָ֨ה שִׁ֣יר חָ֭דָשׁ כִּֽי נִפְלָא֣וֹת עָשָׂ֑ה הוֹשִֽׁיעָה לּ֥וֹ יְ֝מִינ֗וֹ וּזְר֥וֹעַ קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: A Psalm. O sing unto HaShem a new song; for He hath done marvellous things; His right hand, and His holy arm, hath wrought salvation for Him.

verses.he: הוֹדִ֣יעַ יְ֭הוָה יְשׁוּעָת֑וֹ לְעֵינֵ֥י הַ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם גִּלָּ֥ה צִדְקָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: HaShem hath made known His salvation; His righteousness hath He revealed in the sight of the nations.

verses.he: זָ֘כַ֤ר חַסְדּ֨וֹ וֶֽאֱֽמוּנָתוֹ֮ לְבֵ֪ית יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל רָא֥וּ כָל אַפְסֵי אָ֑רֶץ אֵ֝֗ת יְשׁוּעַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.en: He hath remembered His mercy and His faithfulness toward the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our G-d.

verses.he: הָרִ֣יעוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה כָּל הָאָ֑רֶץ פִּצְח֖וּ וְרַנְּנ֣וּ וְזַמֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.en: Shout unto HaShem, all the earth; break forth and sing for joy, yea, sing praises.

verses.he: זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּ֝כִנּ֗וֹר וְק֣וֹל זִמְרָֽה׃
verses.en: Sing praises unto HaShem with the harp; with the harp and the voice of melody.

verses.he: בַּ֭חֲצֹ֣צְרוֹת וְק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָ֑ר הָ֝רִ֗יעוּ לִפְנֵ֤י הַמֶּ֬לֶךְ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: With trumpets and sound of the horn shout ye before the King, HaShem.

verses.he: יִרְעַ֣ם הַ֭יָּם וּמְלֹא֑וֹ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein;

verses.he: נְהָר֥וֹת יִמְחֲאוּ כָ֑ף יַ֝֗חַד הָרִ֥ים יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.en: Let the floods clap their hands; let the mountains sing for joy together;

verses.he: לִֽפְֽנֵי יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.en: Before HaShem, for He is come to judge the earth; He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.

verses.he: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ יִרְגְּז֣וּ עַמִּ֑ים יֹשֵׁ֥ב כְּ֝רוּבִ֗ים תָּנ֥וּט הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: HaShem reigneth; let the peoples tremble; He is enthroned upon the cherubim; let the earth quake.

verses.he: יְ֭הוָה בְּצִיּ֣וֹן גָּד֑וֹל וְרָ֥ם ה֝֗וּא עַל כָּל הָֽעַמִּֽים׃
verses.en: HaShem is great in Zion; and He is high above all the peoples.

verses.he: יוֹד֣וּ שִׁ֭מְךָ גָּד֥וֹל וְנוֹרָ֗א קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא׃
verses.en: Let them praise Thy name as great and awful; Holy is He.

verses.he: וְעֹ֥ז מֶלֶךְ֮ מִשְׁפָּ֪ט אָ֫הֵ֥ב אַ֭תָּה כּוֹנַ֣נְתָּ מֵישָׁרִ֑ים מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה בְּיַעֲקֹ֤ב אַתָּ֬ה עָשִֽׂיתָ׃
verses.en: The strength also of the king who loveth justice--Thou hast established equity, Thou hast executed justice and righteousness in Jacob.

verses.he: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽ֭הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָ֗יו קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא׃
verses.en: Exalt ye HaShem our G-d, and prostrate yourselves at His footstool; Holy is He.

verses.he: מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹ֨ן בְּֽכֹהֲנָ֗יו וּ֭שְׁמוּאֵל בְּקֹרְאֵ֣י שְׁמ֑וֹ קֹרִ֥אים אֶל יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְה֣וּא יַעֲנֵֽם׃
verses.en: Moses and Aaron among His priests, and Samuel among them that call upon His name, did call upon HaShem, and He answered them.

verses.he: בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָ֭נָן יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם שָׁמְר֥וּ עֵ֝דֹתָ֗יו וְחֹ֣ק נָֽתַן לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: He spoke unto them in the pillar of cloud; they kept His testimonies, and the statute that He gave them.

verses.he: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵינוּ֮ אַתָּ֪ה עֲנִ֫יתָ֥ם אֵ֣ל נֹ֭שֵׂא הָיִ֣יתָ לָהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹקֵ֗ם עַל עֲלִילוֹתָֽם׃
verses.en: O HaShem our G-d, Thou didst answer them; a forgiving G-d wast Thou unto them, though Thou tookest vengeance of their misdeeds.

verses.he: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְ֭הִֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑וֹ כִּֽי קָ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.en: Exalt ye HaShem our G-d, and worship at His holy hill; for HaShem our G-d is holy.

verses.he: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְתוֹדָ֑ה הָרִ֥יעוּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout unto HaShem, all the earth.

verses.he: עִבְד֣וּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה בְּשִׂמְחָ֑ה בֹּ֥אוּ לְ֝פָנָ֗יו בִּרְנָנָֽה׃
verses.en: Serve HaShem with gladness; come before His presence with singing.

verses.he: דְּע֗וּ כִּֽי יְהוָה֮ ה֤וּא אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים הֽוּא עָ֭שָׂנוּ ולאולאוְל֣וֹאֲנַ֑חְנוּ עַ֝מּ֗וֹ וְצֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Know ye that HaShem He is G-d; it is He that hath made us, and we our His, His people, and the flock of His pasture.

verses.he: בֹּ֤אוּ שְׁעָרָ֨יו בְּתוֹדָ֗ה חֲצֵרֹתָ֥יו בִּתְהִלָּ֑ה הֽוֹדוּ ל֝֗וֹ בָּרֲכ֥וּ שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Enter into His gates with thanksgiving, and into His courts with praise; give thanks unto Him, and bless His name.

verses.he: כִּי ט֣וֹב יְ֭הֹוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְעַד דֹּ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֱמוּנָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: For HaShem is good; His mercy endureth for ever; and His faithfulness unto all generations.

verses.he: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר חֶֽסֶד וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃
verses.en: A Psalm of David. I will sing of mercy and justice; unto Thee, O HaShem, will I sing praises.

verses.he: אַשְׂכִּ֤ילָה בְּדֶ֬רֶךְ תָּמִ֗ים מָ֭תַי תָּב֣וֹא אֵלָ֑י אֶתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּתָם לְ֝בָבִ֗י בְּקֶ֣רֶב בֵּיתִֽי׃
verses.en: I will give heed unto the way of integrity; oh when wilt Thou come unto me? I will walk within my house in the integrity of my heart.

verses.he: לֹֽא אָשִׁ֨ית לְנֶ֥גֶד עֵינַ֗י דְּֽבַר בְּלִ֫יָּ֥עַל עֲשֹֽׂה סֵטִ֥ים שָׂנֵ֑אתִי לֹ֖א יִדְבַּ֣ק בִּֽי׃
verses.en: I will set no base thing before mine eyes; I hate the doing of things crooked; it shall not cleave unto me.

verses.he: לֵבָ֣ב עִ֭קֵּשׁ יָס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נִּי רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א אֵדָֽע׃
verses.en: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know no evil thing.

verses.he: מלושנימלושנימְלָשְׁנִ֬יבַסֵּ֨תֶר רֵעֵהוּ֮ אוֹת֪וֹ אַ֫צְמִ֥ית גְּֽבַהּ עֵ֭ינַיִם וּרְחַ֣ב לֵבָ֑ב אֹ֝ת֗וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל׃
verses.en: Whoso slandereth his neighbour in secret, him will I destroy; whoso is haughty of eye and proud of heart, him will I not suffer.

verses.he: עֵינַ֤י בְּנֶֽאֶמְנֵי אֶרֶץ֮ לָשֶׁ֪בֶת עִמָּ֫דִ֥י הֹ֭לֵךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ תָּמִ֑ים ה֝֗וּא יְשָׁרְתֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Mine eyes are upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he that walketh in a way of integrity, he shall minister unto me.

verses.he: לֹֽא יֵשֵׁ֨ב בְּקֶ֥רֶב בֵּיתִי֮ עֹשֵׂ֪ה רְמִ֫יָּ֥ה דֹּבֵ֥ר שְׁקָרִ֑ים לֹֽא יִ֝כּ֗וֹן לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽי׃
verses.en: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house; he that speaketh falsehood shall not be established before mine eyes.

verses.he: לַבְּקָרִ֗ים אַצְמִ֥ית כָּל רִשְׁעֵי אָ֑רֶץ לְהַכְרִ֥ית מֵֽעִיר יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: Morning by morning will I destroy all the wicked of the land; to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the city of HaShem.

verses.he: תְּ֭פִלָּה לְעָנִ֣י כִֽי יַעֲטֹ֑ף וְלִפְנֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ שִׂיחֽוֹ׃
verses.en: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he fainteth, and poureth out his complaint before HaShem.

verses.he: יְ֭הוָה שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י אֵלֶ֥יךָ תָבֽוֹא׃
verses.en: O HaShem, hear my prayer, and let my cry come unto Thee.

verses.he: אַל תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ מִמֶּנִּי֮ בְּי֪וֹם צַ֫ר לִ֥י הַטֵּֽה אֵלַ֥י אָזְנֶ֑ךָ בְּי֥וֹם אֶ֝קְרָ֗א מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Hide not Thy face from me in the day of my distress; incline Thine ear unto me; in the day when I call answer me speedily.

verses.he: כִּֽי כָל֣וּ בְעָשָׁ֣ן יָמָ֑י וְ֝עַצְמוֹתַ֗י כְּמוֹ קֵ֥ד נִחָֽרוּ׃
verses.en: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as a hearth.

verses.he: הוּכָּֽה כָ֭עֵשֶׂב וַיִּבַ֣שׁ לִבִּ֑י כִּֽי שָׁ֝כַ֗חְתִּי מֵאֲכֹ֥ל לַחְמִֽי׃
verses.en: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; for I forget to eat my bread.
