verses.he: מִקּ֥וֹל אַנְחָתִ֑י דָּבְקָ֥ה עַ֝צְמִ֗י לִבְשָׂרִֽי׃
verses.en: By reason of the voice of my sighing my bones cleave to my flesh.

verses.he: דָּ֭מִיתִי לִקְאַ֣ת מִדְבָּ֑ר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּכ֣וֹס חֳרָבֽוֹת׃
verses.en: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am become as an owl of the waste places.

verses.he: שָׁקַ֥דְתִּי וָאֶֽהְיֶ֑ה כְּ֝צִפּ֗וֹר בּוֹדֵ֥ד עַל גָּֽג׃
verses.en: I watch, and am become like a sparrow that is alone upon the housetop.

verses.he: כָּל הַ֭יּוֹם חֵרְפ֣וּנִי אוֹיְבָ֑י מְ֝הוֹלָלַ֗י בִּ֣י נִשְׁבָּֽעוּ׃
verses.en: Mine enemies taunt me all the day; they that are mad against me do curse by me.

verses.he: כִּי אֵ֭פֶר כַּלֶּ֣חֶם אָכָ֑לְתִּי וְ֝שִׁקֻּוַ֗י בִּבְכִ֥י מָסָֽכְתִּי׃
verses.en: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

verses.he: מִפְּנֵֽי זַֽעַמְךָ֥ וְקִצְפֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י נְ֝שָׂאתַ֗נִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Because of Thine indignation and Thy wrath; for Thou hast taken me up, and cast me away.

verses.he: יָ֭מַי כְּצֵ֣ל נָט֑וּי וַ֝אֲנִ֗י כָּעֵ֥שֶׂב אִיבָֽשׁ׃
verses.en: My days are like a lengthening shadow; and I am withered like grass.

verses.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֑ב וְ֝זִכְרְךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.en: But Thou, O HaShem, sittest enthroned for ever; and Thy name is unto all generations.

verses.he: אַתָּ֣ה תָ֭קוּם תְּרַחֵ֣ם צִיּ֑וֹן כִּי עֵ֥ת לְ֝חֶֽנְנָ֗הּ כִּי בָ֥א מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.en: Thou wilt arise, and have compassion upon Zion; for it is time to be gracious unto her, for the appointed time is come.

verses.he: כִּֽי רָצ֣וּ עֲ֭בָדֶיךָ אֶת אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְֽאֶת עֲפָרָ֥הּ יְחֹנֵֽנוּ׃
verses.en: For Thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and love her dust.

verses.he: וְיִֽירְא֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם אֶת שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וְֽכָל מַלְכֵ֥י הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ אֶת כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: So the nations will fear the name of HaShem, and all the kings of the earth Thy glory;

verses.he: כִּֽי בָנָ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה צִיּ֑וֹן נִ֝רְאָ֗ה בִּכְבוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.en: When HaShem hath built up Zion, when He hath appeared in His glory;

verses.he: פָּ֭נָה אֶל תְּפִלַּ֣ת הָעַרְעָ֑ר וְלֹֽא בָ֝זָ֗ה אֶת תְּפִלָּתָֽם׃
verses.en: When He hath regarded the prayer of the destitute, and hath not despised their prayer.

verses.he: תִּכָּ֣תֶב זֹ֭את לְד֣וֹר אַחֲר֑וֹן וְעַ֥ם נִ֝בְרָ֗א יְהַלֶּל יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: This shall be written for the generation to come; and a people which shall be created shall praise HaShem.

verses.he: כִּֽי הִ֭שְׁקִיף מִמְּר֣וֹם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַ֤יִם אֶל אֶ֬רֶץ הִבִּֽיט׃
verses.en: For He hath looked down from the height of His sanctuary; from heaven did HaShem behold the earth;

verses.he: לִ֭שְׁמֹעַ אֶנְקַ֣ת אָסִ֑יר לְ֝פַתֵּ֗חַ בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה׃
verses.en: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;

verses.he: לְסַפֵּ֣ר בְּ֭צִיּוֹן שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝תְהִלָּת֗וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.en: That men may tell of the name of HaShem in Zion, and His praise in Jerusalem;

verses.he: בְּהִקָּבֵ֣ץ עַמִּ֣ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וּ֝מַמְלָכ֗וֹת לַעֲבֹ֥ד אֶת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: When the peoples are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve HaShem.

verses.he: עִנָּ֖ה בַדֶּ֥רֶךְ כחוכחוכֹּחִ֗יקִצַּ֥ר יָמָֽי׃
verses.en: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.

verses.he: אֹמַ֗ר אֵלִ֗י אַֽל תַּ֭עֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִ֣י יָמָ֑י בְּד֖וֹר דּוֹרִ֣ים שְׁנוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: I say: 'O my G-d, take me not away in the midst of my days, Thou whose years endure throughout all generations.

verses.he: לְ֭פָנִים הָאָ֣רֶץ יָסַ֑דְתָּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ שָׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.en: Of old Thou didst lay the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the work of Thy hands.

verses.he: הֵ֤מָּה יֹאבֵדוּ֮ וְאַתָּ֪ה תַ֫עֲמֹ֥ד וְ֭כֻלָּם כַּבֶּ֣גֶד יִבְל֑וּ כַּלְּב֖וּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵ֣ם וְֽיַחֲלֹֽפוּ׃
verses.en: They shall perish, but Thou shalt endure; yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt Thou change them, and they shall pass away;

verses.he: וְאַתָּה ה֑וּא וּ֝שְׁנוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִתָּֽמּוּ׃
verses.en: But Thou art the selfsame, and Thy years shall have no end.

verses.he: בְּנֵֽי עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ יִשְׁכּ֑וֹנוּ וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם לְפָנֶ֥יךָ יִכּֽוֹן׃
verses.en: The children of Thy servants shall dwell securely, and their seed shall be established before Thee.'

verses.he: לְדָוִ֨ד בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וְכָל קְ֝רָבַ֗י אֶת שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: A Psalm of David. Bless HaShem, O my soul; and all that is within me, bless His holy name.

verses.he: בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וְאַל תִּ֝שְׁכְּחִ֗י כָּל גְּמוּלָֽיו׃
verses.en: Bless HaShem, O my soul, and forget not all His benefits;

verses.he: הַסֹּלֵ֥חַ לְכָל עֲוֺנֵ֑כִי הָ֝רֹפֵ֗א לְכָל תַּחֲלֻאָֽיְכִי׃
verses.en: Who forgiveth all thine iniquity; who healeth all Thy diseases;

verses.he: הַגּוֹאֵ֣ל מִשַּׁ֣חַת חַיָּ֑יְכִי הַֽ֝מְעַטְּרֵ֗כִי חֶ֣סֶד וְרַחֲמִֽים׃
verses.en: Who redeemeth Thy life from the pit; who encompasseth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

verses.he: הַמַּשְׂבִּ֣יַע בַּטּ֣וֹב עֶדְיֵ֑ךְ תִּתְחַדֵּ֖שׁ כַּנֶּ֣שֶׁר נְעוּרָֽיְכִי׃
verses.en: Who satisfieth thine old age with good things; so that Thy youth is renewed like the eagle.

verses.he: עֹשֵׂ֣ה צְדָק֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטִ֗ים לְכָל עֲשׁוּקִֽים׃
verses.en: HaShem executeth righteousness, and acts of justice for all that are oppressed.

verses.he: יוֹדִ֣יעַ דְּרָכָ֣יו לְמֹשֶׁ֑ה לִבְנֵ֥י יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֲלִילֽוֹתָיו׃
verses.en: He made known His ways unto Moses, His doings unto the children of Israel.

verses.he: רַח֣וּם וְחַנּ֣וּן יְהוָ֑ה אֶ֖רֶךְ אַפַּ֣יִם וְרַב חָֽסֶד׃
verses.en: HaShem is full of compassion and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

verses.he: לֹֽא לָנֶ֥צַח יָרִ֑יב וְלֹ֖א לְעוֹלָ֣ם יִטּֽוֹר׃
verses.en: He will not always contend; neither will He keep His anger for ever.

verses.he: לֹ֣א כַ֭חֲטָאֵינוּ עָ֣שָׂה לָ֑נוּ וְלֹ֥א כַ֝עֲוֺנֹתֵ֗ינוּ גָּמַ֥ל עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.en: He hath not dealt with us after our sins, nor requited us according to our iniquities.

verses.he: כִּ֤י כִגְבֹ֣הַּ שָׁ֭מַיִם עַל הָאָ֑רֶץ גָּבַ֥ר חַ֝סְדּ֗וֹ עַל יְרֵאָֽיו׃
verses.en: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is His mercy toward them that fear Him.

verses.he: כִּרְחֹ֣ק מִ֭זְרָח מִֽמַּֽעֲרָ֑ב הִֽרְחִ֥יק מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ אֶת פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ׃
verses.en: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath He removed our transgressions from us.

verses.he: כְּרַחֵ֣ם אָ֭ב עַל בָּנִ֑ים רִחַ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַל יְרֵאָֽיו׃
verses.en: Like as a father hath compassion upon his children, so hath HaShem compassion upon them that fear Him.

verses.he: כִּי ה֖וּא יָדַ֣ע יִצְרֵ֑נוּ זָ֝כ֗וּר כִּי עָפָ֥ר אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃
verses.en: For He knoweth our frame; He remembereth that we are dust.

verses.he: אֱ֭נוֹשׁ כֶּחָצִ֣יר יָמָ֑יו כְּצִ֥יץ הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה כֵּ֣ן יָצִֽיץ׃
verses.en: As for man, his days are as grass; as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

verses.he: כִּ֤י ר֣וּחַ עָֽבְרָה בּ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וְלֹא יַכִּירֶ֖נּוּ ע֣וֹד מְקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof knoweth it no more.

verses.he: וְחֶ֤סֶד יְהוָ֨ה מֵעוֹלָ֣ם וְעַד ע֭וֹלָם עַל יְרֵאָ֑יו וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ לִבְנֵ֥י בָנִֽים׃
verses.en: But the mercy of HaShem is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear Him, and His righteousness unto children's children;

verses.he: לְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י בְרִית֑וֹ וּלְזֹכְרֵ֥י פִ֝קֻּדָ֗יו לַעֲשׂוֹתָֽם׃
verses.en: To such as keep His covenant, and to those that remember His precepts to do them.

verses.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה בַּ֭שָּׁמַיִם הֵכִ֣ין כִּסְא֑וֹ וּ֝מַלְכוּת֗וֹ בַּכֹּ֥ל מָשָֽׁלָה׃
verses.en: HaShem hath established His throne in the heavens; and His kingdom ruleth over all.

verses.he: בָּרֲכ֥וּ יְהוָ֗ה מַלְאָ֫כָ֥יו גִּבֹּ֣רֵי כֹ֭חַ עֹשֵׂ֣י דְבָר֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗עַ בְּק֣וֹל דְּבָרֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Bless HaShem, ye angels of His, ye mighty in strength, that fulfil His word, hearkening unto the voice of His word.

verses.he: בָּרֲכ֣וּ יְ֭הוָה כָּל צְבָאָ֑יו מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו עֹשֵׂ֥י רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Bless HaShem, all ye His hosts; ye ministers of His, that do His pleasure.

verses.he: בָּרֲכ֤וּ יְהוָ֨ה כָּֽל מַעֲשָׂ֗יו בְּכָל מְקֹמ֥וֹת מֶמְשַׁלְתּ֑וֹ בָּרֲכִ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י אֶת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Bless HaShem, all ye His works, in all places of His dominion; bless HaShem, O my soul.

verses.he: בָּרֲכִ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗י אֶת יְה֫וָ֥ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי גָּדַ֣לְתָּ מְּאֹ֑ד ה֭וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר לָבָֽשְׁתָּ׃
verses.en: Bless HaShem, O my soul. O HaShem my G-d, Thou art very great; Thou art clothed with glory and majesty.

verses.he: עֹֽטֶה א֭וֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָ֑ה נוֹטֶ֥ה שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם כַּיְרִיעָֽה׃
verses.en: Who coverest Thyself with light as with a garment, who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain;

verses.he: הַ֥מְקָרֶֽה בַמַּ֗יִם עֲֽלִיּ֫וֹתָ֥יו הַשָּׂם עָבִ֥ים רְכוּב֑וֹ הַֽ֝מְהַלֵּ֗ךְ עַל כַּנְפֵי רֽוּחַ׃
verses.en: Who layest the beams of Thine upper chambers in the waters, who makest the clouds Thy chariot, who walkest upon the wings of the wind;

verses.he: עֹשֶׂ֣ה מַלְאָכָ֣יו רוּח֑וֹת מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו אֵ֣שׁ לֹהֵֽט׃
verses.en: Who makest winds Thy messengers, the flaming fire Thy ministers.

verses.he: יָֽסַד אֶ֭רֶץ עַל מְכוֹנֶ֑יהָ בַּל תִּ֝מּ֗וֹט עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.en: Who didst establish the earth upon its foundations, that it should not be moved for ever and ever;

verses.he: תְּ֭הוֹם כַּלְּב֣וּשׁ כִּסִּית֑וֹ עַל הָ֝רִ֗ים יַֽעַמְדוּ מָֽיִם׃
verses.en: Thou didst cover it with the deep as with a vesture; the waters stood above the mountains.

verses.he: מִן גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְנוּס֑וּן מִן ק֥וֹל רַֽ֝עַמְךָ֗ יֵחָפֵזֽוּן׃
verses.en: At Thy rebuke they fled, at the voice of Thy thunder they hasted away--

verses.he: יַעֲל֣וּ הָ֭רִים יֵרְד֣וּ בְקָע֑וֹת אֶל מְ֝ק֗וֹם זֶ֤ה יָסַ֬דְתָּ לָהֶֽם׃
verses.en: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down--unto the place which Thou hadst founded for them;

verses.he: גְּֽבוּל שַׂ֭מְתָּ בַּל יַֽעֲבֹר֑וּן בַּל יְ֝שׁוּב֗וּן לְכַסּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Thou didst set a bound which they should not pass over, that they might not return to cover the earth.

verses.he: הַֽמְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ מַ֭עְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִ֑ים בֵּ֥ין הָ֝רִ֗ים יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃
verses.en: Who sendest forth springs into the valleys; they run between the mountains;

verses.he: יַ֭שְׁקוּ כָּל חַיְת֣וֹ שָׂדָ֑י יִשְׁבְּר֖וּ פְרָאִ֣ים צְמָאָֽם׃
verses.en: They give drink to every beast of the field, the wild asses quench their thirst.

verses.he: עֲ֭לֵיהֶם עוֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׁכּ֑וֹן מִבֵּ֥ין עֳ֝פָאיִ֗ם יִתְּנוּ קֽוֹל׃
verses.en: Beside them dwell the fowl of the heaven, from among the branches they sing.

verses.he: מַשְׁקֶ֣ה הָ֭רִים מֵעֲלִיּוֹתָ֑יו מִפְּרִ֥י מַ֝עֲשֶׂ֗יךָ תִּשְׂבַּ֥ע הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Who waterest the mountains from Thine upper chambers; the earth is full of the fruit of Thy works.

verses.he: מַצְמִ֤יחַ חָצִ֨יר לַבְּהֵמָ֗ה וְ֭עֵשֶׂב לַעֲבֹדַ֣ת הָאָדָ֑ם לְה֥וֹצִיא לֶ֝֗חֶם מִן הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Who causeth the grass to spring up for the cattle, and herb for the service of man; to bring forth bread out of the earth,

verses.he: וְיַ֤יִן יְשַׂמַּ֬ח לְֽבַב אֱנ֗וֹשׁ לְהַצְהִ֣יל פָּנִ֣ים מִשָּׁ֑מֶן וְ֝לֶ֗חֶם לְֽבַב אֱנ֥וֹשׁ יִסְעָֽד׃
verses.en: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, making the face brighter than oil, and bread that stayeth man's heart.

verses.he: יִ֭שְׂבְּעוּ עֲצֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אַֽרְזֵ֥י לְ֝בָנ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָטָֽע׃
verses.en: The trees of HaShem have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon, which He hath planted;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֭ם צִפֳּרִ֣ים יְקַנֵּ֑נוּ חֲ֝סִידָ֗ה בְּרוֹשִׁ֥ים בֵּיתָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Wherein the birds make their nests; as for the stork, the fir-trees are her house.

verses.he: הָרִ֣ים הַ֭גְּבֹהִים לַיְּעֵלִ֑ים סְ֝לָעִ֗ים מַחְסֶ֥ה לַֽשְׁפַנִּֽים׃
verses.en: The high mountains are for the wild goats; the rocks are a refuge for the conies.

verses.he: עָשָׂ֣ה יָ֭רֵחַ לְמוֹעֲדִ֑ים שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ יָדַ֥ע מְבוֹאֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Who appointedst the moon for seasons; the sun knoweth his going down.

verses.he: תָּֽשֶׁת חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וִ֣יהִי לָ֑יְלָה בּֽוֹ תִ֝רְמֹ֗שׂ כָּל חַיְתוֹ יָֽעַר׃
verses.en: Thou makest darkness, and it is night, wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.

verses.he: הַ֭כְּפִירִים שֹׁאֲגִ֣ים לַטָּ֑רֶף וּלְבַקֵּ֖שׁ מֵאֵ֣ל אָכְלָֽם׃
verses.en: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from G-d.

verses.he: תִּזְרַ֣ח הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵאָסֵפ֑וּן וְאֶל מְ֝עוֹנֹתָ֗ם יִרְבָּצֽוּן׃
verses.en: The sun ariseth, they slink away, and couch in their dens.

verses.he: יֵצֵ֣א אָדָ֣ם לְפָעֳל֑וֹ וְֽלַעֲבֹ֖דָת֣וֹ עֲדֵי עָֽרֶב׃
verses.en: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

verses.he: מָֽה רַבּ֬וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֨יךָ יְֽהוָ֗ה כֻּ֭לָּם בְּחָכְמָ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ מָלְאָ֥ה הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ קִנְיָנֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: How manifold are Thy works, O HaShem! In wisdom hast Thou made them all; the earth is full of Thy creatures.

verses.he: זֶ֤ה הַיָּ֥ם גָּדוֹל֮ וּרְחַ֪ב יָ֫דָ֥יִם שָֽׁם רֶ֭מֶשׂ וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר חַיּ֥וֹת קְ֝טַנּ֗וֹת עִם גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃
verses.en: Yonder sea, great and wide, therein are creeping things innumerable, living creatures, both small and great.

verses.he: שָׁ֭ם אֳנִיּ֣וֹת יְהַלֵּכ֑וּן לִ֝וְיָתָ֗ן זֶֽה יָצַ֥רְתָּ לְשַֽׂחֶק בּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: There go the ships; there is leviathan, whom Thou hast formed to sport therein.

verses.he: כֻּ֭לָּם אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּר֑וּן לָתֵ֖ת אָכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: All of them wait for Thee, that Thou mayest give them their food in due season.

verses.he: תִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם יִלְקֹט֑וּן תִּפְתַּ֥ח יָֽ֝דְךָ֗ יִשְׂבְּע֥וּן טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: Thou givest it unto them, they gather it; Thou openest Thy hand, they are satisfied with good.

verses.he: תַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנֶיךָ֮ יִֽבָּהֵ֫ל֥וּן תֹּסֵ֣ף ר֭וּחָם יִגְוָע֑וּן וְֽאֶל עֲפָרָ֥ם יְשׁוּבֽוּן׃
verses.en: Thou hidest Thy face, they vanish; Thou withdrawest their breath, they perish, and return to their dust.

verses.he: תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח ר֭וּחֲךָ יִבָּרֵא֑וּן וּ֝תְחַדֵּ֗שׁ פְּנֵ֣י אֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.en: Thou sendest forth Thy spirit, they are created; and Thou renewest the face of the earth.

verses.he: יְהִ֤י כְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֣ה לְעוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂמַ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה בְּמַעֲשָֽׂיו׃
verses.en: May the glory of HaShem endure for ever; let HaShem rejoice in His works!

verses.he: הַמַּבִּ֣יט לָ֭אָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָ֑ד יִגַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃
verses.en: Who looketh on the earth, and it trembleth; He toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.

verses.he: אָשִׁ֣ירָה לַיהוָ֣ה בְּחַיָּ֑י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵאלֹהַ֣י בְּעוֹדִֽי׃
verses.en: I will sing unto HaShem as long as I live; I will sing praise to my G-d while I have any being.

verses.he: יֶעֱרַ֣ב עָלָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י אָ֝נֹכִ֗י אֶשְׂמַ֥ח בַּיהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Let my musing be sweet unto Him; as for me, I will rejoice in HaShem.

verses.he: יִתַּ֤מּוּ חַטָּאִ֨ים מִן הָאָ֡רֶץ וּרְשָׁעִ֤ים ע֤וֹד אֵינָ֗ם בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת יְהוָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Let sinners cease out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless HaShem, O my soul. Hallelujah.

verses.he: הוֹד֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה קִרְא֣וּ בִּשְׁמ֑וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִילוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.en: O give thanks unto HaShem, call upon His name; make known His doings among the peoples.

verses.he: שִֽׁירוּ ל֭וֹ זַמְּרוּ ל֑וֹ שִׂ֝֗יחוּ בְּכָל נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.en: Sing unto Him, sing praises unto Him; speak ye of all His marvellous works.

verses.he: הִֽ֭תְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח לֵ֤ב מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Glory ye in His holy name; let the heart of them rejoice that seek HaShem.

verses.he: דִּרְשׁ֣וּ יְהוָ֣ה וְעֻזּ֑וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֖וּ פָנָ֣יו תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.en: Seek ye HaShem and His strength; seek His face continually.

verses.he: זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתָ֥יו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֑ה מֹ֝פְתָ֗יו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי פִֽיו׃
verses.en: Remember His marvellous works that He hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth;

verses.he: זֶ֭רַע אַבְרָהָ֣ם עַבְדּ֑וֹ בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּחִירָֽיו׃
verses.en: O ye seed of Abraham His servant, ye children of Jacob, His chosen ones.

verses.he: ה֭וּא יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ בְּכָל הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽיו׃
verses.en: He is HaShem our G-d; His judgments are in all the earth.

verses.he: זָכַ֣ר לְעוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ דָּבָ֥ר צִ֝וָּ֗ה לְאֶ֣לֶף דּֽוֹר׃
verses.en: He hath remembered His covenant for ever, the word which He commanded to a thousand generations;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּ֭רַת אֶת אַבְרָהָ֑ם וּשְׁב֖וּעָת֣וֹ לְיִשְׂחָֽק׃
verses.en: The covenant which He made with Abraham, and His oath unto Isaac;

verses.he: וַיַּֽעֲמִידֶ֣הָ לְיַעֲקֹ֣ב לְחֹ֑ק לְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.en: And He established it unto Jacob for a statute, to Israel for an everlasting covenant;

verses.he: לֵאמֹ֗ר לְךָ֗ אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת אֶֽרֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן חֶ֝֗בֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם׃
verses.en: Saying: 'Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance.'

verses.he: בִּֽ֭הְיוֹתָם מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט וְגָרִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃
verses.en: When they were but a few men in number. Yea, very few, and sojourners in it,

verses.he: וַֽ֭יִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִגּ֣וֹי אֶל גּ֑וֹי מִ֝מַּמְלָכָ֗ה אֶל עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר׃
verses.en: And when they went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people,

verses.he: לֹֽא הִנִּ֣יחַ אָדָ֣ם לְעָשְׁקָ֑ם וַיּ֖וֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מְלָכִֽים׃
verses.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong, yea, for their sake He reproved kings:

verses.he: אַֽל תִּגְּע֥וּ בִמְשִׁיחָ֑י וְ֝לִנְבִיאַי אַל תָּרֵֽעוּ׃
verses.en: 'Touch not Mine anointed ones, and do My prophets no harm.'

verses.he: וַיִּקְרָ֣א רָ֭עָב עַל הָאָ֑רֶץ כָּֽל מַטֵּה לֶ֥חֶם שָׁבָֽר׃
verses.en: And He called a famine upon the land; He broke the whole staff of bread.

verses.he: שָׁלַ֣ח לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם אִ֑ישׁ לְ֝עֶ֗בֶד נִמְכַּ֥ר יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.en: He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold for a servant;

verses.he: עִנּ֣וּ בַכֶּ֣בֶל רגליורגליורַגְל֑וֹבַּ֝רְזֶ֗ל בָּ֣אָה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: His feet they hurt with fetters, his person was laid in iron;

verses.he: עַד עֵ֥ת בֹּֽא דְבָר֑וֹ אִמְרַ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה צְרָפָֽתְהוּ׃
verses.en: Until the time that his word came to pass, the word of HaShem tested him.

verses.he: שָׁ֣לַח מֶ֭לֶךְ וַיַּתִּירֵ֑הוּ מֹשֵׁ֥ל עַ֝מִּ֗ים וַֽיְפַתְּחֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the peoples, and set him free.

verses.he: שָׂמ֣וֹ אָד֣וֹן לְבֵית֑וֹ וּ֝מֹשֵׁ֗ל בְּכָל קִנְיָנֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his possessions;

verses.he: לֶאְסֹ֣ר שָׂרָ֣יו בְּנַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּזְקֵנָ֥יו יְחַכֵּֽם׃
verses.en: To bind his princes at his pleasure, and teach his elders wisdom.

verses.he: וַיָּבֹ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ֝יַעֲקֹ֗ב גָּ֣ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ חָֽם׃
verses.en: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

verses.he: וַיֶּ֣פֶר אֶת עַמּ֣וֹ מְאֹ֑ד וַ֝יַּֽעֲצִמֵהוּ מִצָּרָֽיו׃
verses.en: And He increased His people greatly, and made them too mighty for their adversaries.

verses.he: הָפַ֣ךְ לִ֭בָּם לִשְׂנֹ֣א עַמּ֑וֹ לְ֝הִתְנַכֵּ֗ל בַּעֲבָדָֽיו׃
verses.en: He turned their heart to hate His people, to deal craftily with His servants.

verses.he: שָׁ֭לַח מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדּ֑וֹ אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽחַר בּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron whom He had chosen.

verses.he: שָֽׂמוּ בָ֭ם דִּבְרֵ֣י אֹתוֹתָ֑יו וּ֝מֹפְתִ֗ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חָֽם׃
verses.en: They wrought among them His manifold signs, and wonders in the land of Ham.

verses.he: שָׁ֣לַֽח חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וַיַּחְשִׁ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא מָ֝ר֗וּ אֶת דברוודברוודְּבָרֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He sent darkness, and it was dark; and they rebelled not against His word.

verses.he: הָפַ֣ךְ אֶת מֵימֵיהֶ֣ם לְדָ֑ם וַ֝יָּ֗מֶת אֶת דְּגָתָֽם׃
verses.en: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

verses.he: שָׁרַ֣ץ אַרְצָ֣ם צְפַרְדְּעִ֑ים בְּ֝חַדְרֵ֗י מַלְכֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Their land swarmed with frogs, in the chambers of their kings.

verses.he: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א עָרֹ֑ב כִּ֝נִּ֗ים בְּכָל גְּבוּלָֽם׃
verses.en: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, and gnats in all their borders.

verses.he: נָתַ֣ן גִּשְׁמֵיהֶ֣ם בָּרָ֑ד אֵ֖שׁ לֶהָב֣וֹת בְּאַרְצָֽם׃
verses.en: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

verses.he: וַיַּ֣ךְ גַּ֭פְנָם וּתְאֵנָתָ֑ם וַ֝יְשַׁבֵּ֗ר עֵ֣ץ גְּבוּלָֽם׃
verses.en: He smote their vines also and their fig-trees; and broke the trees of their borders.

verses.he: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א אַרְבֶּ֑ה וְ֝יֶ֗לֶק וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.en: He spoke, and the locust came, and the canker-worm without number,

verses.he: וַיֹּ֣אכַל כָּל עֵ֣שֶׂב בְּאַרְצָ֑ם וַ֝יֹּ֗אכַל פְּרִ֣י אַדְמָתָֽם׃
verses.en: And did eat up every herb in their land, and did eat up the fruit of their ground.

verses.he: וַיַּ֣ךְ כָּל בְּכ֣וֹר בְּאַרְצָ֑ם רֵ֝אשִׁ֗ית לְכָל אוֹנָֽם׃
verses.en: He smote also all the first-born in their land, the first-fruits of all their strength.

verses.he: וַֽ֭יּוֹצִיאֵם בְּכֶ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב וְאֵ֖ין בִּשְׁבָטָ֣יו כּוֹשֵֽׁל׃
verses.en: And He brought them forth with silver and gold; and there was none that stumbled among His tribes.

verses.he: שָׂמַ֣ח מִצְרַ֣יִם בְּצֵאתָ֑ם כִּֽי נָפַ֖ל פַּחְדָּ֣ם עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Egypt was glad when they departed; for the fear of them had fallen upon them.

verses.he: פָּרַ֣שׂ עָנָ֣ן לְמָסָ֑ךְ וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ לְהָאִ֥יר לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.en: He spread a cloud for a screen; and fire to give light in the night.

verses.he: שָׁאַ֣ל וַיָּבֵ֣א שְׂלָ֑ו וְלֶ֥חֶם שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽם׃
verses.en: They asked, and He brought quails, and gave them in plenty the bread of heaven.

verses.he: פָּ֣תַח צ֭וּר וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מָ֑יִם הָ֝לְכ֗וּ בַּצִּיּ֥וֹת נָהָֽר׃
verses.en: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out; they ran, a river in the dry places.

verses.he: כִּֽי זָ֭כַר אֶת דְּבַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑וֹ אֶֽת אַבְרָהָ֥ם עַבְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: For He remembered His holy word unto Abraham His servant;

verses.he: וַיּוֹצִ֣א עַמּ֣וֹ בְשָׂשׂ֑וֹן בְּ֝רִנָּ֗ה אֶת בְּחִירָֽיו׃
verses.en: And He brought forth His people with joy, His chosen ones with singing.

verses.he: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם אַרְצ֣וֹת גּוֹיִ֑ם וַעֲמַ֖ל לְאֻמִּ֣ים יִירָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.en: And He gave them the lands of the nations, and they took the labour of the peoples in possession;

verses.he: בַּעֲב֤וּר יִשְׁמְר֣וּ חֻ֭קָּיו וְתוֹרֹתָ֥יו יִנְצֹ֗רוּ הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: That they might keep His statutes, and observe His laws. Hallelujah.

verses.he: הַֽלְלוּיָ֨הּ הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Hallelujah. O give thanks unto HaShem; for He is good; for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: מִ֗י יְ֭מַלֵּל גְּבוּר֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה יַ֝שְׁמִ֗יעַ כָּל תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Who can express the mighty acts of HaShem, or make all His praise to be heard?

verses.he: אַ֭שְׁרֵי שֹׁמְרֵ֣י מִשְׁפָּ֑ט עֹשֵׂ֖ה צְדָקָ֣ה בְכָל עֵֽת׃
verses.en: Happy are they that keep justice, that do righteousness at all times.

verses.he: זָכְרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה בִּרְצ֣וֹן עַמֶּ֑ךָ פָּ֝קְדֵ֗נִי בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Remember me, O HaShem, when Thou favourest Thy people; O think of me at Thy salvation;

verses.he: לִרְא֤וֹת בְּט֘וֹבַ֤ת בְּחִירֶ֗יךָ לִ֭שְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַ֣ת גּוֹיֶ֑ךָ לְ֝הִתְהַלֵּ֗ל עִם נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: That I may behold the prosperity of Thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of Thy nation, that I may glory with Thine inheritance.

verses.he: חָטָ֥אנוּ עִם אֲבוֹתֵ֗ינוּ הֶעֱוִ֥ינוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ׃
verses.en: We have sinned with our fathers, we have done iniquitously, we have dealt wickedly.

verses.he: אֲב֘וֹתֵ֤ינוּ בְמִצְרַ֨יִם לֹא הִשְׂכִּ֬ילוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א זָ֭כְרוּ אֶת רֹ֣ב חֲסָדֶ֑יךָ וַיַּמְר֖וּ עַל יָ֣ם בְּיַם סֽוּף׃
verses.en: Our fathers in Egypt gave no heed unto Thy wonders; they remembered not the multitude of Thy mercies; but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

verses.he: וַֽ֭יּוֹשִׁיעֵם לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמ֑וֹ לְ֝הוֹדִ֗יעַ אֶת גְּבוּרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Nevertheless He saved them for His name's sake, that He might make His mighty power to be known.

verses.he: וַיִּגְעַ֣ר בְּיַם ס֭וּף וַֽיֶּחֱרָ֑ב וַיּוֹלִיכֵ֥ם בַּ֝תְּהֹמ֗וֹת כַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.en: And He rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up; and He led them through the depths, as through a wilderness.

verses.he: וַֽ֭יּוֹשִׁיעֵם מִיַּ֣ד שׂוֹנֵ֑א וַ֝יִּגְאָלֵ֗ם מִיַּ֥ד אוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.en: And He saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

verses.he: וַיְכַסּוּ מַ֥יִם צָרֵיהֶ֑ם אֶחָ֥ד מֵ֝הֶ֗ם לֹ֣א נוֹתָֽר׃
verses.en: And the waters covered their adversaries; there was not one of them left.

verses.he: וַיַּאֲמִ֥ינוּ בִדְבָרָ֑יו יָ֝שִׁ֗ירוּ תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Then believed they His words; they sang His praise.

verses.he: מִֽ֭הֲרוּ שָׁכְח֣וּ מַעֲשָׂ֑יו לֹֽא חִ֝כּ֗וּ לַעֲצָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: They soon forgot His works; they waited not for His counsel;

verses.he: וַיִּתְאַוּ֣וּ תַ֭אֲוָה בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַיְנַסּוּ אֵ֝֗ל בִּֽישִׁימֽוֹן׃
verses.en: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tried G-d in the desert.

verses.he: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם שֶׁאֱלָתָ֑ם וַיְשַׁלַּ֖ח רָז֣וֹן בְּנַפְשָֽׁם׃
verses.en: And He gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

verses.he: וַיְקַנְא֣וּ לְ֭מֹשֶׁה בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה לְ֝אַהֲרֹ֗ן קְד֣וֹשׁ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: They were jealous also of Moses in the camp, and of Aaron the holy one of HaShem.

verses.he: תִּפְתַּח אֶ֭רֶץ וַתִּבְלַ֣ע דָּתָ֑ן וַ֝תְּכַ֗ס עַל עֲדַ֥ת אֲבִירָֽם׃
verses.en: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

verses.he: וַתִּבְעַר אֵ֥שׁ בַּעֲדָתָ֑ם לֶ֝הָבָ֗ה תְּלַהֵ֥ט רְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.en: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

verses.he: יַעֲשׂוּ עֵ֥גֶל בְּחֹרֵ֑ב וַ֝יִּשְׁתַּחֲו֗וּ לְמַסֵּכָֽה׃
verses.en: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped a molten image.

verses.he: וַיָּמִ֥ירוּ אֶת כְּבוֹדָ֑ם בְּתַבְנִ֥ית שׁ֝֗וֹר אֹכֵ֥ל עֵֽשֶׂב׃
verses.en: Thus they exchanged their glory for the likeness of an ox that eateth grass.

verses.he: שָׁ֭כְחוּ אֵ֣ל מוֹשִׁיעָ֑ם עֹשֶׂ֖ה גְדֹל֣וֹת בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.en: They forgot G-d their saviour, who had done great things in Egypt;

verses.he: נִ֭פְלָאוֹת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חָ֑ם נ֝וֹרָא֗וֹת עַל יַם סֽוּף׃
verses.en: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, terrible things by the Red Sea.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לְֽהַשְׁמִ֫ידָ֥ם לוּלֵ֡י מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה בְחִיר֗וֹ עָמַ֣ד בַּפֶּ֣רֶץ לְפָנָ֑יו לְהָשִׁ֥יב חֲ֝מָת֗וֹ מֵֽהַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.en: Therefore He said that He would destroy them, had not Moses His chosen stood before Him in the breach, to turn back His wrath, lest He should destroy them.

verses.he: וַֽ֭יִּמְאֲסוּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חֶמְדָּ֑ה לֹֽא הֶ֝אֱמִ֗ינוּ לִדְבָרֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Moreover, they scorned the desirable land, they believed not His word;

verses.he: וַיֵּרָגְנ֥וּ בְאָהֳלֵיהֶ֑ם לֹ֥א שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: And they murmured in their tents, they hearkened not unto the voice of HaShem.

verses.he: וַיִּשָּׂ֣א יָד֣וֹ לָהֶ֑ם לְהַפִּ֥יל א֝וֹתָ֗ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.en: Therefore He swore concerning them, that He would overthrow them in the wilderness;

verses.he: וּלְהַפִּ֣יל זַ֭רְעָם בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וּ֝לְזָרוֹתָ֗ם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
verses.en: And that He would cast out their seed among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.

verses.he: וַ֭יִּצָּ֣מְדוּ לְבַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר וַ֝יֹּאכְל֗וּ זִבְחֵ֥י מֵתִֽים׃
verses.en: They joined themselves also unto Baal of Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

verses.he: וַ֭יַּכְעִיסוּ בְּמַֽעַלְלֵיהֶ֑ם וַתִּפְרָץ בָּ֝֗ם מַגֵּפָֽה׃
verses.en: Thus they provoked Him with their doings, and the plague broke in upon them.

verses.he: וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד פִּֽ֭ינְחָס וַיְפַלֵּ֑ל וַ֝תֵּעָצַ֗ר הַמַּגֵּפָֽה׃
verses.en: Then stood up Phinehas, and wrought judgment, and so the plague was stayed.

verses.he: וַתֵּחָ֣שֶׁב ל֭וֹ לִצְדָקָ֑ה לְדֹ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר עַד עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.en: And that was counted unto him for righteousness, unto all generations for ever.

verses.he: וַ֭יַּקְצִיפוּ עַל מֵ֥י מְרִיבָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥רַע לְ֝מֹשֶׁ֗ה בַּעֲבוּרָֽם׃
verses.en: They angered Him also at the waters of Meribah, and it went ill with Moses because of them;

verses.he: כִּֽי הִמְר֥וּ אֶת רוּח֑וֹ וַ֝יְבַטֵּ֗א בִּשְׂפָתָֽיו׃
verses.en: For they embittered his spirit, and he spoke rashly with his lips.

verses.he: לֹֽא הִ֭שְׁמִידוּ אֶת הָֽעַמִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה לָהֶֽם׃
verses.en: They did not destroy the peoples, as HaShem commanded them;

verses.he: וַיִּתְעָרְב֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽ֝יִּלְמְד֗וּ מַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: But mingled themselves with the nations, and learned their works;

verses.he: וַיַּעַבְד֥וּ אֶת עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֑ם וַיִּהְי֖וּ לָהֶ֣ם לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃
verses.en: And they served their idols, which became a snare unto them;

verses.he: וַיִּזְבְּח֣וּ אֶת בְּ֭נֵיהֶם וְאֶת בְּנֽוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם לַשֵּֽׁדִים׃
verses.en: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,

verses.he: וַיִּֽשְׁפְּכ֨וּ דָ֪ם נָקִ֡י דַּם בְּנֵ֘יהֶ֤ם וּֽבְנוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר זִ֭בְּחוּ לַעֲצַבֵּ֣י כְנָ֑עַן וַתֶּחֱנַ֥ף הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ בַּדָּמִֽים׃
verses.en: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan; and the land was polluted with blood.

verses.he: וַיִּטְמְא֥וּ בְמַעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּזְנוּ֗ בְּמַֽעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Thus were they defiled with their works, and went astray in their doings.

verses.he: וַיִּֽחַר אַ֣ף יְהוָ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ וַ֝יְתָעֵ֗ב אֶת נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Therefore was the wrath of HaShem kindled against His people, and He abhorred His inheritance.

verses.he: וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם בְּיַד גּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽיִּמְשְׁל֥וּ בָ֝הֶ֗ם שֹׂנְאֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: And He gave them into the hand of the nations; and they that hated them ruled over them.

verses.he: וַיִּלְחָצ֥וּם אוֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּכָּנְע֗וּ תַּ֣חַת יָדָֽם׃
verses.en: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were subdued under their hand.

verses.he: פְּעָמִ֥ים רַבּ֗וֹת יַצִּ֫ילֵ֥ם וְ֭הֵמָּה יַמְר֣וּ בַעֲצָתָ֑ם וַ֝יָּמֹ֗כּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָֽם׃
verses.en: Many times did He deliver them; but they were rebellious in their counsel, and sank low through their iniquity.

verses.he: וַ֭יַּרְא בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שָׁמְע֗וֹ אֶת רִנָּתָֽם׃
verses.en: Nevertheless He looked upon their distress, when He heard their cry;

verses.he: וַיִּזְכֹּ֣ר לָהֶ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ וַ֝יִּנָּחֵ֗ם כְּרֹ֣ב חסדוחסדוחֲסָדָֽיו׃
verses.en: And He remembered for them His covenant, and repented according to the multitude of His mercies.

verses.he: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אוֹתָ֣ם לְרַחֲמִ֑ים לִ֝פְנֵ֗י כָּל שׁוֹבֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captive.

verses.he: הוֹשִׁיעֵ֨נוּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ֮ מִֽן הַגּ֫וֹיִ֥ם לְ֭הֹדוֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ לְ֝הִשְׁתַּבֵּ֗חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Save us, O HaShem our G-d, and gather us from among the nations, that we may give thanks unto Thy holy name, that we may triumph in Thy praise.

verses.he: בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֪י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל מִן הָ֤עוֹלָ֨ם וְעַ֬ד הָעוֹלָ֗ם וְאָמַ֖ר כָּל הָעָ֥ם אָמֵ֗ן הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Blessed be HaShem, the G-d of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting, and let all the people say: 'Amen.' Hallelujah. BOOK V

verses.he: הֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: 'O give thanks unto HaShem, for He is good, for His mercy endureth for ever.'

verses.he: יֹ֭אמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר גְּ֝אָלָ֗ם מִיַּד צָֽר׃
verses.en: So let the redeemed of HaShem say, whom He hath redeemed from the hand of the adversary;

verses.he: וּֽמֵאֲרָצ֗וֹת קִ֫בְּצָ֥ם מִמִּזְרָ֥ח וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב מִצָּפ֥וֹן וּמִיָּֽם׃
verses.en: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the sea.

verses.he: תָּע֣וּ בַ֭מִּדְבָּר בִּישִׁימ֣וֹן דָּ֑רֶךְ עִ֥יר מ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב לֹ֣א מָצָֽאוּ׃
verses.en: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way; they found no city of habitation.

verses.he: רְעֵבִ֥ים גַּם צְמֵאִ֑ים נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בָּהֶ֥ם תִּתְעַטָּֽף׃
verses.en: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

verses.he: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֽוּקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יַצִּילֵֽם׃
verses.en: Then they cried unto HaShem in their trouble, and He delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.he: וַ֭יַּֽדְרִיכֵם בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֑ה לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת אֶל עִ֥יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃
verses.en: And He led them by a straight way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

verses.he: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: Let them give thanks unto HaShem for His mercy, and for His wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.he: כִּי הִ֭שְׂבִּיעַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׁקֵקָ֑ה וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ רְ֝עֵבָה מִלֵּא טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: For He hath satisfied the longing soul, and the hungry soul He hath filled with good.

verses.he: יֹ֭שְׁבֵי חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת אֲסִירֵ֖י עֳנִ֣י וּבַרְזֶֽל׃
verses.en: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron--

verses.he: כִּֽי הִמְר֥וּ אִמְרֵי אֵ֑ל וַעֲצַ֖ת עֶלְי֣וֹן נָאָֽצוּ׃
verses.en: Because they rebelled against the words of G-d, and contemned the counsel of the Most High.

verses.he: וַיַּכְנַ֣ע בֶּעָמָ֣ל לִבָּ֑ם כָּ֝שְׁל֗וּ וְאֵ֣ין עֹזֵֽר׃
verses.en: Therefore He humbled their heart with travail, they stumbled, and there was none to help--

verses.he: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻֽקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃
verses.en: They cried unto HaShem in their trouble, and He saved them out of their distresses.

verses.he: יֽ֭וֹצִיאֵם מֵחֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת וּמוֹסְר֖וֹתֵיהֶ֣ם יְנַתֵּֽק׃
verses.en: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke their bands in sunder.

verses.he: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: Let them give thanks unto HaShem for His mercy, and for His wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.he: כִּֽי שִׁ֭בַּר דַּלְת֣וֹת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וּבְרִיחֵ֖י בַרְזֶ֣ל גִּדֵּֽעַ׃
verses.en: For He hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.

verses.he: אֱ֭וִלִים מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ פִּשְׁעָ֑ם וּֽ֝מֵעֲוֺֽנֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יִתְעַנּֽוּ׃
verses.en: Crazed because of the way of their transgression, and afflicted because of their iniquities--

verses.he: כָּל אֹ֭כֶל תְּתַעֵ֣ב נַפְשָׁ֑ם וַ֝יַּגִּ֗יעוּ עַד שַׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת׃
verses.en: Their soul abhorred all manner of food, and they drew near unto the gates of death--

verses.he: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻֽקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃
verses.en: They cried unto HaShem in their trouble, and He saved them out of their distresses;

verses.he: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּ֭בָרוֹ וְיִרְפָּאֵ֑ם וִֽ֝ימַלֵּ֗ט מִשְּׁחִיתוֹתָֽם׃ ׆
verses.en: He sent His word, and healed them, and delivered them from their graves.

verses.he: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃ ׆
verses.en: Let them give thanks unto HaShem for His mercy, and for His wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.he: וְ֭יִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵ֣י תוֹדָ֑ה וִֽיסַפְּר֖וּ מַעֲשָׂ֣יו בְּרִנָּֽה׃ ׆
verses.en: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare His works with singing.

verses.he: יוֹרְדֵ֣י הַ֭יָּם בָּאֳנִיּ֑וֹת עֹשֵׂ֥י מְ֝לָאכָ֗ה בְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּֽים׃ ׆
verses.en: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters--

verses.he: הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו בִּמְצוּלָֽה׃ ׆
verses.en: These saw the works of HaShem, and His wonders in the deep;

verses.he: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר וַֽ֭יַּעֲמֵד ר֣וּחַ סְעָרָ֑ה וַתְּרוֹמֵ֥ם גַּלָּֽיו׃ ׆
verses.en: For He commanded, and raised the stormy wind, which lifted up the waves thereof;

verses.he: יַעֲל֣וּ שָׁ֭מַיִם יֵרְד֣וּ תְהוֹמ֑וֹת נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בְּרָעָ֥ה תִתְמוֹגָֽג׃
verses.en: They mounted up to the heaven, they went down to the deeps; their soul melted away because of trouble;

verses.he: יָח֣וֹגּוּ וְ֭יָנוּעוּ כַּשִּׁכּ֑וֹר וְכָל חָ֝כְמָתָ֗ם תִּתְבַּלָּֽע׃
verses.en: They reeled to and fro, and staggered like a drunken man, and all their wisdom was swallowed up--

verses.he: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וּֽ֝מִמְּצֽוּקֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹצִיאֵֽם׃
verses.en: They cried unto HaShem in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distresses.

verses.he: יָקֵ֣ם סְ֭עָרָה לִדְמָמָ֑ה וַ֝יֶּחֱשׁ֗וּ גַּלֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: He made the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof were still.

verses.he: וַיִּשְׂמְח֥וּ כִֽי יִשְׁתֹּ֑קוּ וַ֝יַּנְחֵ֗ם אֶל מְח֥וֹז חֶפְצָֽם׃
verses.en: Then were they glad because they were quiet, and He led them unto their desired haven.

verses.he: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: Let them give thanks unto HaShem for His mercy, and for His wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.he: וִֽ֭ירֹמְמוּהוּ בִּקְהַל עָ֑ם וּבְמוֹשַׁ֖ב זְקֵנִ֣ים יְהַלְלֽוּהוּ׃
verses.en: Let them exalt Him also in the assembly of the people, and praise Him in the seat of the elders.

verses.he: יָשֵׂ֣ם נְהָר֣וֹת לְמִדְבָּ֑ר וּמֹצָ֥אֵי מַ֝֗יִם לְצִמָּאֽוֹן׃
verses.en: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and watersprings into a thirsty ground;

verses.he: אֶ֣רֶץ פְּ֭רִי לִמְלֵחָ֑ה מֵ֝רָעַ֗ת יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
verses.en: A fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

verses.he: יָשֵׂ֣ם מִ֭דְבָּר לַֽאֲגַם מַ֑יִם וְאֶ֥רֶץ צִ֝יָּ֗ה לְמֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם׃
verses.en: He turneth a wilderness into a pool of water, and a dry land into watersprings.

verses.he: וַיּ֣וֹשֶׁב שָׁ֣ם רְעֵבִ֑ים וַ֝יְכוֹנְנ֗וּ עִ֣יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃
verses.en: And there He maketh the hungry to dwell, and they establish a city of habitation;

verses.he: וַיִּזְרְע֣וּ שָׂ֭דוֹת וַיִּטְּע֣וּ כְרָמִ֑ים וַ֝יַּעֲשׂ֗וּ פְּרִ֣י תְבֽוּאָה׃
verses.en: And sow fields, and plant vineyards, which yield fruits of increase.

verses.he: וַיְבָרֲכֵ֣ם וַיִּרְבּ֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וּ֝בְהֶמְתָּ֗ם לֹ֣א יַמְעִֽיט׃
verses.en: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly, and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

verses.he: וַיִּמְעֲט֥וּ וַיָּשֹׁ֑חוּ מֵעֹ֖צֶר רָעָ֣ה וְיָגֽוֹן׃ ׆
verses.en: Again, they are minished and dwindle away through oppression of evil and sorrow.

verses.he: שֹׁפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל נְדִיבִ֑ים וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם בְּתֹ֣הוּ לֹא דָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.en: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the waste, where there is no way.

verses.he: וַיְשַׂגֵּ֣ב אֶבְי֣וֹן מֵע֑וֹנִי וַיָּ֥שֶׂם כַּ֝צֹּ֗אן מִשְׁפָּחֽוֹת׃
verses.en: Yet setteth He the needy on high from affliction, and maketh his families like a flock.

verses.he: יִרְא֣וּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְכָל עַ֝וְלָ֗ה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃
verses.en: The upright see it, and are glad; and all iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

verses.he: מִי חָכָ֥ם וְיִשְׁמָר אֵ֑לֶּה וְ֝יִתְבּֽוֹנְנ֗וּ חַֽסְדֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Whoso is wise, let him observe these things, and let them consider the mercies of HaShem.

verses.he: שִׁ֖יר מִזְמ֣וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.en: A Song, a Psalm of David.

verses.he: נָכ֣וֹן לִבִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה אַף כְּבוֹדִֽי׃
verses.en: My heart is steadfast, O G-d; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises, even with my glory.

verses.he: ע֭וּרָֽה הַנֵּ֥בֶל וְכִנּ֗וֹר אָעִ֥ירָה שָּֽׁחַר׃
verses.en: Awake, psaltery and harp; I will awake the dawn.

verses.he: אוֹדְךָ֖ בָעַמִּ֥ים יְהוָ֑ה וַ֝אֲזַמֶּרְךָ֗ בַּל אֻמִּֽים׃
verses.en: I will give thanks unto Thee, O HaShem, among the peoples; and I will sing praises unto Thee among the nations.

verses.he: כִּֽי גָד֣וֹל מֵֽעַל שָׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְֽעַד שְׁחָקִ֥ים אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: For Thy mercy is great above the heavens, and Thy truth reacheth unto the skies.

verses.he: ר֣וּמָה עַל שָׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל כָּל הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Be Thou exalted, O G-d, above the heavens; and Thy glory be above all the earth.

verses.he: לְ֭מַעַן יֵחָלְצ֣וּן יְדִידֶ֑יךָ הוֹשִׁ֖יעָה יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: That Thy beloved may be delivered, save with Thy right hand, and answer me.

verses.he: אֱלֹהִ֤ים דִּבֶּ֥ר בְּקָדְשׁ֗וֹ אֶעְלֹ֥זָה אֲחַלְּקָ֥ה שְׁכֶ֑ם וְעֵ֖מֶק סֻכּ֣וֹת אֲמַדֵּֽד׃
verses.en: G-d spoke in His holiness, that I would exult; that I would divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.he: לִ֤י גִלְעָ֨ד לִ֤י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה וְ֭אֶפְרַיִם מָע֣וֹז רֹאשִׁ֑י יְ֝הוּדָ֗ה מְחֹקְקִֽי׃
verses.en: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.

verses.he: מוֹאָ֤ב סִ֬יר רַחְצִ֗י עַל אֱ֭דוֹם אַשְׁלִ֣יךְ נַעֲלִ֑י עֲלֵֽי פְ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת אֶתְרוֹעָֽע׃
verses.en: Moab is my washpot; upon Edom do I cast my shoe; over Philistia do I cry aloud.

verses.he: מִ֣י יֹ֭בִלֵנִי עִ֣יר מִבְצָ֑ר מִ֖י נָחַ֣נִי עַד אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.en: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me unto Edom?

verses.he: הֲלֹֽא אֱלֹהִ֥ים זְנַחְתָּ֑נוּ וְֽלֹא תֵצֵ֥א אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּצִבְאֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.en: Hast not Thou cast us off, O G-d? and Thou goest not forth, O G-d, with our hosts?

verses.he: הָֽבָה לָּ֣נוּ עֶזְרָ֣ת מִצָּ֑ר וְ֝שָׁ֗וְא תְּשׁוּעַ֥ת אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: Give us help against the adversary; for vain is the help of man.

verses.he: בֵּֽאלֹהִ֥ים נַעֲשֶׂה חָ֑יִל וְ֝ה֗וּא יָב֥וּס צָרֵֽינוּ׃
verses.en: Through G-d we shall do valiantly; for He it is that will tread down our adversaries.

verses.he: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְ֝הִלָּתִ֗י אַֽל תֶּחֱרַֽשׁ׃
verses.en: For the Leader. A Psalm of David. O G-d of my praise, keep not silence;

verses.he: כִּ֤י פִ֪י רָשָׁ֡ע וּֽפִי מִ֭רְמָה עָלַ֣י פָּתָ֑חוּ דִּבְּר֥וּ אִ֝תִּ֗י לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.en: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit have they opened against me; they have spoken unto me with a lying tongue.

verses.he: וְדִבְרֵ֣י שִׂנְאָ֣ה סְבָב֑וּנִי וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֥וּנִי חִנָּֽם׃
verses.en: They compassed me about also with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

verses.he: תַּֽחַת אַהֲבָתִ֥י יִשְׂטְנ֗וּנִי וַאֲנִ֥י תְפִלָּֽה׃
verses.en: In return for my love they are my adversaries; but I am all prayer.

verses.he: וַיָּ֘שִׂ֤ימוּ עָלַ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה וְ֝שִׂנְאָ֗ה תַּ֣חַת אַהֲבָתִֽי׃
verses.en: And they have laid upon me evil for good, and hatred for my love:

verses.he: הַפְקֵ֣ד עָלָ֣יו רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝שָׂטָ֗ן יַעֲמֹ֥ד עַל יְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.en: 'Set Thou a wicked man over him; and let an adversary stand at his right hand.

verses.he: בְּ֭הִשָּׁ֣פְטוֹ יֵצֵ֣א רָשָׁ֑ע וּ֝תְפִלָּת֗וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַֽחֲטָאָֽה׃
verses.en: When he is judged, let him go forth condemned; and let his prayer be turned into sin.

verses.he: יִֽהְיֽוּ יָמָ֥יו מְעַטִּ֑ים פְּ֝קֻדָּת֗וֹ יִקַּ֥ח אַחֵֽר׃
verses.en: Let his days be few; let another take his charge.

verses.he: יִֽהְיוּ בָנָ֥יו יְתוֹמִ֑ים וְ֝אִשְׁתּוֹ אַלְמָנָֽה׃
verses.en: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

verses.he: וְנ֤וֹעַ יָנ֣וּעוּ בָנָ֣יו וְשִׁאֵ֑לוּ וְ֝דָרְשׁ֗וּ מֵחָרְבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg; and let them seek their bread out of their desolate places.

verses.he: יְנַקֵּ֣שׁ נ֭וֹשֶׁה לְכָל אֲשֶׁר ל֑וֹ וְיָבֹ֖זּוּ זָרִ֣ים יְגִיעֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Let the creditor distrain all that he hath; and let strangers make spoil of his labour.

verses.he: אַל יְהִי ל֭וֹ מֹשֵׁ֣ךְ חָ֑סֶד וְֽאַל יְהִ֥י ח֝וֹנֵ֗ן לִיתוֹמָֽיו׃
verses.en: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him; neither let there be any to be gracious unto his fatherless children.

verses.he: יְהִֽי אַחֲרִית֥וֹ לְהַכְרִ֑ית בְּד֥וֹר אַ֝חֵ֗ר יִמַּ֥ח שְׁמָֽם׃
verses.en: Let his posterity be cut off; in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

verses.he: יִזָּכֵ֤ר עֲוֺ֣ן אֲ֭בֹתָיו אֶל יְהוָ֑ה וְחַטַּ֥את אִ֝מּ֗וֹ אַל תִּמָּֽח׃
verses.en: Let the iniquity of his fathers be brought to remembrance unto HaShem; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

verses.he: יִהְי֣וּ נֶֽגֶד יְהוָ֣ה תָּמִ֑יד וְיַכְרֵ֖ת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם׃
verses.en: Let them be before HaShem continually, that He may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

verses.he: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹ֥א זָכַר֮ עֲשׂ֪וֹת חָ֥סֶד וַיִּרְדֹּ֡ף אִישׁ עָנִ֣י וְ֭אֶבְיוֹן וְנִכְאֵ֨ה לֵבָ֬ב לְמוֹתֵֽת׃
verses.en: Because that he remembered not to do kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, and the broken in heart he was ready to slay.

verses.he: וַיֶּאֱהַ֣ב קְ֭לָלָה וַתְּבוֹאֵ֑הוּ וְֽלֹא חָפֵ֥ץ בִּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה וַתִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: Yea, he loved cursing, and it came unto him; and he delighted not in blessing, and it is far from him.

verses.he: וַיִּלְבַּ֥שׁ קְלָלָ֗ה כְּמַ֫דּ֥וֹ וַתָּבֹ֣א כַמַּ֣יִם בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְ֝כַשֶּׁ֗מֶן בְּעַצְמוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.en: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his raiment, and it is come into his inward parts like water, and like oil into his bones.

verses.he: תְּהִי ל֭וֹ כְּבֶ֣גֶד יַעְטֶ֑ה וּ֝לְמֵ֗זַח תָּמִ֥יד יַחְגְּרֶֽהָ׃
verses.en: Let it be unto him as the garment which he putteth on, and for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.'

verses.he: זֹ֤את פְּעֻלַּ֣ת שֹׂ֭טְנַי מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְהַדֹּבְרִ֥ים רָ֝֗ע עַל נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.en: This would mine adversaries effect from HaShem, and they that speak evil against my soul.

verses.he: וְאַתָּ֤ה יְה֘וִ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֗י עֲֽשֵׂה אִ֭תִּי לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּי ט֥וֹב חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ הַצִּילֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: But Thou, O GOD the L-rd, deal with me for Thy name's sake; because Thy mercy is good, deliver Thou me.

verses.he: כִּֽי עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן אָנֹ֑כִי וְ֝לִבִּ֗י חָלַ֥ל בְּקִרְבִּֽי׃
verses.en: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

verses.he: כְּצֵל כִּנְטוֹת֥וֹ נֶהֱלָ֑כְתִּי נִ֝נְעַ֗רְתִּי כָּֽאַרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.en: I am gone like the shadow when it lengtheneth; I am shaken off as the locust.

verses.he: בִּ֭רְכַּי כָּשְׁל֣וּ מִצּ֑וֹם וּ֝בְשָׂרִ֗י כָּחַ֥שׁ מִשָּֽׁמֶן׃
verses.en: My knees totter through fasting; and my flesh is lean, and hath no fatness.

verses.he: וַאֲנִ֤י הָיִ֣יתִי חֶרְפָּ֣ה לָהֶ֑ם יִ֝רְא֗וּנִי יְנִיע֥וּן רֹאשָֽׁם׃
verses.en: I am become also a taunt unto them; when they see me, they shake their head.

verses.he: עָ֭זְרֵנִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י ה֭וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי כְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: Help me, O HaShem my G-d; O save me according to Thy mercy;

verses.he: וְֽ֭יֵדְעוּ כִּי יָ֣דְךָ זֹּ֑את אַתָּ֖ה יְהוָ֣ה עֲשִׂיתָֽהּ׃
verses.en: That they may know that this is Thy hand; that Thou, HaShem, hast done it.

verses.he: יְקַֽלְלוּ הֵמָּה֮ וְאַתָּ֪ה תְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ קָ֤מוּ וַיֵּבֹ֗שׁוּ וְֽעַבְדְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמָֽח׃
verses.en: Let them curse, but bless Thou; when they arise, they shall be put to shame, but Thy servant shall rejoice.

verses.he: יִלְבְּשׁ֣וּ שׂוֹטְנַ֣י כְּלִמָּ֑ה וְיַעֲט֖וּ כַמְעִ֣יל בָּשְׁתָּֽם׃
verses.en: Mine adversaries shall be clothed with confusion, and shall put on their own shame as a robe.

verses.he: א֘וֹדֶ֤ה יְהוָ֣ה מְאֹ֣ד בְּפִ֑י וּבְת֖וֹךְ רַבִּ֣ים אֲהַֽלְלֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: I will give great thanks unto HaShem with my mouth; yea, I will praise Him among the multitude;

verses.he: כִּֽי יַ֭עֲמֹד לִימִ֣ין אֶבְי֑וֹן לְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵ֥י נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: Because He standeth at the right hand of the needy, to save him from them that judge his soul.

verses.he: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר נְאֻ֤ם יְהוָ֨ה לַֽאדֹנִ֗י שֵׁ֥ב לִֽימִינִ֑י עַד אָשִׁ֥ית אֹ֝יְבֶ֗יךָ הֲדֹ֣ם לְרַגְלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: A Psalm of David. HaShem saith unto my lord: 'Sit thou at My right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.'

verses.he: מַטֵּֽה עֻזְּךָ֗ יִשְׁלַ֣ח יְ֭הוָה מִצִּיּ֑וֹן רְ֝דֵ֗ה בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: The rod of Thy strength HaShem will send out of Zion: 'Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.'

verses.he: עַמְּךָ֣ נְדָבֹת֮ בְּי֪וֹם חֵ֫ילֶ֥ךָ בְּֽהַדְרֵי קֹ֭דֶשׁ מֵרֶ֣חֶם מִשְׁחָ֑ר לְ֝ךָ֗ טַ֣ל יַלְדֻתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Thy people offer themselves willingly in the day of thy warfare; in adornments of holiness, from the womb of the dawn, thine is the dew of thy youth.

verses.he: נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהוָ֨ה וְלֹ֥א יִנָּחֵ֗ם אַתָּֽה כֹהֵ֥ן לְעוֹלָ֑ם עַל דִּ֝בְרָתִ֗י מַלְכִּי צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.en: HaShem hath sworn, and will not repent: 'Thou art a priest for ever after the manner of Melchizedek.'

verses.he: אֲדֹנָ֥י עַל יְמִֽינְךָ֑ מָחַ֖ץ בְּיוֹם אַפּ֣וֹ מְלָכִֽים׃
verses.en: The L-rd at thy right hand doth crush kings in the day of His wrath.

verses.he: יָדִ֣ין בַּ֭גּוֹיִם מָלֵ֣א גְוִיּ֑וֹת מָ֥חַץ רֹ֝֗אשׁ עַל אֶ֥רֶץ רַבָּֽה׃
verses.en: He will judge among the nations; He filleth it with the dead bodies, He crusheth the head over a wide land.

verses.he: מִ֭נַּחַל בַּדֶּ֣רֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה עַל כֵּ֝֗ן יָרִ֥ים רֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.en: He will drink of the brook in the way; therefore will he lift up the head.

verses.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל לֵבָ֑ב בְּס֖וֹד יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְעֵדָֽה׃
verses.en: Hallelujah. I will give thanks unto HaShem with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

verses.he: גְּ֭דֹלִים מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהוָ֑ה דְּ֝רוּשִׁ֗ים לְכָל חֶפְצֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: The works of HaShem are great, sought out of all them that have delight therein.

verses.he: הוֹד וְהָדָ֥ר פָּֽעֳל֑וֹ וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃
verses.en: His work is glory and majesty; and His righteousness endureth for ever.

verses.he: זֵ֣כֶר עָ֭שָׂה לְנִפְלְאֹתָ֑יו חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: He hath made a memorial for His wonderful works; HaShem is gracious and full of compassion.

verses.he: טֶ֭רֶף נָתַ֣ן לִֽירֵאָ֑יו יִזְכֹּ֖ר לְעוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He hath given food unto them that fear Him; He will ever be mindful of His covenant.

verses.he: כֹּ֣חַ מַ֭עֲשָׂיו הִגִּ֣יד לְעַמּ֑וֹ לָתֵ֥ת לָ֝הֶ֗ם נַחֲלַ֥ת גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.en: He hath declared to His people the power of His works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

verses.he: מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָ֭דָיו אֱמֶ֣ת וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נֶ֝אֱמָנִ֗ים כָּל פִּקּוּדָֽיו׃
verses.en: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are sure.

verses.he: סְמוּכִ֣ים לָעַ֣ד לְעוֹלָ֑ם עֲ֝שׂוּיִ֗ם בֶּאֱמֶ֥ת וְיָשָֽׁר׃
verses.en: They are established for ever and ever, they are done in truth and uprightness.

verses.he: פְּד֤וּת שָׁ֘לַ֤ח לְעַמּ֗וֹ צִוָּֽה לְעוֹלָ֥ם בְּרִית֑וֹ קָד֖וֹשׁ וְנוֹרָ֣א שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He hath sent redemption unto His people; He hath commanded His covenant for ever; Holy and awful is His name.

verses.he: רֵ֘אשִׁ֤ית חָכְמָ֨ה יִרְאַ֬ת יְהוָ֗ה שֵׂ֣כֶל ט֭וֹב לְכָל עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם תְּ֝הִלָּת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃
verses.en: The fear of HaShem is the beginning of wisdom; a good understanding have all they that do thereafter; His praise endureth for ever.

verses.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ אַשְׁרֵי אִ֭ישׁ יָרֵ֣א אֶת יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝מִצְוֺתָ֗יו חָפֵ֥ץ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.en: Hallelujah. Happy is the man that feareth HaShem, that delighteth greatly in His commandments.

verses.he: גִּבּ֣וֹר בָּ֭אָרֶץ יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְע֑וֹ דּ֭וֹר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יְבֹרָֽךְ׃
verses.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth; the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

verses.he: הוֹן וָעֹ֥שֶׁר בְּבֵית֑וֹ וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃
verses.en: Wealth and riches are in his house; and his merit endureth for ever.

verses.he: זָ֘רַ֤ח בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ א֭וֹר לַיְשָׁרִ֑ים חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם וְצַדִּֽיק׃
verses.en: Unto the upright He shineth as a light in the darkness, gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

verses.he: טֽוֹב אִ֭ישׁ חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה יְכַלְכֵּ֖ל דְּבָרָ֣יו בְּמִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.en: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth, that ordereth his affairs rightfully.

verses.he: כִּֽי לְעוֹלָ֥ם לֹא יִמּ֑וֹט לְזֵ֥כֶר ע֝וֹלָ֗ם יִהְיֶ֥ה צַדִּֽיק׃
verses.en: For he shall never be moved; the righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.

verses.he: מִשְּׁמוּעָ֣ה רָ֭עָה לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א נָכ֥וֹן לִ֝בּ֗וֹ בָּטֻ֥חַ בַּיהוָֽה׃
verses.en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings; his heart is stedfast, trusting in HaShem.

verses.he: סָמ֣וּךְ לִ֭בּוֹ לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר יִרְאֶ֣ה בְצָרָֽיו׃
verses.en: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he gaze upon his adversaries.

verses.he: פִּזַּ֤ר נָ֘תַ֤ן לָאֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים צִ֭דְקָתוֹ עֹמֶ֣דֶת לָעַ֑ד קַ֝רְנ֗וֹ תָּר֥וּם בְּכָבֽוֹד׃
verses.en: He hath scattered abroad, he hath given to the needy; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted in honour.

verses.he: רָ֘שָׁ֤ע יִרְאֶ֨ה וְכָעָ֗ס שִׁנָּ֣יו יַחֲרֹ֣ק וְנָמָ֑ס תַּאֲוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃
verses.en: The wicked shall see it, and be vexed; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away; the desire of the wicked shall perish.

verses.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ הַ֭לְלוּ עַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְלוּ אֶת שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Hallelujah. Praise, O ye servants of HaShem, praise the name of HaShem.

verses.he: יְהִ֤י שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֣ה מְבֹרָ֑ךְ מֵֽ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.en: Blessed be the name of HaShem from this time forth and for ever.

verses.he: מִמִּזְרַח שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ עַד מְבוֹא֑וֹ מְ֝הֻלָּ֗ל שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: From the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof HaShem'S name is to be praised.

verses.he: רָ֖ם עַל כָּל גּוֹיִ֥ם יְהוָ֑ה עַ֖ל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.en: HaShem is high above all nations, His glory is above the heavens.

verses.he: מִ֭י כַּיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ הַֽמַּגְבִּיהִ֥י לָשָֽׁבֶת׃
verses.en: Who is like unto HaShem our G-d, that is enthroned on high,

verses.he: הַֽמַּשְׁפִּילִ֥י לִרְא֑וֹת בַּשָּׁמַ֥יִם וּבָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: That looketh down low upon heaven and upon the earth?

verses.he: מְקִֽימִ֣י מֵעָפָ֣ר דָּ֑ל מֵֽ֝אַשְׁפֹּ֗ת יָרִ֥ים אֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.en: Who raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth up the needy out of the dunghill;

verses.he: לְהוֹשִׁיבִ֥י עִם נְדִיבִ֑ים עִ֝֗ם נְדִיבֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: That He may set him with princes, even with the princes of His people.

verses.he: מֽוֹשִׁיבִ֨י עֲקֶ֬רֶת הַבַּ֗יִת אֵֽם הַבָּנִ֥ים שְׂמֵחָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Who maketh the barren woman to dwell in her house as a joyful mother of children. Hallelujah.

verses.he: בְּצֵ֣את יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם בֵּ֥ית יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב מֵעַ֥ם לֹעֵֽז׃
verses.en: When Israel came forth out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

verses.he: הָיְתָ֣ה יְהוּדָ֣ה לְקָדְשׁ֑וֹ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל מַמְשְׁלוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.en: Judah became His sanctuary, Israel His dominion.

verses.he: הַיָּ֣ם רָ֭אָה וַיָּנֹ֑ס הַ֝יַּרְדֵּ֗ן יִסֹּ֥ב לְאָחֽוֹר׃
verses.en: The sea saw it, and fled; the Jordan turned backward.

verses.he: הֶֽ֭הָרִים רָקְד֣וּ כְאֵילִ֑ים גְּ֝בָע֗וֹת כִּבְנֵי צֹֽאן׃
verses.en: The mountains skipped like rams, the hills like young sheep.

verses.he: מַה לְּךָ֣ הַ֭יָּם כִּ֣י תָנ֑וּס הַ֝יַּרְדֵּ֗ן תִּסֹּ֥ב לְאָחֽוֹר׃
verses.en: What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? thou Jordan, that thou turnest backward?

verses.he: הֶֽ֭הָרִים תִּרְקְד֣וּ כְאֵילִ֑ים גְּ֝בָע֗וֹת כִּבְנֵי צֹֽאן׃
verses.en: Ye mountains, that ye skip like rams; ye hills, like young sheep?

verses.he: מִלִּפְנֵ֣י אָ֭דוֹן ח֣וּלִי אָ֑רֶץ מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.en: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the L-rd, at the presence of the G-d of Jacob;

verses.he: הַהֹפְכִ֣י הַצּ֣וּר אֲגַם מָ֑יִם חַ֝לָּמִ֗ישׁ לְמַעְיְנוֹ מָֽיִם׃
verses.en: Who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a fountain of waters.

verses.he: לֹ֤א לָ֥נוּ יְהוָ֗ה לֹ֫א לָ֥נוּ כִּֽי לְ֭שִׁמְךָ תֵּ֣ן כָּב֑וֹד עַל חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ עַל אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: Not unto us, O HaShem, not unto us, but unto Thy name give glory, for Thy mercy, and for Thy truth's sake.

verses.he: לָ֭מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם אַיֵּה נָ֝֗א אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Wherefore should the nations say: 'Where is now their G-d?'

verses.he: וֵֽאלֹהֵ֥ינוּ בַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כֹּ֭ל אֲשֶׁר חָפֵ֣ץ עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.en: But our G-d is in the heavens; whatsoever pleased Him He hath done.

verses.he: עֲֽ֭צַבֵּיהֶם כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

verses.he: פֶּֽה לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ עֵינַ֥יִם לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֽוּ׃
verses.en: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;

verses.he: אָזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ אַ֥ף לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יְרִיחֽוּן׃
verses.en: They have ears, but they hear not; noses have they, but they smell not;

verses.he: יְדֵיהֶ֤ם וְלֹ֬א יְמִישׁ֗וּן רַ֭גְלֵיהֶם וְלֹ֣א יְהַלֵּ֑כוּ לֹֽא יֶ֝הְגּ֗וּ בִּגְרוֹנָֽם׃
verses.en: They have hands, but they handle not; feet have they, but they walk not; neither speak they with their throat.

verses.he: כְּ֭מוֹהֶם יִהְי֣וּ עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֭ל אֲשֶׁר בֹּטֵ֣חַ בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.en: They that make them shall be like unto them; yea, every one that trusteth in them.

verses.he: יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בְּטַ֣ח בַּיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃
verses.en: O Israel, trust thou in HaShem! He is their help and their shield!

verses.he: בֵּ֣ית אַ֭הֲרֹן בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃
verses.en: O house of Aaron, trust ye in HaShem! He is their help and their shield!

verses.he: יִרְאֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃
verses.en: Ye that fear HaShem, trust in HaShem! He is their help and their shield.

verses.he: יְהוָה֮ זְכָרָ֪נוּ יְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ יְ֭בָרֵךְ אֶת בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְ֝בָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת בֵּ֥ית אַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.en: HaShem hath been mindful of us, He will bless--He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.

verses.he: יְ֭בָרֵךְ יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַ֝קְּטַנִּ֗ים עִם הַגְּדֹלִֽים׃
verses.en: He will bless them that fear HaShem, both small and great.

verses.he: יֹסֵ֣ף יְהוָ֣ה עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם וְעַל בְּנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.en: HaShem increase you more and more, you and your children.

verses.he: בְּרוּכִ֣ים אַ֭תֶּם לַיהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Blessed be ye of HaShem who made heaven and earth.

verses.he: הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם שָׁ֭מַיִם לַיהוָ֑ה וְ֝הָאָ֗רֶץ נָתַ֥ן לִבְנֵי אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: The heavens are the heavens of HaShem; but the earth hath He given to the children of men.

verses.he: לֹ֣א הַ֭מֵּתִים יְהַֽלְלוּ יָ֑הּ וְ֝לֹ֗א כָּל יֹרְדֵ֥י דוּמָֽה׃
verses.en: The dead praise not HaShem, neither any that go down into silence;

verses.he: וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ נְבָ֘רֵ֤ךְ יָ֗הּ מֵֽעַתָּ֥ה וְעַד עוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: But we will bless HaShem from this time forth and for ever. Hallelujah.

verses.he: אָ֭הַבְתִּי כִּֽי יִשְׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֑ה אֶת ק֝וֹלִ֗י תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
verses.en: I love that HaShem should hear my voice and my supplications.

verses.he: כִּֽי הִטָּ֣ה אָזְנ֣וֹ לִ֑י וּבְיָמַ֥י אֶקְרָֽא׃
verses.en: Because He hath inclined His ear unto me, therefore will I call upon Him all my days.

verses.he: אֲפָפ֤וּנִי חֶבְלֵי מָ֗וֶת וּמְצָרֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל מְצָא֑וּנִי צָרָ֖ה וְיָג֣וֹן אֶמְצָֽא׃
verses.en: The cords of death compassed me, and the straits of the nether-world got hold upon me; I found trouble and sorrow.

verses.he: וּבְשֵֽׁם יְהוָ֥ה אֶקְרָ֑א אָנָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה מַלְּטָ֥ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.en: But I called upon the name of HaShem: 'I beseech thee, O HaShem, deliver my soul.'

verses.he: חַנּ֣וּן יְהֹוָ֣ה וְצַדִּ֑יק וֵ֖אלֹהֵ֣ינוּ מְרַחֵֽם׃
verses.en: Gracious is HaShem, and righteous; yea, our G-d is compassionate.

verses.he: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פְּתָאיִ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה דַּ֝לּוֹתִ֗י וְלִ֣י יְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.en: HaShem preserveth the simple; I was brought low, and He saved me.

verses.he: שׁוּבִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָ֑יְכִי כִּֽי יְ֝הוָ֗ה גָּמַ֥ל עָלָֽיְכִי׃
verses.en: Return, O my soul, unto Thy rest; for HaShem hath dealt bountifully with thee.

verses.he: כִּ֤י חִלַּ֥צְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֗י מִ֫מָּ֥וֶת אֶת עֵינִ֥י מִן דִּמְעָ֑ה אֶת רַגְלִ֥י מִדֶּֽחִי׃
verses.en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling.

verses.he: אֶ֭תְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝אַרְצ֗וֹת הַֽחַיִּֽים׃
verses.en: I shall walk before HaShem in the lands of the living.

verses.he: הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֲ֝נִ֗י עָנִ֥יתִי מְאֹֽד׃
verses.en: I trusted even when I spoke: 'I am greatly afflicted.'

verses.he: אֲ֭נִי אָמַ֣רְתִּי בְחָפְזִ֑י כָּֽל הָאָדָ֥ם כֹּזֵֽב׃
verses.en: I said in my haste: 'All men are liars.'

verses.he: מָֽה אָשִׁ֥יב לַיהוָ֑ה כָּֽל תַּגְמוּל֥וֹהִי עָלָֽי׃
verses.en: How can I repay unto HaShem all His bountiful dealings toward me?

verses.he: כּוֹס יְשׁוּע֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֑א וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא׃
verses.en: I will lift up the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of HaShem.

verses.he: נְ֭דָרַי לַיהוָ֣ה אֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם נֶגְדָה נָּ֝֗א לְכָל עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: My vows will I pay unto HaShem, yea, in the presence of all His people.

verses.he: יָ֭קָר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַ֝מָּ֗וְתָה לַחֲסִידָֽיו׃
verses.en: Precious in the sight of HaShem is the death of His saints.

verses.he: אָֽנָּ֣ה יְהוָה֮ כִּֽי אֲנִ֪י עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲֽנִי עַ֭בְדְּךָ בֶּן אֲמָתֶ֑ךָ פִּ֝תַּ֗חְתָּ לְמוֹסֵרָֽי׃
verses.en: I beseech Thee, O HaShem, for I am Thy servant; I am Thy servant, the son of Thy handmaid; Thou hast loosed my bands.

verses.he: לְֽךָ אֶ֭זְבַּח זֶ֣בַח תּוֹדָ֑ה וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא׃
verses.en: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of HaShem.

verses.he: נְ֭דָרַי לַיהוָ֣ה אֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם נֶגְדָה נָּ֝֗א לְכָל עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: I will pay my vows unto HaShem, yea, in the presence of all His people;

verses.he: בְּחַצְר֤וֹת בֵּ֤ית יְהוָ֗ה בְּֽת֘וֹכֵ֤כִי יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: In the courts of HaShem'S house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah.

verses.he: הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת יְ֭הוָה כָּל גּוֹיִ֑ם שַׁ֝בְּח֗וּהוּ כָּל הָאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.en: O praise HaShem, all ye nations; laud Him, all ye peoples.

verses.he: כִּ֥י גָ֘בַ֤ר עָלֵ֨ינוּ חַסְדּ֗וֹ וֶֽאֱמֶת יְהוָ֥ה לְעוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: For His mercy is great toward us; and the truth of HaShem endureth for ever. Hallelujah.

verses.he: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: 'O give thanks unto HaShem, for He is good, for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: יֹֽאמַר נָ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: So let Israel now say, for His mercy endureth for ever,

verses.he: יֹֽאמְרוּ נָ֥א בֵֽית אַהֲרֹ֑ן כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: So let the house of Aaron now say, for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: יֹֽאמְרוּ נָ֭א יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: So let them now that fear HaShem say, for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: מִֽן הַ֭מֵּצַ֥ר קָרָ֣אתִי יָּ֑הּ עָנָ֖נִי בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Out of my straits I called upon HaShem; He answered me with great enlargement.

verses.he: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִ֣י אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: HaShem is for me; I will not fear; what can man do unto me?

verses.he: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י בְּעֹזְרָ֑י וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶרְאֶ֥ה בְשֹׂנְאָֽי׃
verses.en: HaShem is for me as my helper; and I shall gaze upon them that hate me.

verses.he: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בָּאָדָֽם׃
verses.en: It is better to take refuge in HaShem than to trust in man.

verses.he: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בִּנְדִיבִֽים׃
verses.en: It is better to take refuge in HaShem than to trust in princes.

verses.he: כָּל גּוֹיִ֥ם סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃
verses.en: All nations compass me about; verily, in the name of HaShem I will cut them off.

verses.he: סַבּ֥וּנִי גַם סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃
verses.en: They compass me about, yea, they compass me about; verily, in the name of HaShem I will cut them off.

verses.he: סַבּ֤וּנִי כִדְבוֹרִ֗ים דֹּ֭עֲכוּ כְּאֵ֣שׁ קוֹצִ֑ים בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃
verses.en: They compass me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns; verily, in the name of HaShem I will cut them off.

verses.he: דַּחֹ֣ה דְחִיתַ֣נִי לִנְפֹּ֑ל וַ֖יהוָ֣ה עֲזָרָֽנִי׃
verses.en: Thou didst thrust sore at me that I might fall; but HaShem helped me.

verses.he: עָזִּ֣י וְזִמְרָ֣ת יָ֑הּ וַֽיְהִי לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.en: HaShem is my strength and song; and He is become my salvation.

verses.he: ק֤וֹל רִנָּ֬ה וִֽישׁוּעָ֗ה בְּאָהֳלֵ֥י צַדִּיקִ֑ים יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃
verses.en: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous; the right hand of HaShem doeth valiantly.

verses.he: יְמִ֣ין יְ֭הוָה רוֹמֵמָ֑ה יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃
verses.en: The right hand of HaShem is exalted; the right hand of HaShem doeth valiantly.

verses.he: לֹֽא אָמ֥וּת כִּי אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה וַ֝אֲסַפֵּ֗ר מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥י יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of HaShem.

verses.he: יַסֹּ֣ר יִסְּרַ֣נִּי יָּ֑הּ וְ֝לַמָּ֗וֶת לֹ֣א נְתָנָֽנִי׃
verses.en: HaShem hath chastened me sore; but He hath not given me over unto death.

verses.he: פִּתְחוּ לִ֥י שַׁעֲרֵי צֶ֑דֶק אָֽבֹא בָ֝ם אוֹדֶ֥ה יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will enter into them, I will give thanks unto HaShem.

verses.he: זֶֽה הַשַּׁ֥עַר לַיהוָ֑ה צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יָבֹ֥אוּ בֽוֹ׃
verses.en: This is the gate of HaShem; the righteous shall enter into it.

verses.he: א֭וֹדְךָ כִּ֣י עֲנִיתָ֑נִי וַתְּהִי לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.en: I will give thanks unto Thee, for Thou hast answered me, and art become my salvation.

verses.he: אֶ֭בֶן מָאֲס֣וּ הַבּוֹנִ֑ים הָ֝יְתָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ פִּנָּֽה׃
verses.en: The stone which the builders rejected is become the chief corner-stone.

verses.he: מֵאֵ֣ת יְ֭הוָה הָ֣יְתָה זֹּ֑את הִ֖יא נִפְלָ֣את בְּעֵינֵֽינוּ׃
verses.en: This is HaShem'S doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.

verses.he: זֶה הַ֭יּוֹם עָשָׂ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה נָגִ֖ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָ֣ה בֽוֹ׃
verses.en: This is the day which HaShem hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

verses.he: אָנָּ֣א יְ֭הוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥ה נָּ֑א אָֽנָּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥ה נָּֽא׃
verses.en: We beseech Thee, O HaShem, save now! We beseech Thee, O HaShem, make us now to prosper!

verses.he: בָּר֣וּךְ הַ֭בָּא בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה בֵּ֝רַֽכְנוּכֶ֗ם מִבֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of HaShem; we bless you out of the house of HaShem.

verses.he: אֵ֤ל יְהוָה֮ וַיָּ֪אֶר לָ֥נוּ אִסְרוּ חַ֥ג בַּעֲבֹתִ֑ים עַד קַ֝רְנ֗וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.en: HaShem is G-d, and hath given us light; order the festival procession with boughs, even unto the horns of the altar.

verses.he: אֵלִ֣י אַתָּ֣ה וְאוֹדֶ֑ךָּ אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֲרוֹמְמֶֽךָּ׃
verses.en: Thou art my G-d, and I will give thanks unto Thee; Thou art my G-d, I will exalt Thee.

verses.he: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: O give thanks unto HaShem, for He is good, for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: אַשְׁרֵ֥י תְמִֽימֵי דָ֑רֶךְ הַֽ֝הֹלְכִ֗ים בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: ALEPH. Happy are they that are upright in the way, who walk in the law of HaShem.

verses.he: אַ֭שְׁרֵי נֹצְרֵ֥י עֵדֹתָ֗יו בְּכָל לֵ֥ב יִדְרְשֽׁוּהוּ׃
verses.en: Happy are they that keep His testimonies, that seek Him with the whole heart.

verses.he: אַ֭ף לֹֽא פָעֲל֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה בִּדְרָכָ֥יו הָלָֽכוּ׃
verses.en: Yea, they do no unrighteousness; they walk in His ways.

verses.he: אַ֭תָּה צִוִּ֥יתָה פִקֻּדֶ֗יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֥ר מְאֹֽד׃
verses.en: Thou hast ordained Thy precepts, that we should observe them diligently.

verses.he: אַ֭חֲלַי יִכֹּ֥נוּ דְרָכָ֗י לִשְׁמֹ֥ר חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Oh that my ways were directed to observe Thy statutes!

verses.he: אָ֥ז לֹא אֵב֑וֹשׁ בְּ֝הַבִּיטִ֗י אֶל כָּל מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Then should I not be ashamed, when I have regard unto all Thy commandments.

verses.he: א֭וֹדְךָ בְּיֹ֣שֶׁר לֵבָ֑ב בְּ֝לָמְדִ֗י מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: I will give thanks unto Thee with uprightness of heart, when I learn Thy righteous ordinances.

verses.he: אֶת חֻקֶּ֥יךָ אֶשְׁמֹ֑ר אַֽל תַּעַזְבֵ֥נִי עַד מְאֹֽד׃
verses.en: I will observe Thy statutes; O forsake me not utterly.

verses.he: בַּמֶּ֣ה יְזַכֶּה נַּ֭עַר אֶת אָרְח֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: BETH. Wherewithal shall a young man keep his way pure? By taking heed thereto according to Thy word.

verses.he: בְּכָל לִבִּ֥י דְרַשְׁתִּ֑יךָ אַל תַּ֝שְׁגֵּ֗נִי מִמִּצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: With my whole heart have I sought Thee; O let me not err from Thy commandments.

verses.he: בְּ֭לִבִּי צָפַ֣נְתִּי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֶֽחֱטָא לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, that I might not sin against Thee.

verses.he: בָּר֖וּךְ אַתָּ֥ה יְהוָ֗ה לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Blessed art Thou, O HaShem; teach me Thy statutes.

verses.he: בִּשְׂפָתַ֥י סִפַּ֑רְתִּי כֹּ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵי פִֽיךָ׃
verses.en: With my lips have I told all the ordinances of Thy mouth.

verses.he: בְּדֶ֖רֶךְ עֵדְוֺתֶ֥יךָ שַׂ֗שְׂתִּי כְּעַ֣ל כָּל הֽוֹן׃
verses.en: I have rejoiced in the way of Thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.

verses.he: בְּפִקֻּדֶ֥יךָ אָשִׂ֑יחָה וְ֝אַבִּ֗יטָה אֹרְחֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: I will meditate in Thy precepts, and have respect unto Thy ways.

verses.he: בְּחֻקֹּתֶ֥יךָ אֶֽשְׁתַּעֲשָׁ֑ע לֹ֭א אֶשְׁכַּ֣ח דְּבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: I will delight myself in Thy statutes; I will not forget Thy word.

verses.he: גְּמֹ֖ל עַֽל עַבְדְּךָ֥ אֶֽחְיֶ֗ה וְאֶשְׁמְרָ֥ה דְבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with Thy servant that I may live, and I will observe Thy word.

verses.he: גַּל עֵינַ֥י וְאַבִּ֑יטָה נִ֝פְלָא֗וֹת מִתּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Open Thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of Thy law.

verses.he: גֵּ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י בָאָ֑רֶץ אַל תַּסְתֵּ֥ר מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: I am a sojourner in the earth; hide not Thy commandments from me.

verses.he: גָּרְסָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֣י לְתַאֲבָ֑ה אֶֽל מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ בְכָל עֵֽת׃
verses.en: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto Thine ordinances at all times.

verses.he: גָּ֭עַרְתָּ זֵדִ֣ים אֲרוּרִ֑ים הַ֝שֹּׁגִים מִמִּצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, that do err from Thy commandments.

verses.he: גַּ֣ל מֵֽ֭עָלַי חֶרְפָּ֣ה וָב֑וּז כִּ֖י עֵדֹתֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי׃
verses.en: Take away from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept Thy testimonies.

verses.he: גַּ֤ם יָֽשְׁב֣וּ שָׂ֭רִים בִּ֣י נִדְבָּ֑רוּ עַ֝בְדְּךָ֗ יָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Even though princes sit and talk against me, thy servant doth meditate in Thy statutes.

verses.he: גַּֽם עֵ֭דֹתֶיךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֗י אַנְשֵׁ֥י עֲצָתִֽי׃
verses.en: Yea, Thy testimonies are my delight, they are my counsellors.

verses.he: דָּֽבְקָ֣ה לֶעָפָ֣ר נַפְשִׁ֑י חַ֝יֵּ֗נִי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: DALETH. My soul cleaveth unto the dust; quicken Thou me according to Thy word.

verses.he: דְּרָכַ֣י סִ֭פַּרְתִּי וַֽתַּעֲנֵ֗נִי לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.en: I told of my ways, and Thou didst answer me; teach me Thy statutes.

verses.he: דֶּֽרֶךְ פִּקּוּדֶ֥יךָ הֲבִינֵ֑נִי וְ֝אָשִׂ֗יחָה בְּנִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Make me to understand the way of Thy precepts, that I may talk of Thy wondrous works.

verses.he: דָּלְפָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִתּוּגָ֑ה קַ֝יְּמֵ֗נִי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: My soul melteth away for heaviness; sustain me according unto Thy word.

verses.he: דֶּֽרֶךְ שֶׁ֭קֶר הָסֵ֣ר מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְֽתוֹרָתְךָ֥ חָנֵּֽנִי׃
verses.en: Remove from me the way of falsehood; and grant me Thy law graciously.

verses.he: דֶּֽרֶךְ אֱמוּנָ֥ה בָחָ֑רְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ שִׁוִּֽיתִי׃
verses.en: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; Thine ordinances have I set before me.

verses.he: דָּבַ֥קְתִּי בְעֵֽדְוֺתֶ֑יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַל תְּבִישֵֽׁנִי׃
verses.en: I cleave unto Thy testimonies; O HaShem, put me not to shame.

verses.he: דֶּֽרֶךְ מִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ אָר֑וּץ כִּ֖י תַרְחִ֣יב לִבִּֽי׃
verses.en: I will run the way of Thy commandments, for Thou dost enlarge my heart.

verses.he: הוֹרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ חֻקֶּ֗יךָ וְאֶצְּרֶ֥נָּה עֵֽקֶב׃
verses.en: HE. Teach me, O HaShem, the way of Thy statutes; and I will keep it at every step.

verses.he: הֲ֭בִינֵנִי וְאֶצְּרָ֥ה תֽוֹרָתֶ֗ךָ וְאֶשְׁמְרֶ֥נָּה בְכָל לֵֽב׃
verses.en: Give me understanding, that I keep Thy law and observe it with my whole heart.

verses.he: הַ֭דְרִיכֵנִי בִּנְתִ֣יב מִצְוֺתֶ֑יךָ כִּי ב֥וֹ חָפָֽצְתִּי׃
verses.en: Make me to tread in the path of Thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

verses.he: הַט לִ֭בִּי אֶל עֵדְוֺתֶ֗יךָ וְאַ֣ל אֶל בָּֽצַע׃
verses.en: Incline my heart unto Thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

verses.he: הַעֲבֵ֣ר עֵ֭ינַי מֵרְא֣וֹת שָׁ֑וְא בִּדְרָכֶ֥ךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
verses.en: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity, and quicken me in Thy ways.

verses.he: הָקֵ֣ם לְ֭עַבְדְּךָ אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לְיִרְאָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Confirm Thy word unto Thy servant, which pertaineth unto the fear of Thee.

verses.he: הַעֲבֵ֣ר חֶ֭רְפָּתִי אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָגֹ֑רְתִּי כִּ֖י מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ טוֹבִֽים׃
verses.en: Turn away my reproach which I dread; for Thine ordinances are good.

verses.he: הִ֭נֵּה תָּאַ֣בְתִּי לְפִקֻּדֶ֑יךָ בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֥ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
verses.en: Behold, I have longed after Thy precepts; quicken me in Thy righteousness.

verses.he: וִֽיבֹאֻ֣נִי חֲסָדֶ֣ךָ יְהוָ֑ה תְּ֝שֽׁוּעָתְךָ֗ כְּאִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: VAV. Let Thy mercies also come unto me, O HaShem, even Thy salvation, according to Thy word;

verses.he: וְאֶֽעֱנֶ֣ה חֹרְפִ֣י דָבָ֑ר כִּֽי בָ֝טַחְתִּי בִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: That I may have an answer for him that taunteth me; for I trust in Thy word.

verses.he: וְֽאַל תַּצֵּ֬ל מִפִּ֣י דְבַר אֱמֶ֣ת עַד מְאֹ֑ד כִּ֖י לְמִשְׁפָּטֶ֣ךָ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.en: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I hope in Thine ordinances;

verses.he: וְאֶשְׁמְרָ֖ה תוֹרָתְךָ֥ תָמִ֗יד לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.en: So shall I observe Thy law continually for ever and ever;

verses.he: וְאֶתְהַלְּכָ֥ה בָרְחָבָ֑ה כִּ֖י פִקֻּדֶ֣יךָ דָרָֽשְׁתִּי׃
verses.en: And I will walk at ease, for I have sought Thy precepts;

verses.he: וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה בְ֭עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶ֥גֶד מְלָכִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.en: I will also speak of Thy testimonies before kings, and will not be ashamed.

verses.he: וְאֶשְׁתַּֽעֲשַׁ֥ע בְּמִצְוֺתֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהָֽבְתִּי׃
verses.en: And I will delight myself in Thy commandments, which I have loved.

verses.he: וְאֶשָּֽׂא כַפַּ֗י אֶֽל מִ֭צְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָהָ֗בְתִּי וְאָשִׂ֥יחָה בְחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.en: I will lift up my hands also unto Thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in Thy statutes.

verses.he: זְכֹר דָּבָ֥ר לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ עַ֝֗ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִֽחַלְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.en: ZAIN. Remember the word unto Thy servant, because Thou hast made me to hope.

verses.he: זֹ֣את נֶחָמָתִ֣י בְעָנְיִ֑י כִּ֖י אִמְרָתְךָ֣ חִיָּֽתְנִי׃
verses.en: This is my comfort in my affliction, that Thy word hath quickened me.

verses.he: זֵ֭דִים הֱלִיצֻ֣נִי עַד מְאֹ֑ד מִ֝תּֽוֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי׃
verses.en: The proud have had me greatly in derision; yet have I not turned aside from Thy law.

verses.he: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶ֖יךָ מֵעוֹלָ֥ם יְהוָ֗ה וָֽאֶתְנֶחָֽם׃
verses.en: I have remembered Thine ordinances which are of old, O HaShem, and have comforted myself.

verses.he: זַלְעָפָ֣ה אֲ֭חָזַתְנִי מֵרְשָׁעִ֑ים עֹ֝זְבֵ֗י תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Burning indignation hath taken hold upon me, because of the wicked that forsake Thy law.

verses.he: זְ֭מִרוֹת הָֽיוּ לִ֥י חֻקֶּ֗יךָ בְּבֵ֣ית מְגוּרָֽי׃
verses.en: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

verses.he: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה וָֽ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: I have remembered Thy name, O HaShem, in the night, and have observed Thy law.

verses.he: זֹ֥את הָֽיְתָה לִּ֑י כִּ֖י פִקֻּדֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי׃
verses.en: This I have had, that I have kept Thy precepts.

verses.he: חֶלְקִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אָמַ֗רְתִּי לִשְׁמֹ֥ר דְּבָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: HETH. My portion is HaShem, I have said that I would observe Thy words.

verses.he: חִלִּ֣יתִי פָנֶ֣יךָ בְכָל לֵ֑ב חָ֝נֵּ֗נִי כְּאִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: I have entreated Thy favour with my whole heart; be gracious unto me according to Thy word.

verses.he: חִשַּׁ֥בְתִּי דְרָכָ֑י וָאָשִׁ֥יבָה רַ֝גְלַ֗י אֶל עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: I considered my ways, and turned my feet unto Thy testimonies.

verses.he: חַ֭שְׁתִּי וְלֹ֣א הִתְמַהְמָ֑הְתִּי לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: I made haste, and delayed not, to observe Thy commandments.

verses.he: חֶבְלֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים עִוְּדֻ֑נִי תּֽ֝וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
verses.en: The bands of the wicked have enclosed me; but I have not forgotten Thy law.

verses.he: חֲצֽוֹת לַ֗יְלָה אָ֭קוּם לְהוֹד֣וֹת לָ֑ךְ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto Thee because of Thy righteous ordinances.

verses.he: חָבֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי לְכָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְרֵא֑וּךָ וּ֝לְשֹׁמְרֵ֗י פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: I am a companion of all them that fear Thee, and of them that observe Thy precepts.

verses.he: חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֗רֶץ חֻקֶּ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: The earth, O HaShem, is full of Thy mercy; teach me Thy statutes.

verses.he: ט֭וֹב עָשִׂ֣יתָ עִֽם עַבְדְּךָ֑ יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: TETH. Thou hast dealt well with Thy servant, O HaShem, according unto Thy word.

verses.he: ט֤וּב טַ֣עַם וָדַ֣עַת לַמְּדֵ֑נִי כִּ֖י בְמִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ הֶאֱמָֽנְתִּי׃
verses.en: Teach me good discernment and knowledge; for I have believed Thy commandments.

verses.he: טֶ֣רֶם אֶ֭עֱנֶה אֲנִ֣י שֹׁגֵ֑ג וְ֝עַתָּ֗ה אִמְרָתְךָ֥ שָׁמָֽרְתִּי׃
verses.en: Before I was afflicted, I did err; but now I observe Thy word.

verses.he: טוֹב אַתָּ֥ה וּמֵטִ֗יב לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me Thy statutes.

verses.he: טָפְל֬וּ עָלַ֣י שֶׁ֣קֶר זֵדִ֑ים אֲ֝נִ֗י בְּכָל לֵ֤ב אֱצֹּ֬ר פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: The proud have forged a lie against me; but I with my whole heart will keep Thy precepts.

verses.he: טָפַ֣שׁ כַּחֵ֣לֶב לִבָּ֑ם אֲ֝נִ֗י תּוֹרָתְךָ֥ שִֽׁעֲשָֽׁעְתִּי׃
verses.en: Their heart is gross like fat; but I delight in Thy law.

verses.he: טֽוֹב לִ֥י כִֽי עֻנֵּ֑יתִי לְ֝מַ֗עַן אֶלְמַ֥ד חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.en: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, in order that I might learn Thy statutes.

verses.he: טֽוֹב לִ֥י תֽוֹרַת פִּ֑יךָ מֵ֝אַלְפֵ֗י זָהָ֥ב וָכָֽסֶף׃
verses.en: The law of Thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.

verses.he: יָדֶ֣יךָ עָ֭שׂוּנִי וַֽיְכוֹנְנ֑וּנִי הֲ֝בִינֵ֗נִי וְאֶלְמְדָ֥ה מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: JOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding, that I may learn Thy commandments.

verses.he: יְ֭רֵאֶיךָ יִרְא֣וּנִי וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ כִּ֖י לִדְבָרְךָ֣ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.en: They that fear Thee shall see me and be glad, because I have hope in Thy word.

verses.he: יָדַ֣עְתִּי יְ֭הוָה כִּי צֶ֣דֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶ֑יךָ וֶ֝אֱמוּנָ֗ה עִנִּיתָֽנִי׃
verses.en: I know, O HaShem, that Thy judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness Thou hast afflicted me.

verses.he: יְהִי נָ֣א חַסְדְּךָ֣ לְנַחֲמֵ֑נִי כְּאִמְרָתְךָ֥ לְעַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: Let, I pray Thee, Thy lovingkindness be ready to comfort me, according to Thy promise unto Thy servant.

verses.he: יְבֹא֣וּנִי רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ וְאֶֽחְיֶ֑ה כִּי תֽ֝וֹרָתְךָ֗ שַֽׁעֲשֻׁעָֽי׃
verses.en: Let Thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live; for Thy law is my delight.

verses.he: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ זֵ֭דִים כִּי שֶׁ֣קֶר עִוְּת֑וּנִי אֲ֝נִ֗י אָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Let the proud be put to shame, for they have distorted my cause with falsehood; but I will meditate in Thy precepts.

verses.he: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ לִ֣י יְרֵאֶ֑יךָ וידעווידעווְ֝יֹדְעֵ֗יעֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Let those that fear Thee return unto me, and they that know Thy testimonies.

verses.he: יְהִֽי לִבִּ֣י תָמִ֣ים בְּחֻקֶּ֑יךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.en: Let my heart be undivided in Thy statutes, in order that I may not be put to shame.

verses.he: כָּלְתָ֣ה לִתְשׁוּעָתְךָ֣ נַפְשִׁ֑י לִדְבָרְךָ֥ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.en: CAPH. My soul pineth for Thy salvation; in Thy word do I hope.

verses.he: כָּל֣וּ עֵ֭ינַי לְאִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לֵ֝אמֹ֗ר מָתַ֥י תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Mine eyes fail for Thy word, saying: 'When wilt Thou comfort me?'

verses.he: כִּֽי הָ֭יִיתִי כְּנֹ֣אד בְּקִיט֑וֹר חֻ֝קֶּ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
verses.en: For I am become like a wine-skin in the smoke; yet do I not forget Thy statutes.

verses.he: כַּמָּ֥ה יְמֵֽי עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ מָתַ֬י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בְרֹדְפַ֣י מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.en: How many are the days of Thy servant? When wilt Thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

verses.he: כָּֽרוּ לִ֣י זֵדִ֣ים שִׁיח֑וֹת אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לֹ֣א כְתוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: The proud have digged pits for me, which is not according to Thy law.

verses.he: כָּל מִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ אֱמוּנָ֑ה שֶׁ֖קֶר רְדָפ֣וּנִי עָזְרֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: All Thy commandments are faithful; they persecute me for nought; help Thou me.

verses.he: כִּ֭מְעַט כִּלּ֣וּנִי בָאָ֑רֶץ וַ֝אֲנִ֗י לֹא עָזַ֥בְתִּי פִקֻּודֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but as for me, I forsook not Thy precepts.

verses.he: כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ חַיֵּ֑נִי וְ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה עֵד֥וּת פִּֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Quicken me after Thy lovingkindness, and I will observe the testimony of Thy mouth.

verses.he: לְעוֹלָ֥ם יְהוָ֑ה דְּ֝בָרְךָ֗ נִצָּ֥ב בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.en: LAMED. For ever, O HaShem, Thy word standeth fast in heaven.

verses.he: לְדֹ֣ר וָ֭דֹר אֱמֽוּנָתֶ֑ךָ כּוֹנַ֥נְתָּ אֶ֝֗רֶץ וַֽתַּעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.en: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations; Thou hast established the earth, and it standeth.

verses.he: לְֽ֭מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְד֣וּ הַיּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י הַכֹּ֣ל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: They stand this day according to Thine ordinances; for all things are Thy servants.

verses.he: לוּלֵ֣י ת֭וֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֑י אָ֝֗ז אָבַ֥דְתִּי בְעָנְיִֽי׃
verses.en: Unless Thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
